choices.text: The person places a small green paper triangle beside the jar and adds a larger green triangle to its left. They press the larger piece against the table, then hold up a small white square and place it to the left of both green pieces. Their fingertips press down on the white paper before lifting away.

The person lays a small white paper triangle on the dark counter and presses it flat with their fingertips. They place a larger triangle immediately to its right, aligning the lower edges. Finally, they add a small white square to the right of the larger triangle and withdraw their hand, leaving the shapes beside the mug.

A person picks up a wide blue lid and places it over a small clear jar on a red table, pressing it down with one hand. They put a red lid on the taller jar beside it, then take a small gray lid and set it on top of a clear plastic tub at the left before withdrawing their hands.

A person screws a gray lid onto a small glass jar on a round red table. They lift a much broader blue lid, rest it across the mouth of a taller jar, and press down on it several times. They then pick up a red lid from beside that jar and reach over to press the clear lid on the round container at the left.

A person rests an orange notebook with one end raised on a thick green book, then lays a brown jar on its side at the lower end. They place a thin dark stick across the sloping cover and release it. After reaching toward the jar to retrieve the stick, they place it near the raised end again and repeat the movement.

A person unscrews the cap from a black bottle and leaves it on the table beside the decorated glass. They tilt the open bottle over the glass, then return it to an upright position. Next, they raise the glass and lower it back onto the table, leaving the bottle uncapped.

A hand unscrews the metal cap from the clear bottle and removes it. The person lifts the open bottle, tilts its mouth over the stemless glass, and stands it upright again. They then pick up the glass and raise it out of view before returning it to the table beside the uncapped bottle.

A person lifts the clear bottle, twists off its cap, and sets the cap beside the mug. They tip the open bottle over the mug while steadying the mug with the other hand, then return the bottle upright on the table. The mug is raised beyond the top of the frame and later set back down, leaving the bottle uncapped.

A person lifts a bottle of dark liquid and twists its orange cap while holding the bottle beside a tall clear glass. With the cap still on, they tilt the bottle over the glass, then set it upright again. They lift the glass out of the top of the view and return it beside a tomato and fork resting on a book.

A person lifts the tall clear bottle and unscrews its white cap. Holding the turquoise cup in the other hand, they tilt the bottle so its mouth rests over the cup's rim, then return both upright. They replace the cap and stand the bottle on the table before raising the cup out of view and setting it back down.

A person rests an orange notebook with one end raised on a thick green book, then lays a brown jar on its side at the lower end. They place a thin dark stick across the sloping cover and release it. After reaching toward the jar to retrieve the stick, they place it near the raised end again and repeat the movement.

A person lays a small clear jar of yellow liquid on its side near the right end of a book and releases it to roll across the cover. They repeatedly retrieve the jar from the left, return it to the right and let it roll again. After the last run, they move the jar beside the notebook pile, leaving the book clear in front of them.

A person arranges three books on a wooden table, leaving one slanted across another and standing the third upright in front of its right end. They release a small orange onto the slanted book; it rolls behind the upright book and emerges on the right. They repeat this twice, then leave the orange beside the books and step away.

A person leans a spiral notebook against a small stack of books to form a ramp, then stands an ornate book upright nearby. They release a clear plastic bottle with a blue cap down the notebook, retrieve it from the right side of the table, and repeat the motion. The sequence ends with another release onto the sloping notebook.

A person lays a brown spiral notebook at an angle across the small book stack, then stands a thick dark hardback upright to its right. They bring a clear blue-capped bottle onto the notebook and release it on its side. The bottle rolls off toward the open tabletop, and the person retrieves it and repeats the roll before bringing it back to the notebook.

A person rolls an orange across the wooden table and retrieves it near the front edge. They bring a closed brown book forward and lift the orange onto its cover. The orange is turned and moved over the book, then released on top while the red mug and pale apple remain at the back of the table.

A person arranges three books on a wooden table, leaving one slanted across another and standing the third upright in front of its right end. They release a small orange onto the slanted book; it rolls behind the upright book and emerges on the right. They repeat this twice, then leave the orange beside the books and step away.

A person lifts the small white cup over an empty patch of table, then raises the floral mug to reveal an orange underneath. They cover the orange and slide the inverted cups back and forth, briefly exchanging their positions. After restoring the white cup on the left and floral mug in the middle, they lift each again and leave the orange covered by the floral mug beside the apple.

A person places an apple on a closed book, raises one edge of the book, and lets the apple roll off onto the table. They retrieve it and repeat the movement several times, changing the tilt so the apple rolls toward the near edge and then off the left side. The apple finishes on the table beside the book, while a capped bottle remains to the left.

A person places one end of a wooden board on a stack of books to make a ramp. They release an orange at the raised end, allowing it to roll down onto the table, then retrieve it from near the small black box. The orange is sent down the board a second time, retrieved again and reset for another release as the person's hand lifts away.

The person releases a small red cap from the far end of the white board, letting it roll toward the near edge of the table. They retrieve it, return it to the far end, and repeat the action. At the end, the cap is partway along the board while the orange cup remains beside it.

A person lays a capped white bottle on its side at the right edge of a wooden cutting board, which is raised on a dark book. They release the bottle and it rolls across the board to the left, where their other hand waits. They retrieve it and repeat the roll, then return the bottle to the raised right edge once more.

A person moves cups from the right end of a white table into a row across its middle. They set a patterned white cup upright, place a green and yellow cup upside down to its left, add an upright metal tumbler, and then an inverted maroon and yellow cup farther left. They finish by lifting the remaining maroon cup and turning it upside down in the air.

A person removes the red cap from a small white bottle and sets it beside the bottle, then takes the green lid off a large tub. They unscrew a silver cap from the small clear shaker and a dark cap from the tall clear bottle, placing both on the table. Finally, they briefly move the computer mouse at the right and lift their hand away.

A person holds a large white board upright in front of a small nail polish bottle on the table. They move the board to the left to reveal the bottle, then slide it back across to hide it again. After repeating this movement, they lift the board away and leave, with the bottle and a mug holding a banana and fork still on the table.

The person sends a round green object rolling from the right side of the table toward the patterned metal tin. They bring it back to the right and repeat the motion. After the final release, it is left beside the tin, with the mug and small bottle still in their original positions.

A hand lowers a short wooden cylinder onto its side at the right of the table and releases it to roll left toward the small yellow container. The person retrieves it, brings it back beside the blue lid, and rolls it across again. They repeat the same movement once more, while the box and plate remain in place.

A person lays a capped plastic water bottle on its side on a red-covered table and pushes it into a short roll. They repeatedly bring it back toward the left and send it rolling across the same area again. The bottle stays on its side throughout, while a notebook and an upside-down bowl topped with a small green vegetable remain at the back.

A hand lays a blue-capped plastic bottle on its side and pushes it across the wooden tabletop toward the shallow gray bowl. The bottle is brought back toward the near edge and rolled again several times. The hand alternates between catching it and releasing it, while the mug and narrow red bottle stay in place.

A person pushes a white cylinder lying on its side across a dark-covered table, lets it roll, and moves it back for another release. They repeat the rolling motion, then reach behind the cylinder and lift a clear bottle out of view. They give the cylinder another push, leaving it resting horizontally near the front while a black toy car and small colored sticks remain nearby.

A person sets a tall patterned cup with a yellow rim on the gray table, then adds a white cup with green leaves beside it. A clear glass is placed in front of the yellow-rimmed cup. The final cup, decorated with small stars, is set upside down to the right of the glass, forming a second row.

A hand places a clear ribbed cup upright near the front-left of the black tabletop. A tall decorated yellow tumbler is added behind it to the right, followed by a plain pale yellow cup farther right. Finally, the person sets a white printed mug upside down at the back-right end, leaving four vessels arranged diagonally across the table.

A person places a tall cartoon-patterned cup on a gray table and adds a white cup with a green leafy design beside it. They adjust the white cup so the pair stands close together, then set a clear handled mug in front on the right. A cream-colored cup with a yellow face design is placed upside down at the front of the group.

A person places a translucent purple cup upright near the back of the round table. They add a second cup in front of it, turning this one upside down, then set a third cup upright closer to the front edge. The cups form a short diagonal row beside the small roll of tape.

A seated person brings the orange cup to the front of the table, then places the blue-lined white cup upside down behind it. They add the white mug with lettering upright and move the purple mug behind that, upside down. Finally, they lift the wide yellow-patterned mug and hold it above the table while reaching toward the camera with their other hand.

The person sets a folded green shirt on the table, unfolds it, and holds it spread out with the printed design facing forward. They fold it into a small stack again and lay it down. A black fabric item with blue edging is placed on top, followed by a fork laid across the pile.

A person folds a dark gray garment at the back of a wooden table and lays it flat near the front left. They fold a beige garment and place it over the first, then add a folded dark shirt with a white graphic on top. They pat the finished stack beside a green glass bowl resting on a book.

A person spreads out a yellow T-shirt, folds it into a compact rectangle and places it beside the tall yellow cup. They fold the white sheet of paper and lay it on top of the shirt. Next, they lift the blue patterned fabric, fold it and add it to the stack, pressing the pile flat with both hands.

A seated person lifts a red printed garment, folds it and places it on the table. They fold a dark garment onto it, then add a pale patterned piece to the top of the pile. Finally, they pull a white paper towel toward the front, fold it into a smaller rectangle and smooth it down beside a pair of glasses.

A person lifts a dark teal garment from a pile on a checked table, folds it, and places it to the left. They fold an orange shirt and add it on top, followed by a red shirt. They then lift the remaining dark patterned sweater, fold it into a compact rectangle, and lay it on the stack, clearing the right side of the table.

A person holds up a black remote control and lays it on the counter in front of the tall green vase. They bring in a white plate next and set it farther forward on the right. Finally, a white power adapter and its cable are placed to the left of the plate, with the cable left loosely looped.

A person points across a pale table and places a white plug adapter near its front corner. They add a small roll of tape farther back and a brown mug beside the adapter. A pair of metal chopsticks is moved next to the mug, and a black remote is taken from the left side and laid beside the tape.

A person brings a black remote control to a wooden table, shows its buttons, and sets it beside a small lidded glass jar. They then hold out an empty white ribbed bowl and place it farther to the right. Finally, they display a black sock and lay it on the right side of the bowl, leaving the items spread across the table.

Hands lift a black remote control from a coffee table, turn its buttons toward the camera, and set it near the front. The person then picks up a closed laptop, tilts it sideways, and returns it farther right. They display a drinking glass and set it near the front left, then lift a power adapter with its cables and lay them across the table beside the remote.

A person lifts a black frying pan to show its inside, then returns it to the counter. They pick up and display a remote control, a small gray rectangular device and a floral mug in turn, putting each down again. Next, they lift and spread out the colorful cloth, then reposition the fork and red-handled knife beside it.

A person lifts three upside-down white cups one at a time, showing a small dark object beneath the cup on the right. They put the cups down and slide them around with both hands. After rearranging them, they lift the cups again, revealing the object under the middle cup before returning all three to an inverted row.

A person lifts each of two inverted yellow cups, showing empty space beneath the left cup and a small white bottle beneath the right, then covers both positions again. They slide the cups forward and closer together on the counter. They repeat the reveals in the same order, with the bottle still beneath the right cup, and finish with both cups inverted.

A person lifts three inverted cups in turn, showing empty spaces under the blue and brown cups and a small cluster of nails beneath the white one. They cover the nails and shuffle the cups across the lap desk. They then lift the brown cup to show nothing beneath it, uncover the nails under the white cup in the middle, and lift the empty blue cup before covering all three positions again.

A person moves cups from the right end of a white table into a row across its middle. They set a patterned white cup upright, place a green and yellow cup upside down to its left, add an upright metal tumbler, and then an inverted maroon and yellow cup farther left. They finish by lifting the remaining maroon cup and turning it upside down in the air.

A person lifts the left of two clear inverted cups, revealing a small green piece, then lifts the right cup to show the bare cloth beneath it. They replace both cups and slide them around with crossed hands. Lifting them again reveals the green piece beneath the left cup, and both cups are finally set down upside down.

A person sorts a pile on a wooden table, gathering a white garment and then folding a striped towel over it on the right. They fold a gray item and add it to the stack. Next, they crease a sheet of white paper and stand it on top before gathering the last white cloth and placing it with the folded items.

A person lifts a gray garment from a pile on a covered table, folds it, and places it near the back. They fold a white garment over it, smoothing the new stack with both hands. Next, they pick up a dark striped shirt, fold it, and add it on top, while a blue garment remains spread separately at the front.

A person folds a dark gray garment at the back of a wooden table and lays it flat near the front left. They fold a beige garment and place it over the first, then add a folded dark shirt with a white graphic on top. They pat the finished stack beside a green glass bowl resting on a book.

A person lifts a dark teal garment from a pile on a checked table, folds it, and places it to the left. They fold an orange shirt and add it on top, followed by a red shirt. They then lift the remaining dark patterned sweater, fold it into a compact rectangle, and lay it on the stack, clearing the right side of the table.

A person lifts a white sheet from a pile of clothes, folds it, and stands it on the glass tabletop. They then pick up dark trousers, fold them into a compact rectangle, and set them down on the right. A dark blue printed shirt is folded next and placed on top of the trousers beside the open laptop.

A hand picks up the black-and-white pen and displays it across an open palm before returning it to the counter. The cream-handled knife is lifted and shown next, followed by the clear-bodied pen. Finally, the blue pencil is held up in the same way and set back beside the other objects.

A person picks up a dark pen from a wooden table and holds it horizontally between both hands, then puts it back. They repeat the display with a second dark pen before lifting a metal spoon and holding it across their hands in the same way. The spoon is returned beside the pens, while another utensil stays resting across the red container at the left.

A person turns a small dark item between their hands and places it near the white egg. They then hold up a red-capped pen and a black pen in turn, laying them on the table after each display. Finally, they show the orange-handled spoon and set it down to the left of the writing implements.

A hand presents a slim black pen over a white-covered table and removes it from view. The person then displays a blue writing tool, a metal fork with a dark handle and a beige marker with a black cap, withdrawing each in turn. A small black charging unit and its loose cable remain on the left throughout.

A person shows a clear pen with red ends and lays it on the right side of a table. They display a metal fork next and place it beside the pen, then add a gray retractable pen, a blue-ended clear pen and another dark-topped pen in turn. Each object is briefly held toward the camera before joining the growing row.

A hand places a clear bottle with a white lid on the right side of the round table. A larger bottle containing yellow-green liquid is brought in horizontally, turned upright, and set to its left. Finally, a large yellow fruit is placed between the bottles, in front of the purple cups.

A person places an orange near the back of a round red table, then sets a clear drinking glass to its right. They add a small white bowl in front of the orange and stand a tall pink bottle beside the glass. Finally, they place a small labeled bottle behind the bowl, leaving the objects spaced across the tabletop.

A seated person places a small clear bottle with a green cap on the right side of a wooden table, then adds a red jar with a white lid on the left. They set a black oval case in front of the green-capped bottle and a small bottle of pale yellow liquid in front of the jar. A yellow tube is laid horizontally beside the case last.

A hand holds up a green star fruit and sets it on the round wooden table. Next, the person shows a small banana and places it beside the fruit. They finish by presenting a red onion and setting it on the other side of the banana, leaving the tall brown bottle standing behind the arrangement.

A person holds a large clear plastic bottle horizontally above a wooden table, turns it upright and sets it at the left behind a black ladle. They present a tall dark glass bottle next and place it on the right. Finally, they show a red apple and lower it onto the table between the two bottles, just behind the ladle's handle.

A person places a translucent purple cup upright near the back of the round table. They add a second cup in front of it, turning this one upside down, then set a third cup upright closer to the front edge. The cups form a short diagonal row beside the small roll of tape.

A person sets a tall patterned cup with a yellow rim on the gray table, then adds a white cup with green leaves beside it. A clear glass is placed in front of the yellow-rimmed cup. The final cup, decorated with small stars, is set upside down to the right of the glass, forming a second row.

A seated person brings the orange cup to the front of the table, then places the blue-lined white cup upside down behind it. They add the white mug with lettering upright and move the purple mug behind that, upside down. Finally, they lift the wide yellow-patterned mug and hold it above the table while reaching toward the camera with their other hand.

A person moves cups from the right end of a white table into a row across its middle. They set a patterned white cup upright, place a green and yellow cup upside down to its left, add an upright metal tumbler, and then an inverted maroon and yellow cup farther left. They finish by lifting the remaining maroon cup and turning it upside down in the air.

A hand places a clear ribbed cup upright near the front-left of the black tabletop. A tall decorated yellow tumbler is added behind it to the right, followed by a plain pale yellow cup farther right. Finally, the person sets a white printed mug upside down at the back-right end, leaving four vessels arranged diagonally across the table.

The person lifts the sheet of paper and pulls it apart, leaving a crumpled piece on the table. They then tear the lettuce into smaller sections and set the pieces down at the back of the table. Returning to the paper, they tear it into more pieces and leave a loose pile in front of the lettuce.

A person pulls a white sheet apart with both hands and leaves the pieces on the counter. They pick up a green lettuce leaf, tear off a smaller piece, and put both pieces down beside the paper. They then tear more white paper into smaller fragments, leaving a loose pile near the larger sheet and the lettuce.

A person takes lettuce from the plate, tears the leaves apart with both hands, and drops the pieces into the patterned bowl. They add tomato slices and then cucumber rounds from the plate, arranging them over the lettuce while some slices remain behind. Finally, they lift and move the small translucent container at the back of the counter.

A woman picks up a white sheet and pulls it apart with both hands, tearing off a long strip. She tears the remaining paper into more pieces and leaves them on the table. She then lifts the green lettuce leaf, pulls it into two sections and puts them back down, while the toy dinosaur with a funnel on its head stays at the left.

A person tears a long printed sheet into two pieces and leaves them beside a small blue packet. They pick up the small tan object on the right, pull it apart, and put the pieces down. Returning to the paper, they tear both sections into narrower strips and leave the strips spread across the table.

Holding a white plastic bag open by one handle, the person reaches inside and brings out a dark pen, followed by a silver-colored pen. Both are left on the tabletop beside the black boots. The bag is then lifted and set down loosely to the left of the pens.

A person holds a white shopping bag open and removes pens one at a time, laying a red-capped pen and then dark pens on the table. The pens form a small group in front of the bag, beside a pair of black boots and a white ball. They then gather the bag into a crumpled bundle and set it down to the left.

A hand picks up the black-and-white pen and displays it across an open palm before returning it to the counter. The cream-handled knife is lifted and shown next, followed by the clear-bodied pen. Finally, the blue pencil is held up in the same way and set back beside the other objects.

A person opens the white container on the right and leaves its lid on the table, then opens the matching container beside it. Both containers remain upright with their loose lids in front. The person then reaches for the gray pen on the left and nudges it across the tabletop before moving their hand away.

A person holds a pink pen horizontally toward the camera and lays it on the wooden table. They show a yellow pencil and a clear-bodied pen in turn, placing them beside the first pen. Next, they add orange-handled scissors in front of the writing tools and a turquoise ruler behind them, leaving the salt container standing at the back.

A person displays a black-capped marker in one hand and lays it near the back of a checked table. They show a metal spoon next, then slide it into place to the left of a black case. Finally, they present another dark pen and put it near the front, below the spoon.

A person picks up a dark pen from a wooden table and holds it horizontally between both hands, then puts it back. They repeat the display with a second dark pen before lifting a metal spoon and holding it across their hands in the same way. The spoon is returned beside the pens, while another utensil stays resting across the red container at the left.

A hand presents writing tools one at a time above the dark table, withdrawing each between views. A gray marker with a black cap is followed by a broad blue-capped marker, a slim blue pen, a silver-bodied marker with a blue cap, and another gray marker with a black cap. Finally, the person shows a clear glass with blue printing and takes it away.

A person turns a small dark item between their hands and places it near the white egg. They then hold up a red-capped pen and a black pen in turn, laying them on the table after each display. Finally, they show the orange-handled spoon and set it down to the left of the writing implements.

A hand presents a slim black pen over a white-covered table and removes it from view. The person then displays a blue writing tool, a metal fork with a dark handle and a beige marker with a black cap, withdrawing each in turn. A small black charging unit and its loose cable remain on the left throughout.

The person holds the black bag open and slides the blue book from the top of the stack inside. They add the next book, then the orange-covered book, clearing the stack from the table. Finally, they lower the top of the bag and work the zipper along the opening, leaving it between the plant and the red mug.

The person opens the black backpack and puts the black zippered case from the notebook into its main compartment. They add the spiral-bound notebook, pressing it down inside, then draw the top together and pull the zipper closed. With one hand still near the bag, they reach past the blue plate and shift the potted plant beside it.

The person lifts the top of a dark backpack lying on the table and slides a blue book into the open compartment. They add a thicker book with a dark cover, then an orange book, taking each from the stack beside the bag. After pressing the last book down inside, they lower the top of the backpack and withdraw their hand.

A person lifts the small book from the cabinet and opens it above the larger book lying underneath. They pick up the pale rectangular slip, lay it between the pages and close the small book. They move it toward the red bag, open the bag’s top and lower their hands at the opening before letting go and stepping back.

The person moves the two small books to the left and rests one end of the thick white book on them to make a slope. They shift the coffee tin to the right of the raised book. Holding a small cork with a dark base, they release it near the raised end, retrieve it near the lower end, and repeat the movement.

A person briefly holds a long metal utensil over the table and removes it from view. They show a looped white cable next, followed by a white plate with a green floral design. Finally, they raise a gray mug by its handle with its base facing the camera, then take it away.

A person presents a brown mug with a black interior above the floral table covering and takes it away. They show a metal spoon next, followed by a shallow metal plate, withdrawing each between views. Finally, they hold up a bunched olive garment with orange ties and then dark denim fabric before removing both from view.

A person holds a white floral mug above the table, turns it, and removes it from view. They then present a metal cup, a blue invoice book, and a long black notebook one after another, withdrawing each before showing the next. Returning to the earlier objects, they display the floral mug again with its opening visible, followed by the invoice book with its blue cover facing the camera.

A person presents a large kitchen knife horizontally, with its white handle in one hand, and lowers it out of view. They next hold up a plain white cup, a black remote control with its buttons facing the camera, and a looped white cable in turn. The light bulb, white plug adapter, and red-and-black book remain on the table throughout.

A person sets a small plate on the table and places a patterned white mug upright on it. They show a dark frying pan and lay it behind the mug, with the handle extending to the right. A remote control is added nearby, followed by a bundle of red checked fabric placed behind the cup.

A person holds an olive-green coat up in front of the camera, showing its front and pockets, then lowers it into a loose pile on a round glass table. Next, they display a white T-shirt with a colorful printed design. They lift the shirt briefly out of view and place it in a smaller bundle on top of the coat.

A person lifts a large coat and spreads it open, showing its dark lining, then folds it onto the seat of a white chair with the furry hood trim hanging over the front. They next raise a long camouflage-patterned garment with white sleeves and drawstrings, turn it to display both sides, and fold it onto the coat.

A person lifts a burgundy shirt, holds it open and turns it before dropping it onto the gray table. They add a green cap with a red and white brim near the front edge, then lay a looped white cable across it. Finally, they show a thick paperback close to the camera and place it on top of the cable and cap.

The person sets a folded green shirt on the table, unfolds it, and holds it spread out with the printed design facing forward. They fold it into a small stack again and lay it down. A black fabric item with blue edging is placed on top, followed by a fork laid across the pile.

A person folds a dark gray garment at the back of a wooden table and lays it flat near the front left. They fold a beige garment and place it over the first, then add a folded dark shirt with a white graphic on top. They pat the finished stack beside a green glass bowl resting on a book.

A person uncaps a blue pen and writes “MINE” on a small sheet of paper, then holds the sheet up to show it. They put the paper and pen down and begin sliding the separate black letters on the desk into a new order. After adjusting and flattening the letters with a hand, the row reads “EMIN.”

A person picks up a pen and makes short writing movements on a sheet of white paper while steadying the page with their other hand. After putting the pen down, they take large colored letter pieces one at a time and arrange them along the paper's right edge. They adjust the last piece and withdraw their hands, leaving the letters beside the page.

A person moves an orange pen across a white sheet, then lays the pen down and raises the paper to show its unmarked surface. They return the sheet to the dark table and begin arranging small pink and white letter pieces beside it. The letters are added one at a time until they form the row LUPER to the right of the blank sheet.

A person lays a blue pen horizontally near the center of a wooden table, beside a printed sheet and a red pen. They bring a white paperback upright in front of the blue pen, hiding it while shifting the book across the table and moving the loose sheet. When they lift the paperback away, the blue pen is visible farther left near the back edge.

A person picks up a black pen and moves its tip over a lined sheet on a yellow table. They put the pen beside a blue notebook, lift the sheet to show that it has no visible writing, and lay it back down. They then place white paper letters P, I, and G in a row above the sheet, spelling PIG.

The person lays green leaves on two slices of bread and adds tomato slices to each. They take white slices from the left side of the tray and place them on one piece of bread, then bring the bread together into a sandwich. Holding the sandwich down with one hand, they work a knife back and forth across the top.

A person moves two bread slices from a cutting board onto a white plate, laying them side by side. They place lettuce on the left slice and add a pale slice of cheese, pressing and adjusting the layers. They then lift the topped slice and move the plain bread underneath it, stack the two slices together, and reposition the bread on the plate with the lettuce and cheese still exposed on top.

A person moves the two bread slices from above the bowl onto the patterned plate and lays them side by side. They place a lettuce leaf on the right slice, then briefly straighten the three colored letters in front of the plate. They add tomato rounds from the bowl onto the lettuce and adjust the topping with both hands, leaving the left bread slice uncovered.

A person arranges slices of white bread on a plain plate beside a colorful plate of sandwich fillings. They transfer a pale cheese slice onto the bread, add green lettuce leaves, and place a square pink slice of deli meat on top. They adjust the layers with both hands, leaving the layered bread on the plain plate and the colorful plate empty.

The person places slices of bread side by side on the plate. They transfer the pink sliced filling from the cutting board onto one piece, then add a thin pale slice and adjust the layers with their fingers. They lift the topped piece onto the other bread slice, reposition the stack, and leave it on the plate with the pink topping still visible.

A clear blue-capped bottle is dropped onto a wooden table and settles on its side, followed by a yellow packet. A hand adds a long black-bristled brush at the front and a pale-bristled brush behind the bottle. A blue face mask is then dropped near the front edge, and a green pen lands across the tray of small pale pieces.

A hand lays a blue-capped plastic bottle on its side and pushes it across the wooden tabletop toward the shallow gray bowl. The bottle is brought back toward the near edge and rolled again several times. The hand alternates between catching it and releasing it, while the mug and narrow red bottle stay in place.

A person holds a clear blue-capped bottle by its neck and sets it upright near the back of a wooden table. A person taps their fingers on the wooden table beside a small sheet of paper. Holding the paper with one hand, they repeatedly raise and lower a pencil, tapping its eraser end against the table. A person picks up a pen and makes short writing movements on a sheet of white paper while steadying the page with their other hand. After putting the pen down, they take large colored letter pieces one at a time and arrange them along the paper's right edge. They adjust the last piece and withdraw their hands, leaving the letters beside the page.

A person places a tall cartoon-patterned cup on a gray table and adds a white cup with a green leafy design beside it. They adjust the white cup so the pair stands close together, then set a clear handled mug in front on the right. A cream-colored cup with a yellow face design is placed upside down at the front of the group.

A person sets a tall patterned cup with a yellow rim on the gray table, then adds a white cup with green leaves beside it. A clear glass is placed in front of the yellow-rimmed cup. The final cup, decorated with small stars, is set upside down to the right of the glass, forming a second row.

A person places a white mug on the black counter and adds a clear glass mug to its left. They set another white mug upside down in front of them, then bring in a tall drinking glass and place it nearer the front edge. Finally, they add a smaller clear handled cup at the back left of the group.

A seated person brings the orange cup to the front of the table, then places the blue-lined white cup upside down behind it. They add the white mug with lettering upright and move the purple mug behind that, upside down. Finally, they lift the wide yellow-patterned mug and hold it above the table while reaching toward the camera with their other hand.

A person moves an upright yellow cup forward from a group of drinkware, then brings a blue patterned mug closer beside it. They add another upright yellow cup in front of the mug. Finally, they lift a third yellow cup, turn it upside down, and set it at the front of the group, leaving a patterned paper cup farther back.

A seated person steadies clear plastic bowls lying on their sides near the back of a white table. Their other hand repeatedly reaches toward a small orange ball among the bowls and nudges it through short movements. The bowls remain clustered together while a tall container stays balanced on an inverted mug to the left.

A seated person brings a shallow rectangular dish onto the dark round table and sets it on the right. They reach off to the left for a translucent plastic bowl and place it beside the dish. They add a round metal bowl farther left and adjust it slightly, leaving all three containers open and arranged side by side.

A seated person rolls a large orange ball forward across a blue-covered table, catches it with one hand, and returns it toward the back. They repeat the motion, letting the ball approach the book at the front left before pulling it back and rolling it again. The green decorative bottle, small toy, and gold figurine stay in place.

A person places an orange near the back of a round red table, then sets a clear drinking glass to its right. They add a small white bowl in front of the orange and stand a tall pink bottle beside the glass. Finally, they place a small labeled bottle behind the bowl, leaving the objects spaced across the tabletop.

A seated person brings the orange cup to the front of the table, then places the blue-lined white cup upside down behind it. They add the white mug with lettering upright and move the purple mug behind that, upside down. Finally, they lift the wide yellow-patterned mug and hold it above the table while reaching toward the camera with their other hand.

The person places an orange on the flat black case lying across the wooden board. They lift one edge of the case so the orange rolls forward onto the counter, then replace the fruit and repeat the tilt. After the second roll, they pick up the orange near the camera and take it out of view.

A person picks up a banana from the back of a white table, holds it toward the camera and sets it nearer the front. They repeat the display with an orange and a green apple, placing both below the banana. Lastly, they show a red-skinned sweet potato and lay it to the right of the fruit, leaving a slice of bread on the left.

A person holds a large green plastic bag open and takes out a small red and yellow fruit, placing it on the glass table beside a pink cup. Two more small fruits are removed and added one at a time to form a row. The person then bunches the bag into a compact ball and holds it close to the camera.

A person places a yellow-green fruit on the dark table in front of the bowl of shells. They lower a flat gray panel upright between the fruit and the camera, briefly hiding it. The panel moves across to the right and is lifted away, revealing the fruit still on the tabletop beside the remote and clear bottle.

A person holds a red and yellow apple close to the camera, turns it slightly, and takes it away. They display a red tomato next, followed by a large red and yellow mango. Finally, they lift a long pale squash with green stripes, turn it horizontally between both hands, and lower it back toward the right side of the counter.

A person sets a small faceted glass upright near the middle of a wooden coffee table. A plain cylindrical glass is placed upright to its left, and a broader glass is added upside down on the right. The row remains in front of an inverted white bowl with a remote balanced across its base.

A person places a small stemmed glass upside down on the right side of a dark table, beside a turquoise bowl. They add a second stemmed glass upright just in front of it. Finally, they turn a larger wineglass mouth-down and lower it at the front right, adjusting it until its rim rests flat on the table before withdrawing their hand.

A hand brings a green patterned glass over the white table and sets it upright near the middle. The person adds a small clear glass beside it, then places a larger square clear glass farther to the left. They withdraw their hand, leaving the small glass between the two larger ones, with the folded socks and card still nearby.

A person sets a tall patterned cup with a yellow rim on the gray table, then adds a white cup with green leaves beside it. A clear glass is placed in front of the yellow-rimmed cup. The final cup, decorated with small stars, is set upside down to the right of the glass, forming a second row.

A person takes a gray mug from the far end of a coffee table, turns it upside down and places it near the front. The purple mug and then the blue mug are also inverted and added behind it to form a line. They lift the remaining tall red mug and hold it above the table, while the glass with tangled wire stays at the left.

The person opens both hands toward the camera, showing a purple cross on one palm. They close their hands into fists and lower their arms beside their body. After bringing both fists forward again, they spread their fingers and hold their palms together, with the same cross still visible.

A person opens both hands close to the camera, showing a blue cross on one palm and no mark on the other. They close their hands into fists, move their forearms across one another, and return their hands side by side. They open both palms again and hold them toward the camera, with the cross still visible on the same hand.

A person holds both hands in fists near the camera, then opens them with the palms facing upward and fingers spread. They close the hands again, cross their wrists, and move the fists past one another. The hands separate and reopen to show both empty palms before closing and crossing again above the table.

A person opens both hands toward the camera, displaying a large dark X across one palm. They close their hands, lower the fists, and move them together in front of their body before opening one hand and then the other. Both palms face forward again, with the large X and a smaller reddish mark on the opposite palm visible, before the hands close and lower.

A person opens both palms above a wood-patterned table, showing a small blue cross on one palm and an unmarked other hand. They close their fists, cross their forearms and reopen both hands with the cross still on the same palm. After another sweeping hand movement, they display the palms once more and then withdraw their arms from the table.

A person unscrews the yellow-topped lid from a translucent bottle and sets it beside the bottle. They also remove the white cap from a smaller labeled container. Leaving both containers open, they pick up a roll of clear tape, turn it in their hands and move it around on the tabletop with their fingertips.

A person removes the red cap from a small white bottle and sets it beside the bottle, then takes the green lid off a large tub. They unscrew a silver cap from the small clear shaker and a dark cap from the tall clear bottle, placing both on the table. Finally, they briefly move the computer mouse at the right and lift their hand away.

A person places a silver-colored cap on the clear plastic bottle at the right of a small table, then screws a blue cap onto the glass bottle with a turquoise sleeve. They fit a rounded translucent cover over the tall frosted bottle near the front. Finally they steady the opaque white bottle at the left and work another cap onto its opening.

The person fits a rounded white cover onto the tall translucent bottle and screws the blue cap onto the clear plastic bottle behind it. They next pick up the black lid with a metal clip and fasten it to the white bottle. Finally, they twist the silver cap onto the glass bottle with the blue sleeve and lift their hands away.

A person fits the small cap onto the tall green bottle and twists it while holding the bottle steady. They pick up the gold-colored lid and close the jar containing red material. Next, they cover the front jar of yellow liquid with the wider pale lid, leaving the containers capped in a line along the table.

The person opens the pale yellow bag beside the laptop and removes a clear spray bottle, setting it upright on the glass table. They take out a white charger with its cable, a black wallet and a yellow-covered notebook, laying them in front of the bag. After removing these objects, they gather the bag in both hands and compress it into a small bundle.

A seated person raises the front of a gray bag and places a closed silver laptop in its open compartment. They lift a folded striped cloth and then a blue box behind the raised panel, moving each out of sight. They lower the panel and pull the zipper around the bag's edge, leaving the closed bag beside a potted plant.

A person opens a pale fabric tote on a glass table beside a laptop. They take out a clear spray bottle, a coiled white cable, and a black wallet, setting them along the front of the table. After reaching into the bag again, they lift it by its upper edges and hold its printed side facing outward.

A person holds a black backpack open and lowers purple fabric out of view behind its front edge. They move several small stationery items from beside a closed laptop toward the opening, with a blue glue stick and writing tools becoming visible inside. They lift the laptop toward the bag, then lay the backpack flat and handle its zipper.

A person holds a folded banknote above an open black wallet beside the laptop and tucks it into the wallet. They fold the wallet closed, lift it from the desk, and bring it toward the upright black shoulder bag. They lower the wallet into the open compartment at the top and press it down with their fingers, leaving the bag open.

The person releases a blue toy car onto the cardboard ramp propped against the stack of books. They retrieve it and return it to the raised end for repeated runs down the slope. After the car reaches the table in front of the ramp, they pick it up and hold it between both hands beside the ramp.

A person pushes a blue-wheeled toy car up a clear plastic ramp on a yellow table and brings it back to the front. They repeat the movement on the neighboring ramp, then leave the car below the gap between the two. Finally, they straighten the red book on the left, while the apple and small pieces at the tops of the ramps remain in place.

A person places a small yellow toy car at the raised left end of a sloping puzzle book and releases it to roll toward the lower right end. They retrieve the car and repeat the release twice more. The upright novel, inverted stemmed glass, large clear cup and sideways water bottle remain arranged around the book ramp.

A person pulls a small blue toy car backward across a patterned tablecloth, then releases it to travel toward the large book at the right. They repeat the backward pull and release twice more, returning the car to the same area beside the book after each run. The blue mug, knife and small white item stay along the back of the table.

A person props a red hardcover book at an angle against a stack of books, making a slope behind an upright blue box. They place a red toy car at the raised end and release it down the cover, where it passes behind the box and appears near the front left edge. They retrieve the car and repeat the release from the top of the slope.

The person lifts a pair of blue jeans and folds them into a compact stack on the wooden table. They place a brightly patterned slip-on shoe on top, then add its matching shoe beside it. Holding both shoes by their openings, they briefly lift them together and set them back onto the folded jeans.

A seated person stretches a pair of blue jeans lengthwise across the white table, folds the legs inward, and brings the waistband over to make a compact rectangle. They place a fork to the left, then set two black shoes side by side on top of the folded jeans. A paperback is added on the far left beside the fork.

A person lowers blue jeans onto the glass table and leaves them spread out. They hold a dark garment above the jeans, fold it, and place it on the right leg. A pair of red and black high top trainers is then set over the folded clothing, followed by a banana placed on the jeans to the shoes' left.

The person stretches the gray trousers along the table and folds them into a shorter rectangle. They set a pair of white sneakers side by side on the folded trousers. Next, they hold a dark striped garment across the shoes, fold it inward, and leave it resting on top of the pair.

A hand sets a pair of white sneakers with blue and red stripes side by side on the round table. The person then brings in folded black jeans and lays them over the shoes, hiding them. Finally, they show a bunched white undergarment and place it on top of the jeans.

A person lifts the inverted white-and-gold cups one at a time, showing a red-and-white ball beneath the cup farther from the camera. They cover it and slide the cups around each other on the black counter. After the shuffle, the back cup reveals an empty space and the front cup reveals the ball; they lower both cups again.

A person lifts three inverted white cups in turn, revealing a small pale blue ball beneath the middle cup and empty spaces under the outer cups, then covers them again. They slide and exchange the cups with both hands before returning them to a row. They lift each cup again, showing the ball under the middle one, and finish with all three inverted.

A woman lifts the left of two inverted blue cups to show an empty spot, then raises the right cup to reveal a small white ball. After covering the ball, she slides the cups around with both hands. The left cup is lifted to expose the ball in its new position and lowered again; a final lift of the right cup shows it is empty before both cups return to the counter.

A person lifts three upside-down white cups one at a time, showing a small dark object beneath the cup on the right. They put the cups down and slide them around with both hands. After rearranging them, they lift the cups again, revealing the object under the middle cup before returning all three to an inverted row.

A hand lifts and replaces three inverted black cups one at a time, revealing a small green marble under the rightmost cup. The person slides the cups into different positions across the glass table. They lift each cup again, this time exposing the marble beneath the middle one, and finish with all three cups upside down in a row.

A person taps their fingers on the wooden table beside a small sheet of paper. Holding the paper with one hand, they repeatedly raise and lower a pencil, tapping its eraser end against the table. They put the pencil down, lift and fold the paper into a smaller rectangle, then leave it standing beside the pencil.

A hand holds up a dark pencil and places it horizontally on the wooden table, with its point facing right. A second pencil is shown and laid alongside the first. The person then displays a silver table knife and places it in front of the pencils, also pointing to the right.

A red pencil rests near the raised right edge of a gray cutting board propped on books. A person releases it to roll down toward the left edge, retrieves it, and returns it to the top. They repeat the release twice more, with the pencil rolling across the scratched board while headphones and an electric toothbrush remain behind it.

A person brings their palms together once, lowers their hands, and picks up a long black pen from a blue cloth-covered table. Holding it near one end, they repeatedly move their wrist up and down so the pen swings rapidly between upright and downward positions. They continue the motion at different heights, then lower the pen and leave it lying diagonally on the cloth.

A seated person raises both hands above a white table, brings their palms together, and separates them. They repeat the movement, briefly curling their fingers between the open-handed motions. The hands come together once more and then lower apart, while a silver pen, round tin, and long white strip remain undisturbed on the tabletop.

A person lifts a black frying pan to show its inside, then returns it to the counter. They pick up and display a remote control, a small gray rectangular device and a floral mug in turn, putting each down again. Next, they lift and spread out the colorful cloth, then reposition the fork and red-handled knife beside it.

A person shows a white mug with brown stripes and sets it on the counter, then presents and lays down a remote control, a black-handled fork and a round fluted metal cutter. They next lift a cream cable-knit hat with fluffy pom-poms and place it to the left of the other objects. They lift and reposition the hat once more before leaving it there.

A person sets a small plate on the table and places a patterned white mug upright on it. They show a dark frying pan and lay it behind the mug, with the handle extending to the right. A remote control is added nearby, followed by a bundle of red checked fabric placed behind the cup.

A person brings a black remote control to a wooden table, shows its buttons, and sets it beside a small lidded glass jar. They then hold out an empty white ribbed bowl and place it farther to the right. Finally, they display a black sock and lay it on the right side of the bowl, leaving the items spread across the table.

A person displays objects from a row on a kitchen counter. They lift a large bottle containing pale liquid, return it, and do the same with a clear green-labeled bottle. Next, they raise an onion, a smaller orange-capped bottle, and a large red-capped bottle with dark liquid at the bottom, setting each back upright after showing it.

The person brings the lower edges of their open denim shirt together and fastens a button near the hem. They continue buttoning upward, using both hands to join the front panels over the dark red top underneath. After fastening the buttons near the collar, they lower their hands with the shirt closed down the front.

A person brings the two sides of an open, pale checked shirt together near the neck and starts fastening the buttons. Their hands work steadily down the front, pinching each section of fabric together before moving lower. By the end, the front is closed and they are still adjusting the lowest part near the hem.

A person wearing an open blue-and-white shirt brings its lower front edges together and fastens the bottom buttons. They work upward with both hands, closing the shirt across the waist and chest. After fastening the upper buttons near the collar, they lower their hands, leaving the shirt front closed over the black top underneath.

A seated person pulls the upper edges of a gray shirt together over a beige T shirt and fastens the button near the collar. They continue down the front, using both hands to guide each button through its hole and straighten the fabric. After fastening the lower buttons, they smooth the front and lower their hands with the shirt closed across their torso.

A seated person brings together the lower edges of an open gray shirt and fastens a button near the hem. They work upward with both hands, closing successive buttons across the stomach and chest until only the collar area remains open. After fastening the top button, they release the shirt and lower their hands to their lap.

A person sets a blue toy car on the wooden table and pulls it to the right using the white string attached to its front. They lift the car, slide a white cutting board into the middle of the table and place the car on it. Pulling the string again brings the car across the board and onto the table at the right.

A person takes hold of the string attached to a yellow toy car and pulls it across the bare tabletop from left to right. They pick the car up and place it on the stacked wooden boards. Holding the string again, they draw the car across the top board toward its right edge, then lower the string and leave the car there.

A person repositions a white cutting board on a worn green table and puts a bright green toy car near its left end. They lift that end so the car rolls down and off onto the table at the right. They push the car back across the board, adjust the board again and repeat the tilted-board run, leaving the car near the right edge.

A person pulls a small blue toy car backward across a patterned tablecloth, then releases it to travel toward the large book at the right. They repeat the backward pull and release twice more, returning the car to the same area beside the book after each run. The blue mug, knife and small white item stay along the back of the table.

The person sets a small toy car at the back of the gridded board and pulls the thin string attached to it, drawing the car toward the front edge. They then lift the car and place it at the back of the orange notebook. Pulling the string again moves the car forward across the notebook cover.

Seated behind a low table, a person claps their hands repeatedly, changing the angle of their palms as they meet. They pause with both hands lowered near the tabletop and then resume clapping before lowering them again. Blue scissors and a long blue pen resting diagonally on a small upright box remain undisturbed in front of them.

A seated person raises their hands from the wooden table and repeatedly claps, bringing the palms together and separating them in front of their chest. They pause with the hands pressed together between movements, then resume several more times. At the end, both hands lower toward the tabletop beside the stationary plants and ornaments.

A seated person holds both hands open above the patterned tablecloth, brings the palms together, and separates them. They repeatedly clap, pausing at times with their fingers curled into fists before opening their hands again. The silver cylindrical tin and orange remain together on the pink cloth at the left throughout the hand movements.

A seated person raises both hands above a pale tablecloth and repeatedly brings their palms together over the middle of the table. Between claps, they spread their arms outward and turn their open palms toward the camera. They finish by lowering both hands near the back edge, while the capped bottle at the left and clear jars at the right remain still.

A seated person raises both hands above a white table, brings their palms together, and separates them. They repeat the movement, briefly curling their fingers between the open-handed motions. The hands come together once more and then lower apart, while a silver pen, round tin, and long white strip remain undisturbed on the tabletop.

The person screws the small silver lid onto the short glass jar. They then drop the small gold cap into the wide jar at the front and fit the red lid onto the taller jar beside the game controller. Finally, they place the large silver lid across the mouth of the black bottle, leaving the wide jar open with the small cap inside.

A person screws a small silver lid onto the round decorated jar. They pick up the gold cap and drop it into the larger open glass jar, then fasten the red lid onto the tall narrow jar. Finally, they balance the wide gray lid across the mouth of the black bottle, where it rests at an angle.

A person screws the light blue cap onto the clear plastic bottle, then places the small dark blue cap on the little white container beside it. They pick up the cream-colored lid and lower it into the wide jar with the green rim, pressing it inside the opening. Finally, they fit the broad green lid onto the clear glass jar at the front and withdraw their hands.

A person places the gold cap on the tall dark bottle and twists it closed. They then fit the printed lid onto the jar containing red food and turn it while holding the jar steady. Finally, they screw the remaining metal lid onto the jar of yellow liquid, leaving all three containers closed in a row.

The person places the large white cover across the mouth of the brown bottle, where it overhangs the sides. They then screw a metal lid onto the jar containing yellow liquid. Next, they pick up the small metal cap and lower it into the open jar with reddish contents, leaving that jar uncovered and its larger lid on the table.

A person spreads out a yellow T-shirt, folds it into a compact rectangle and places it beside the tall yellow cup. They fold the white sheet of paper and lay it on top of the shirt. Next, they lift the blue patterned fabric, fold it and add it to the stack, pressing the pile flat with both hands.

A person lifts a gray garment from a pile on a covered table, folds it, and places it near the back. They fold a white garment over it, smoothing the new stack with both hands. Next, they pick up a dark striped shirt, fold it, and add it on top, while a blue garment remains spread separately at the front.

A person lifts a dark teal garment from a pile on a checked table, folds it, and places it to the left. They fold an orange shirt and add it on top, followed by a red shirt. They then lift the remaining dark patterned sweater, fold it into a compact rectangle, and lay it on the stack, clearing the right side of the table.

A person sorts a pile on a wooden table, gathering a white garment and then folding a striped towel over it on the right. They fold a gray item and add it to the stack. Next, they crease a sheet of white paper and stand it on top before gathering the last white cloth and placing it with the folded items.

A person moves the dark floral garment aside and folds the plain black clothing into a compact shape on the counter. They fold the yellow garment and place it on the black layer. Next, they gather the pale striped garment, lay it on top, and press the pile with both hands, leaving the floral item spread out to the right.

After moving the red bowl of greens aside, a person tips the shredded dark red vegetables from the orange plate into the large turquoise bowl. They add purple cabbage from the white bowl and shredded carrot from the orange bowl. Next, they tilt the green bottle over the vegetables and shake the white seasoning container above them, then mix everything with a spoon.

A person tears lettuce onto a square plate and adds pieces of orange pepper from a smaller plate. They lift corn from a glass with a fork and add it to the lettuce, then tip a capped green bottle over the plate before standing it back up. After sprinkling white granules from a bowl with their fingers, they mix the vegetables with the fork and return it to the smaller plate.

After rearranging the pink letter cutouts, the person cuts a pale leafy vegetable into small pieces on a plate. They tip chopped orange vegetables from the other plate onto the leaves and set the empty plate aside. They make pinching motions over the food and tilt the dark bottle above it. Finally, they return the bottle upright and use a fork to mix the vegetables together.

A person takes lettuce from the plate, tears the leaves apart with both hands, and drops the pieces into the patterned bowl. They add tomato slices and then cucumber rounds from the plate, arranging them over the lettuce while some slices remain behind. Finally, they lift and move the small translucent container at the back of the counter.

A person places lettuce leaves on a blue-and-white patterned plate and adds small red-skinned apple pieces near the upper edge. They tip a bottle of yellow oil over the lettuce, then shake white granules from a spoon onto the leaves. Using the spoon, they lift and turn the lettuce, shifting the leaves around the plate with the apple pieces beside them.

A person lifts the large mottled yellow fruit from the table, holding it horizontally with a white cloth beneath it before carrying it out of view. They next pick up the dark round fruit, turn it in their hands and remove it as well. Finally, they display the carrot across one palm and take it away, leaving the tall lidded glass at the left.

A hand presents a yellow lemon over a pale patterned tablecloth, then takes it out of view. The person repeats the display with a red apple and then a long dark green cucumber, removing each afterward. A green cloth and two filled jars remain at the back of the table throughout.

A person lifts the large green-labeled bottle from the right side of the table, holds it upright, and returns it to the same spot. They next lift the tall bottle containing yellow liquid and set it down again. Finally, they show the small carrot in an open palm before replacing it beside the plate.

A hand holds up a green star fruit and sets it on the round wooden table. Next, the person shows a small banana and places it beside the fruit. They finish by presenting a red onion and setting it on the other side of the banana, leaving the tall brown bottle standing behind the arrangement.

A person holds a yellow lemon in one hand, turns it to show different sides, and brings it close to the camera before setting it on the counter. They repeat the presentation with a green apple and place it to the lemon’s left. Finally, they hold a carrot horizontally across their palm and lay it along the front edge, in front of the two fruits.

The person lays a small white paper triangle on the dark counter and presses it flat with their fingertips. They place a larger triangle immediately to its right, aligning the lower edges. Finally, they add a small white square to the right of the larger triangle and withdraw their hand, leaving the shapes beside the mug.

The person places a small green paper triangle beside the jar and adds a larger green triangle to its left. They press the larger piece against the table, then hold up a small white square and place it to the left of both green pieces. Their fingertips press down on the white paper before lifting away.

A woman places a small yellow triangle on the right side of the wooden table and adjusts its position with her fingertips. She adds a small red rectangle to its left, then brings in a larger yellow triangle and lays it farther left. After a final adjustment, the three shapes remain in a row beside the calculator and marker.

A person places a white mug on the black counter and adds a clear glass mug to its left. They set another white mug upside down in front of them, then bring in a tall drinking glass and place it nearer the front edge. Finally, they add a smaller clear handled cup at the back left of the group.

A seated person holds up a small blue rectangular paper piece and lays it near the left side of a black tray table. They display a small orange triangle and place it to the rectangle's right. A larger orange triangle is brought closer to the camera and then added farther right, leaving three colored shapes arranged across the tabletop.

The person places the large white cover across the mouth of the brown bottle, where it overhangs the sides. They then screw a metal lid onto the jar containing yellow liquid. Next, they pick up the small metal cap and lower it into the open jar with reddish contents, leaving that jar uncovered and its larger lid on the table.

A person screws the light blue cap onto the clear plastic bottle, then places the small dark blue cap on the little white container beside it. They pick up the cream-colored lid and lower it into the wide jar with the green rim, pressing it inside the opening. Finally, they fit the broad green lid onto the clear glass jar at the front and withdraw their hands.

A person fits the small cap onto the tall green bottle and twists it while holding the bottle steady. They pick up the gold-colored lid and close the jar containing red material. Next, they cover the front jar of yellow liquid with the wider pale lid, leaving the containers capped in a line along the table.

A person picks up a round lid and fits it onto a small white jar on the table. They then reach between the two bottles and handle the opening of the large clear plastic bottle, which remains open. Finally, they lift the broad white cap from the table and balance it across the mouth of the smaller glass bottle.

A person places the gold cap on the tall dark bottle and twists it closed. They then fit the printed lid onto the jar containing red food and turn it while holding the jar steady. Finally, they screw the remaining metal lid onto the jar of yellow liquid, leaving all three containers closed in a row.

The person handles the striped container beside the clear mug and leaves a red spoon standing inside the mug. They pour water from the white kettle into it, then stir the dark liquid with the spoon. After reaching into the open box of white cubes, they bring their hand above the mug. They finish by sliding the small letter pieces around on the table beside the handle.

A person lowers a small spoon into a white cup, then lifts and tilts the metal kettle above it before returning the kettle to the table. They stir the cup and rearrange the colored plastic letters in front of it. After dipping the spoon into the small metal cup, they return to stirring the white cup while steadying the metal one with the other hand.

A person takes a tea bag from a red box and lowers it into a white mug. They pour from the black kettle while moving a slice of bread away with their free hand, then set the kettle back down. Next, they dip a spoon into the clear container behind the mug, bring it over the drink, and stir while holding the mug’s handle.

The person fills an open cardboard box, first lowering a clear container and then the patterned mug into it. They move the books from the tabletop into the box in small stacks and add the black stapler. Next, they lift the tall glass carafe and place it upright inside. They fold the lid downward, but it remains angled above the box when their hands withdraw.

A person opens a tea box, handles a sachet and lowers a tea bag into a white mug. They lift a red insulated jug, tilt it above the mug and return it to the table before stirring with a metal spoon. Finally, they scoop a spoonful of white granules from a large clear jar and leave that spoon standing in the jar.
