They repeat the display with a second dark pen before lifting a metal spoon and holding it across their hands in the same way. The spoon is returned beside the pens, while another utensil stays resting across the red container at the left.

A person displays a black-capped marker in one hand and lays it near the back of a checked table. They show a metal spoon next, then slide it into place to the left of a black case. Finally, they present another dark pen and put it near the front, below the spoon.

A hand picks up the black-and-white pen and displays it across an open palm before returning it to the counter. The cream-handled knife is lifted and shown next, followed by the clear-bodied pen. Finally, the blue pencil is held up in the same way and set back beside the other objects.

The person takes a white egg from its carton, holds it above a shallow patterned bowl, and sets it down beside the bowl. They reach toward the open white container and make a pinching gesture over the bowl. Finally, they move a red-handled fork around inside the visibly empty bowl and return it to the mat beside the egg.

The person takes a brown egg from the carton, moves it over the white bowl, and places it inside with the shell intact. They make a pinching gesture above the open jar and then over the bowl. Next, they pick up the fork, move it inside the bowl beside the whole egg, and lift it out again.

A person opens an egg carton, takes out an egg, and closes the lid. They bring the egg to the rim of a patterned bowl and hold it above the bowl with both hands, then set it down whole beside the onion. After moving a hand from the small blue dish over the bowl, they lift the bowl and move a fork inside it. No egg contents are visible in the bowl.

A person cracks an egg over a white bowl and sets the shell pieces beside it. They rub and clap their hands together above the table, then take a pinch from the small glass and sprinkle it over the egg. They pick up the fork, stir the contents of the bowl, and leave the fork resting inside.

A person opens a small egg carton and lifts a white egg from it. They hold the intact egg above a translucent bowl, then set it whole on the tabletop beside the bowl. They shake a pale seasoning container over the bowl and move a fork inside it, while an orange remains balanced on a decorated cup at the right.

A person lays a brown strappy garment across the green-covered table and moves the large hairbrush and black package toward the sides. They bring in a white garment, fold it over, and set it on top of the brown fabric. Finally, they place a yellow illustrated book on the clothing, beside the standing pink bottle.

A person slides a blue-and-white paperback forward on a dark patterned tablecloth. They lift a folded orange towel and set it on the book, then pick up a second, white-covered book from the left and lay it across the towel. They straighten the three layers into a small stack beside a white wristwatch.

The person holds a small red hair dryer in one hand while moving the books beside the power strip with the other. They place the blue spiral notebook near the center of the table, add the brown book, and put the larger dark binder on top, exposing a gray cloth beneath the original stack. They then return both hands to the dryer and adjust their grip.

A person lays long gray trousers across a round red table and smooths them with both hands. They place a small blue spiral notebook with a yellow star on top, then drop a pale shirt over the notebook and trousers. Finally, they set a small clear bottle with a blue cap on its side on the shirt, leaving the yellow cylindrical container at the left.

A person lays a dark garment across the back of a white table. They bring in a patterned blue and black bag, stand it on the garment, and leave its straps draped forward. They then place a thick paperback leaning against the bag, while a wooden handled knife remains across a blue smartphone near the front edge.

A person folds a black garment and smooths it into a flat pile on the left side of the table. They lift the blue garment from the remaining clothes, fold it, and add it to the pile. Next, they fold the mustard-yellow garment over the blue one and finish by placing a small folded gray item on top.

A person folds a dark gray garment at the back of a wooden table and lays it flat near the front left. They fold a beige garment and place it over the first, then add a folded dark shirt with a white graphic on top. They pat the finished stack beside a green glass bowl resting on a book.

A person moves the dark floral garment aside and folds the plain black clothing into a compact shape on the counter. They fold the yellow garment and place it on the black layer. Next, they gather the pale striped garment, lay it on top, and press the pile with both hands, leaving the floral item spread out to the right.

The person lifts a dark garment from the pile on the left and folds it onto the right side of the table. They add the beige knitted garment, the pink garment, and another dark item in turn, lifting and folding each onto the growing stack. Finally, they fold the checked scarf into a compact rectangle and place it on top.

A person takes the light gray garment from the top of a clothing pile, folds it, and sets it at the front of the table. They fold the white garment with orange and dark stripes and stack it on the gray one, then add folded camouflage clothing on top. Dark gray clothes remain at the back, with the pomegranate, book, and yellow boxes undisturbed on the right.

A person reaches beside the red desk lamp and switches it on, lighting the plant and books on the glass table. They lift a book, open it briefly, and close it before returning it to the stack. After switching the lamp off again, they gather the colored markers into their hands and lower them back beside the books.

A person touches the desk lamp’s base, turning on the light, then opens the illustrated book to a detailed line drawing. They close the book and touch the base again until the light switches off. They pick up the small crayon packet, turn it between their hands and set it on top of the closed book.

The person opens a book on the blue storage-box lid and moves a glass of clear liquid onto its pages. They plug the white desk lamp into the wall socket, then adjust the open book beneath the glass. Finally, they press the switch on the lamp cord, and a bright patch of light appears across the pages.

A person operates the black switch beside a desk lamp, turning the lamp on brightly above a striped mug and open papers. They turn a page beneath the light and briefly move their hands over the desk. After pressing the switch again, the lamp goes dark; they turn another page and lower their hands beside the stack of books.

A person opens the paperback on the bedside table, briefly spreads its pages, and closes it again. They slide the book back toward the wall and move the pink pen alongside its right edge. They then adjust the knife near the front of the table so its blade points toward the red lamp base; the lamp stays lit beside the glass and metal pan.

A person moves a blue pen around on the table beside a loose light bulb and its cord. They plug the cord into the wall socket, remove it again, and turn the bulb in its holder while steadying the holder with the other hand. After setting the bulb down, they reconnect the plug, and the bulb lights up.

A person rests a hand on an open book beside a lit desk lamp, then reaches down and pulls the lamp's plug from the wall socket. The bulb goes dark, and the loose plug is laid on the table. The person repeatedly presses the lamp's base while keeping the other hand on the book, then begins turning a page.

A person opens a pink notebook and holds its lined pages beside a tall red lamp. With the notebook still in hand, they pick up the loose black plug and insert it into the wall socket. They handle the pages again, close the notebook on the desk, and press the inline cord switch, causing the lamp to glow brightly through its red shade.

The person opens a book on the blue storage-box lid and moves a glass of clear liquid onto its pages. They plug the white desk lamp into the wall socket, then adjust the open book beneath the glass. Finally, they press the switch on the lamp cord, and a bright patch of light appears across the pages.

A person touches the desk lamp’s base, turning on the light, then opens the illustrated book to a detailed line drawing. They close the book and touch the base again until the light switches off. They pick up the small crayon packet, turn it between their hands and set it on top of the closed book.

A person stands a floral shopping bag against the wooden door and moves the door back and forth. After the bag falls flat on the floor, a wooden chair is brought into the doorway, with its legs beside the bag. The door moves again behind the chair, and the person finishes by laying a folded newspaper across the fallen bag.

A person puts a pink pouch on the floor beside the open door, drops a book next to it, and stands a clear bottle nearby. They carry in a wooden chair and set it in the doorway. As the door swings inward across the objects, the bottle falls and rolls to the left, while the book and pouch end up beside the chair and the door remains partly open.

A person walks to an open doorway and places a white plastic bag and a small crumpled brown object on the tiled floor. They carry a wooden chair into the doorway and set it beside the objects, then pull the door toward them by its handle. The door comes partway across the opening beside the chair, and the person walks away to the left.

A person shakes out a white shopping bag near an open door, dropping a small pale item onto the wooden floor before putting the bag down beside it. They set a large capped water bottle upright next to the bag. The door then swings across the objects and back, leaving the bag flattened and the bottle still standing near the threshold.

A person bends down at an open doorway and places a small white plastic bag and a brown ball on the tiled floor. They bring a wooden chair over and set it beside the doorway, then step to the wall and swing the door toward the objects. As the door closes, the bag and ball shift behind the chair and door, disappearing from the open floor space.

A person folds the sleeves and body of a navy shirt into a rectangle and moves it to the left side of the table. They fold the gray shirt underneath in the same area and stack it over the navy one, then fold the green shorts and add them on top. Finally, they fold a white sheet of paper beside the clothes and press the crease flat.

A person lifts a navy garment with red and white stripes, folds it, and sets it at the back of the table. They hold up a white graphic T-shirt, fold it, and lay it on top. A navy-and-white garment is unfolded next and folded over the pile, leaving its dark side on top beside the bottle, orange, and green scissors.

A person lifts a dark teal garment from a pile on a checked table, folds it, and places it to the left. They fold an orange shirt and add it on top, followed by a red shirt. They then lift the remaining dark patterned sweater, fold it into a compact rectangle, and lay it on the stack, clearing the right side of the table.

A person folds a dark gray garment at the back of a wooden table and lays it flat near the front left. They fold a beige garment and place it over the first, then add a folded dark shirt with a white graphic on top. They pat the finished stack beside a green glass bowl resting on a book.

A person lifts a gray garment from a pile on a covered table, folds it, and places it near the back. They fold a white garment over it, smoothing the new stack with both hands. Next, they pick up a dark striped shirt, fold it, and add it on top, while a blue garment remains spread separately at the front.

After rearranging the pink letter cutouts, the person cuts a pale leafy vegetable into small pieces on a plate. They tip chopped orange vegetables from the other plate onto the leaves and set the empty plate aside. They make pinching motions over the food and tilt the dark bottle above it. Finally, they return the bottle upright and use a fork to mix the vegetables together.

A person tears lettuce onto a square plate and adds pieces of orange pepper from a smaller plate. They lift corn from a glass with a fork and add it to the lettuce, then tip a capped green bottle over the plate before standing it back up. After sprinkling white granules from a bowl with their fingers, they mix the vegetables with the fork and return it to the smaller plate.

A person takes lettuce from the plate, tears the leaves apart with both hands, and drops the pieces into the patterned bowl. They add tomato slices and then cucumber rounds from the plate, arranging them over the lettuce while some slices remain behind. Finally, they lift and move the small translucent container at the back of the counter.

A person lifts the large green-labeled bottle from the right side of the table, holds it upright, and returns it to the same spot. They next lift the tall bottle containing yellow liquid and set it down again. Finally, they show the small carrot in an open palm before replacing it beside the plate.

A person tears yellow cheese into pieces and lays them over the right-hand slice of bread on a striped plate. They take lettuce from a bowl, spread it over the cheese, and slide the other bread slice underneath, leaving the lettuce exposed on top. Next, they move a bottle of dark liquid to the left of the plate and twist its cap with both hands before withdrawing, with the cap still on.

The person rests one end of the gray rectangular board on the stack of books, making a shallow slope, and moves the small box forward beside it. They place the tennis ball near the raised end and let it roll along the board. They retrieve the ball and repeat the motion, ending with another release near the top of the slope.

A person lays a wooden board across a small box and a stack of books, making a sloping ramp. They pick up a yellow tennis ball and release it onto the board, where it rolls toward the lower left end. They retrieve it beside a roll of tape, put it at the raised end and release it to roll down again.

A seated person releases a yellow tennis ball across a dark tabletop toward a book lying in front of them. They catch or retrieve the ball near the book, move it back to the far side, and roll it forward again. This motion repeats, with one hand resting near the book while the other releases and collects the ball.

A person props one end of a wooden board on a stack of notebooks, making a short slope on the red-covered table. They place a tennis ball at the raised end and release it; the ball rolls down and out of view. They retrieve the ball, reset it on the board, and let it roll off again beside the stationary scissors and spray bottle.

A person releases a small orange ball onto the yellow book propped on stacked red books. It rolls down the ramp toward the large red book standing like a tent. The ball is then visible on the table on the other side of the red book, where the person reaches for it. They retrieve it near the table edge and return it to the yellow ramp.

A person tears a white sheet into smaller pieces and gathers them in a pile on the right side of the table. They pick up the green leaf beside it, pull it apart with both hands, and return the pieces near the toy car. They then pick up more of the white paper and continue tearing it into smaller scraps.

A woman picks up a white sheet and pulls it apart with both hands, tearing off a long strip. She tears the remaining paper into more pieces and leaves them on the table. She then lifts the green lettuce leaf, pulls it into two sections and puts them back down, while the toy dinosaur with a funnel on its head stays at the left.

A person tears a white sheet into two sections and leaves them on the counter beside the large glass. They pick up the small green leaf, pull at it with both hands, and set it down again. Returning to one paper section, they fold and bend it repeatedly, tear off smaller pieces, and drop the scraps beside the remaining strip.

A person pulls a white sheet apart with both hands and leaves the pieces on the counter. They pick up a green lettuce leaf, tear off a smaller piece, and put both pieces down beside the paper. They then tear more white paper into smaller fragments, leaving a loose pile near the larger sheet and the lettuce.

The person lifts the sheet of paper and pulls it apart, leaving a crumpled piece on the table. They then tear the lettuce into smaller sections and set the pieces down at the back of the table. Returning to the paper, they tear it into more pieces and leave a loose pile in front of the lettuce.

A person places a white mug on the black counter and adds a clear glass mug to its left. They set another white mug upside down in front of them, then bring in a tall drinking glass and place it nearer the front edge. Finally, they add a smaller clear handled cup at the back left of the group.

A person moves a black mug from the back of a wooden table to the front left, then places a white mug beside it. They bring the second black mug forward to the white mug's right, forming a row of three upright mugs. They then reach for the blue plastic cup remaining behind the row and begin lifting it by the rim.

A person moves a red and white mug from the back of the table to the front left, leaving it upright. They place a checked mug upside down beside it, then invert a larger red floral mug to extend the row. They finish by lifting the remaining white mug covered in black words and holding it upright to the right of the arranged cups.

A person places a tall cartoon-patterned cup on a gray table and adds a white cup with a green leafy design beside it. They adjust the white cup so the pair stands close together, then set a clear handled mug in front on the right. A cream-colored cup with a yellow face design is placed upside down at the front of the group.

A person moves the burgundy spotted mug forward and leaves it upside down. They bring the wide green patterned cup beside it, then place the dark green mug upside down in front of the remaining cups. After moving the orange-rimmed patterned cup to the front right, they lift the tall pale mug and hold it above the arrangement.

The person takes the white-and-turquoise socks from the clothing pile, folds them, and stacks them near the mug. They spread out the white sleeveless shirt, fold it into a smaller bundle, and place it over the socks. Finally, they fold the dark trousers and add them on top, leaving the rest of the red-covered table clear between the bottle and phone.

A person lifts a dark teal garment from a pile on a checked table, folds it, and places it to the left. They fold an orange shirt and add it on top, followed by a red shirt. They then lift the remaining dark patterned sweater, fold it into a compact rectangle, and lay it on the stack, clearing the right side of the table.

A person moves clothing from the far end of a checkered table into a stack at the front. They fold and lay down a teal printed shirt, add an orange shirt, then place a red shirt over it. A dark knitted garment with a brown pattern is added last, while the kettle, wallet and bottles remain standing on the left.

The person lifts a dark garment from the pile on the left and folds it onto the right side of the table. They add the beige knitted garment, the pink garment, and another dark item in turn, lifting and folding each onto the growing stack. Finally, they fold the checked scarf into a compact rectangle and place it on top.

A person folds a pink knitted garment into a pile on the table, then folds a gray garment and places it over the pink one. They briefly move the green knitwear aside while adding a dark navy garment to the stack. The green garment is folded and placed on top last, building a tall pile in front of the clear pitcher and fuzzy slippers.

A person gathers the books into a stack on a small table, placing the pale book on top of the red one. They move a black-handled utensil up and down against the top cover. Keeping the utensil in one hand, they lift the white and green hair dryer with the other and turn it above the table.

The person holds a small red hair dryer in one hand while moving the books beside the power strip with the other. They place the blue spiral notebook near the center of the table, add the brown book, and put the larger dark binder on top, exposing a gray cloth beneath the original stack. They then return both hands to the dryer and adjust their grip.

A person opens a paperback on a red-covered desk and flips through several pages, leaving it open in front of a laptop. They pass a hand above the pages, turn another page, and reach to the right. They lift a black hair dryer by its handle and hold it horizontally with the nozzle aimed across the open book, making small changes to its height and angle.

A person opens a paperback on the table and points along the printed pages. They reach to the wall-mounted electrical connection, handle it, and return their hand to the book. They then pick up a black hair dryer and hold its nozzle toward the open book; several pages rise and shift while the dryer remains raised beside it.

A seated person picks up a red-and-black hair dryer from the floor and points it toward a nearby stack of notebooks and loose papers. Holding the dryer in one hand, they separate and reposition the papers and books with the other. After gathering them back into a pile, they lower the dryer onto the tiles beside the chair.

A person cracks an egg into a blue bowl and places the shell near the back of the table. They briefly rearrange the colored letters beside the bowl, then shake a small white container over the egg. Holding the bowl steady, they beat the egg with a fork until the yolk and white form a yellow mixture.

A person takes an egg from a tray, cracks it open over a yellow bowl and leaves a shell half on the table. They move a tall brown glass from the left side to the right, then shake a white seasoning container over the bowl. Finally, they stir the bowl's contents with a blue-handled fork and leave the fork resting inside.

A person cracks a brown egg over a white bowl and separates the shell, letting the yolk and white drop into the bowl. They set the shell halves beside a blue cap, pinch some salt from the cap, and sprinkle it over the egg. They then lift the spoon from the bowl's rim and take it away, leaving the raw egg in the bowl.

The person cracks an egg into a small glass bowl, leaving the yolk intact at first. They add white granules from the open jar and shake seasoning from the yellow-lidded container over the egg. Finally, they hold the bowl and stir with a plastic knife, breaking up the yolk and combining it with the white.

A person cracks a white egg into a yellow bowl and leaves the broken shell on the counter. They shake a small white container over the bowl and return it upright, then handle the top of a milk carton and set it beside the shell. They pick up a metal utensil and stir the contents of the bowl before lifting their hands away.

The person lays a white paperback horizontally across the top of an upright black bottle, keeping one hand against the bottle as they position it. After letting the book rest there, they bring a rounded black object over it. They place the object on the book and lift their upper hand away while the stack remains upright.

A hand stands a tall white bottle in the middle of the covered table. The person lays a thin black-covered book horizontally across its top and lets go, leaving it balanced. They then place a potato near the book's left end; the book tilts slightly but stays on the bottle with the potato on top.

The person moves the two small books to the left and rests one end of the thick white book on them to make a slope. They shift the coffee tin to the right of the raised book. Holding a small cork with a dark base, they release it near the raised end, retrieve it near the lower end, and repeat the movement.

A seated person shifts a thick dark book forward on a patterned surface, then lifts a second illustrated book and holds it above the table. With their free hand, they place a loose white sheet across the dark book and smooth it flat. They lower the illustrated book onto the paper, forming a stack with the white sheet between the two books.

A person lays a brown spiral notebook at an angle across the small book stack, then stands a thick dark hardback upright to its right. They bring a clear blue-capped bottle onto the notebook and release it on its side. The bottle rolls off toward the open tabletop, and the person retrieves it and repeats the roll before bringing it back to the notebook.

The person lifts the top of a dark backpack lying on the table and slides a blue book into the open compartment. They add a thicker book with a dark cover, then an orange book, taking each from the stack beside the bag. After pressing the last book down inside, they lower the top of the backpack and withdraw their hand.

The person holds the black bag open and slides the blue book from the top of the stack inside. They add the next book, then the orange-covered book, clearing the stack from the table. Finally, they lower the top of the bag and work the zipper along the opening, leaving it between the plant and the red mug.

A person lifts the small book from the cabinet and opens it above the larger book lying underneath. They pick up the pale rectangular slip, lay it between the pages and close the small book. A person picks up a banknote, opens the orange paperback beside a red backpack and brings their fingers toward its pages. They close that book and leave it on the table. They lift the other orange paperback from the foreground and place it in the open backpack, pressing it down before folding the broad bag panel over the opening.

A person opens the thick red and gray paperback on a wooden board and places a small blue card between its pages. They close the book and return it to the board, then pick up the pink and blue paperback beside it. This second book is moved toward the black backpack behind the desk, where the person works both hands around the bag's opening.

The person types on the laptop, adding B, then O, then H to the document on the screen. They move their hand from the keyboard to the colored letters arranged as H, B, O on the table. Sliding the cutouts into a new order, they leave the yellow B, red O, and green H reading BOH beneath the matching text.

A person types on a laptop, adding two short rows of letters to a blank document. They then move both hands to the white paper letters laid out beside the computer and slide the pieces into different positions. After making several adjustments, they withdraw their hands, leaving the typed letters visible on the screen.

A seated person presses keys on a laptop, and large black letters appear on the white screen in sequence: J, then JK, then JKL. Green J, yellow K, and pink L cutouts lie in a row beside the computer. The person reaches over to the cutouts and rearranges them, moving the J to the right of the K while the typed JKL remains on the screen.

A person types on the laptop, changing the blank document to a large W and then the full sequence WKIDUN. They leave the text on screen and rearrange the colored cutout letters below the keyboard, moving the I and N toward the left and the K toward the right. The physical row ends as NIWDKU while WKIDUN remains displayed above it.

A seated person presents colorful letter cutouts on an open palm and places them in a row across a white tablecloth. They add a red M, blue N, yellow O, green P, red Q, and blue R in order, briefly displaying each before setting it down. A small glass with green stems remains on the left and a black remote stays on the right.

A person holds a large white board upright in front of a small nail polish bottle on the table. They move the board to the left to reveal the bottle, then slide it back across to hide it again. After repeating this movement, they lift the board away and leave, with the bottle and a mug holding a banana and fork still on the table.

A person lays a capped white bottle on its side at the right edge of a wooden cutting board, which is raised on a dark book. They release the bottle and it rolls across the board to the left, where their other hand waits. They retrieve it and repeat the roll, then return the bottle to the raised right edge once more.

A person reaches over a wooden table to display a small beige rectangular piece between their fingers, then withdraws it. They repeat the presentation with two more pale rectangular pieces, holding each above the tabletop before taking it away. Finally, a small purple piece is shown and removed, while the fork and orange object at the far corner stay in place.

A hand holds a plain white bottle horizontally by its cap above a wooden cutting board. The bottle is released onto its side near the left edge, then retrieved from the right side of the board. The person repeats this sequence twice more, lifting the bottle by the cap and placing it back onto its side on the board.

A person holds a white floral mug above the table, turns it, and removes it from view. They then present a metal cup, a blue invoice book, and a long black notebook one after another, withdrawing each before showing the next. Returning to the earlier objects, they display the floral mug again with its opening visible, followed by the invoice book with its blue cover facing the camera.

A hand brings a green patterned glass over the white table and sets it upright near the middle. The person adds a small clear glass beside it, then places a larger square clear glass farther to the left. They withdraw their hand, leaving the small glass between the two larger ones, with the folded socks and card still nearby.

A person sets a small faceted glass upright near the middle of a wooden coffee table. A plain cylindrical glass is placed upright to its left, and a broader glass is added upside down on the right. The row remains in front of an inverted white bowl with a remote balanced across its base.

A person lifts the left inverted glass to show the bare tabletop, then lifts the right glass to reveal a small bottle underneath. After covering the bottle, they slide the glasses around each other. The bottle is revealed beneath the glass on the left, while the right one covers an empty patch; both glasses are set back upside down.

A hand lifts the rightmost striped glass, revealing a white eraser beneath it, and lowers the glass again. The person also lifts and replaces the other upside-down glasses, exposing bare tabletop beneath them. After sliding the glasses around, they check underneath again: the eraser is still under the glass on the right. All the glasses finish upside down on the table.

A person lifts an inverted glass to reveal a small green ball beneath it, then covers the ball again. They slide the two glasses around on the wooden table until the ball is under the glass on the right. After lifting the left glass, they raise the right one to expose the ball, then replace it and move their hands away.

A person pours clear liquid from a pink-lidded pitcher into the right pink cup, then fills the matching cup beside it. After moving the middle cup farther back, they lift it and pour its contents into the large glass on the left. They set the emptied pink cup close to the camera, while the other pink cup remains filled.

A person pours clear liquid from a large plastic bottle into two clear cups in turn, then stands the bottle behind them. Holding the fruit-printed glass in one hand, they lift the left cup and pour most of its contents into that glass. They bring the cup close to the camera and tilt it to show the small amount remaining, then set it back beside the fuller cup.

A person removes the cap from a water bottle and tips it over each of two tall glasses, leaving shallow amounts of clear liquid in both. They lift the middle glass and pour its liquid into the short tumbler on the right. They hold the emptied tall glass upright and turn it slightly toward the camera, then put it back between the other two glasses.

A person lifts the blue patterned jug and pours clear liquid into the two wide glasses on the right, moving it over the taller left glass before setting it down. They pick up the middle glass and pour its liquid into the tall glass. After tipping and rotating the emptied glass above it, they hold the glass toward the camera and return it between the other two.

A person tips a clear bottle over two plastic cups in turn, leaving clear liquid in both cups. They put the bottle aside and lift the right-hand cup over the large translucent jug, tipping its contents into the jug. The emptied cup is returned beside the other cup, which still contains liquid.

A hand displays a card with an orange A and lays it beside the fork on the white table. Next, an orange triangle is shown and placed near the blue toothbrush. A red Y card is set farther forward, followed by a green H card to its left, leaving all the pieces visible in a loose arrangement.

A person gathers a small stack of illustrated cards and holds it in one hand above a wooden table. They deal the cards individually into a loose overlapping spread: a brown card, a green card to its right, and two purple illustrated cards toward the front. They place the final card at the right with its patterned back facing up, then withdraw their hands.

A seated person separates cards from a small stack held in one hand and deals them onto a wooden table. The cards form a loose, overlapping row beside a fork, with pink backs and a face-up card visible. They place the last held card down near the left end of the row and lift their hand away.

A person picks up the white card and brown wallet from the table, opens the wallet and works the card between its inner sections. They fold the wallet closed, lift the flap of the black laptop bag and move the wallet behind it until it is hidden. They lower the flap again, leaving the banknote, two coins, mouse, scissors and marker on the table.

A hand holds a pale letter A above the table and withdraws it, then presents a purple B in the same spot. The person continues with a yellow C and a green D, showing each letter separately by its top edge. The person holds a small red hair dryer in one hand while moving the books beside the power strip with the other. A person opens a pink notebook and holds its lined pages beside a tall red lamp. With the notebook still in hand, they pick up the loose black plug and insert it into the wall socket. They handle the pages again, close the notebook on the desk, and press the inline cord switch, causing the lamp to glow brightly through its red shade.

A person picks up and releases the inline switch of a pink lamp, then opens a small notebook and closes it again. They handle the switch once more, touch the wall plug, and briefly reopen the notebook. Finally, they operate the inline switch again; the lamp illuminates brightly through its pink shade and stays lit as the switch is set down.

A person moves a blue pen around on the table beside a loose light bulb and its cord. They plug the cord into the wall socket, remove it again, and turn the bulb in its holder while steadying the holder with the other hand. After setting the bulb down, they reconnect the plug, and the bulb lights up.

The person displays a purple F and places it near the front of the wooden table. They add a yellow O, an orange R, and a blue D one at a time, forming the word FORD. After straightening the row with their hand, they hold up a dark blue triangular piece and set it beside the F.

A seated person starts a row near the front of the wooden table by placing a red letter R and a dark blue block beside it. They add a blue S, then a red bottle cap to its right. They place a green T next and finish with a purple cap at the far right, withdrawing their hand after each addition while the remote stays behind the row.

Standing behind the dark table, the person raises a blue paper E and holds it facing the camera before taking it to the left. They repeat this with an F, a narrow I, and finally an L. Each letter is displayed separately and removed, while the stacked books, white-handled knife, and dark dish stay on the table.

A person holds up a green letter E and places it flat on a dark wooden table. They show a red A and add it to the right, followed by a brown U to complete a row of three letters. Finally, they display a small green triangle and set it below the middle of the row, with a water bottle and keys remaining behind the pieces.

A seated person shows a pink letter H between their fingers, then lowers it toward their other hand. They next present a purple I and a red J, gathering the letters together near their lap after each display. They adjust the pieces between their hands while the clear bottle remains on its side at the left of the table.

A hand holds a white remote control in front of the upright book, then takes it out of view. A white spoon is presented next, followed by a bright pink capped pen and a folded beige cloth. Each item is removed before the next appears, while the open laptop and the banana on top of the book remain in place.

The person briefly touches the round brown object beside the open laptop, then picks up the book lying to its left. They hold the book upright in front of the object, hiding it from view. Raising the book reveals the object still on the glass tabletop, and they finish by laying the book flat behind it.

A hand brings a red mug over the wood-grain surface and tilts it to show the interior before taking it away. The person then displays three books separately, presenting a dark back cover, a purple back cover and another dark back cover in succession. Each book is withdrawn after being shown, while the black tapered attachment stays on the surface.

A hand repeatedly brings a small cream patterned cup into view, holds it by the handle, and takes it away. Between the cup displays, the person presents three books in turn: a pink-bordered back cover, a dark illustrated cover, and a pale illustrated textbook. The patterned curtain and marble floor remain visible behind each object.

A seated person holds a black remote control toward the camera and takes it away. They next display a notebook with a dark patterned cover and a white label, then lower it out of view. Finally, they raise an orange piece of fabric and withdraw it as well, while the tall clear glass and pencil balanced across its rim remain at the table’s left.

A person brings a pair of burgundy trainers to the glass table and sets them side by side. They hold up black shorts by the waistband, then lay them over the shoes. Next, they spread a pair of beige briefs between their hands and place them on top of the shorts, building a pile beside the blue mug.

A person stretches a black pair of shorts open by the waistband and drops them onto the wooden table beside the small glass jar. They then hold up a dark blue sock and set it just to the right of the shorts. A small red fabric item is shown last and placed farther right, leaving the three items arranged across the table.

A person lowers blue jeans onto the glass table and leaves them spread out. They hold a dark garment above the jeans, fold it, and place it on the right leg. A pair of red and black high top trainers is then set over the folded clothing, followed by a banana placed on the jeans to the shoes' left.

A person holds up dark trousers and then a pair of black lace-up boots, lowering each out of view after showing them. They bring in a red mug with white spots and set it behind the paperback on the table. Next, they gather blue jeans into a pile on the left, bring the boots back, and place them side by side on top of the denim with their toes facing forward.

A person holds up a dark pair of briefs, folds it inward, and places it on the left side of a table. They show light gray boxer shorts and lay them on top, then turn a pale pink bra in their hands and add it to the same pile. Finally, they lift a black garment from the remaining clothes, gather it together, and put it on the stack.

A hand shows a yellow lemon and sets it near the middle of the tabletop. A larger mottled green-and-yellow citrus fruit is placed to its right, followed by a white garlic bulb farther right. Finally, the hand presents a small spotted banana and lays it behind the citrus fruit, leaving the food items arranged beside the packet.

A hand holds up a green star fruit and sets it on the round wooden table. Next, the person shows a small banana and places it beside the fruit. They finish by presenting a red onion and setting it on the other side of the banana, leaving the tall brown bottle standing behind the arrangement.

A hand presents a yellow lemon over a pale patterned tablecloth, then takes it out of view. The person repeats the display with a red apple and then a long dark green cucumber, removing each afterward. A green cloth and two filled jars remain at the back of the table throughout.

A person holds a yellow lemon in one hand, turns it to show different sides, and brings it close to the camera before setting it on the counter. They repeat the presentation with a green apple and place it to the lemon’s left. Finally, they hold a carrot horizontally across their palm and lay it along the front edge, in front of the two fruits.

A person takes a large yellow citrus fruit from a plate, presents it on one palm, and sets it on a gray woven placemat. They repeat this with a small green apple, placing it to the left of the yellow fruit. Finally they show a mottled green-and-orange citrus fruit and set it farther left, leaving the plate empty behind the three fruits.

A person tips a clear bottle over two plastic cups in turn, leaving clear liquid in both cups. They put the bottle aside and lift the right-hand cup over the large translucent jug, tipping its contents into the jug. The emptied cup is returned beside the other cup, which still contains liquid.

A person lifts the clear bottle, twists off its cap, and sets the cap beside the mug. They tip the open bottle over the mug while steadying the mug with the other hand, then return the bottle upright on the table. The mug is raised beyond the top of the frame and later set back down, leaving the bottle uncapped.

A person pours clear liquid from a large plastic bottle into two clear cups in turn, then stands the bottle behind them. Holding the fruit-printed glass in one hand, they lift the left cup and pour most of its contents into that glass. They bring the cup close to the camera and tilt it to show the small amount remaining, then set it back beside the fuller cup.

A person removes the cap from a water bottle and tips it over each of two tall glasses, leaving shallow amounts of clear liquid in both. They lift the middle glass and pour its liquid into the short tumbler on the right. They hold the emptied tall glass upright and turn it slightly toward the camera, then put it back between the other two glasses.

A hand removes the blue cap from the clear plastic bottle and briefly lifts the blue mug out of view before putting it back. The bottle is then tilted over the mug, pouring a stream of clear liquid into it. Finally, the bottle returns upright to the table and the cap is put back on.

Seated on an orange-covered sofa with a reddish cloth over their lap, the person repeatedly brings their open palms together and separates them. Their hands continue clapping in front of their body before coming together in a loose clasp at the end.

A seated person holds both hands open above the patterned tablecloth, brings the palms together, and separates them. They repeatedly clap, pausing at times with their fingers curled into fists before opening their hands again. The silver cylindrical tin and orange remain together on the pink cloth at the left throughout the hand movements.

A seated person raises their hands from the wooden table and repeatedly claps, bringing the palms together and separating them in front of their chest. They pause with the hands pressed together between movements, then resume several more times. At the end, both hands lower toward the tabletop beside the stationary plants and ornaments.

Seated behind a low table, a person claps their hands repeatedly, changing the angle of their palms as they meet. They pause with both hands lowered near the tabletop and then resume clapping before lowering them again. Blue scissors and a long blue pen resting diagonally on a small upright box remain undisturbed in front of them.

A person stands behind a wooden table and brings their hands together in front of their body, briefly clasping the fingers. They lower their arms to their sides, then raise them and repeat a sequence of palm contacts and short separations. They finish with both arms down again, while the small lidded glass container with an orange object inside stays at the table’s left.

A seated person holds out a dark clothes hanger and lays it across the far end of the white table. They next present a coiled black cable and put it in the middle, below the hanger. Finally, they show a green-covered paperback and set it flat closer to the camera, beside the clear bottle.

Beside a folding table holding a glass and a white bottle, a person lays a white cable across the tabletop. They add a small handbag on the right, leaving its long strap hanging down, then drape a black garment over the front edge. Finally, they bring over a closed notebook with a yellow ribbon and lower it onto the crowded table before stepping away.

A person lifts a burgundy shirt, holds it open and turns it before dropping it onto the gray table. They add a green cap with a red and white brim near the front edge, then lay a looped white cable across it. Finally, they show a thick paperback close to the camera and place it on top of the cable and cap.

A seated person lifts a folded light blue T-shirt and holds its printed front toward the camera before returning it behind a small potted cactus. They then present a metal fork across their palm and lay it on the table. Finally, they hold out a white charger and coiled cable, then set them back beside the fork and the other tabletop items.

A person lays a brown strappy garment across the green-covered table and moves the large hairbrush and black package toward the sides. They bring in a white garment, fold it over, and set it on top of the brown fabric. Finally, they place a yellow illustrated book on the clothing, beside the standing pink bottle.

The person removes the pale lid from the rear glass jar and twists the green lid off the larger jar in front. They grip the gray top of the bright green bottle and shift the bottle slightly on the counter. Finally, they bring forward the small white container and remove its mint-colored lid, leaving the jars and small container open.

A person unscrews the gold lid from the front glass jar and sets it down on the counter. They remove the green lid from the jar behind it, then briefly handle the yellow top of the tall green bottle. Finally, they twist off the pale green lid of the small container of white granules, leaving it open beside the glass.

A person fits the small cap onto the tall green bottle and twists it while holding the bottle steady. They pick up the gold-colored lid and close the jar containing red material. Next, they cover the front jar of yellow liquid with the wider pale lid, leaving the containers capped in a line along the table.

A person steadies the small glass jar on the wooden tray, twists off its metal lid and puts it to the right. They move the empty white bowl slightly left and turn it with their fingertips. They then unscrew the blue cap from the tall plastic bottle and set it beside the jar’s lid, leaving both containers open.

The person fits the dark-blue domed lid onto its matching container on the left. They lift a small gold-colored rectangular object onto the white jar, briefly raise it, and put it back across the lid. Finally, they take the shallow round metal container from the table and balance it on top of the tall blue bottle.

A person screws a red cap onto the small blue container and places another red cap on the tall spice jar. They bring a smaller cap over the mouth of the open white bottle, then lower their hand. Finally, they lift the broad green lid and balance it across the top of the narrow clear bottle, leaving the white bottle open.

A person picks up a round lid and fits it onto a small white jar on the table. They then reach between the two bottles and handle the opening of the large clear plastic bottle, which remains open. Finally, they lift the broad white cap from the table and balance it across the mouth of the smaller glass bottle.

A person fits the small cap onto the tall green bottle and twists it while holding the bottle steady. They pick up the gold-colored lid and close the jar containing red material. Next, they cover the front jar of yellow liquid with the wider pale lid, leaving the containers capped in a line along the table.

A person steadies the small glass jar on the wooden tray, twists off its metal lid and puts it to the right. They move the empty white bowl slightly left and turn it with their fingertips. They then unscrew the blue cap from the tall plastic bottle and set it beside the jar’s lid, leaving both containers open.

A person balances a broad beige lid across the mouth of a tall plastic bottle. They bring a small yellow cap toward another clear bottle, but it drops onto the table. They fit a red cap onto a smaller blue bottle, then lift a white cap and lower their hand at the opening of a decorated glass jar, which remains uncovered.

A person opens one hand to reveal a coin on the palm, then closes their fingers around it. They draw their hands back and move them together before returning both fists side by side above the table. Finally, they open both palms, displaying the coin in the hand on the left of the image while the other palm is empty.

A person opens both hands beside a potted plant, showing a coin on the farther palm and the nearer palm empty. They close both fists and move them around, briefly crossing the wrists. When the hands open again, the coin is on the farther palm, which is then held closer to the camera to display it.

A person lifts a black wallet, opens its top, and picks up a small coin from the table. They put the coin into the wallet, pull the closure shut, and turn the wallet in their hands. The person then spreads the quilted handbag open, lowers the wallet toward its opening, and works the bag's zipper before withdrawing both hands.

A person holds both fists above a wooden table, then opens their palms to reveal a small red-and-white wrapped item in one hand. They close their hands, move the fists around, and briefly bring their hands together. Opening both palms again shows the wrapped item in the same hand, and they finish with both fists closed.

A person opens both fists over the slatted wooden table, showing a white round disc in the palm beside the wristwatch and an empty hand opposite it. They close their hands, move the fists up and down and bring them together briefly. They reopen both palms with the disc still in the watch-wearing hand, then withdraw both arms from view.

The person shifts a small cardboard box with an apple on top, then lays a spiral notebook at an angle across a stack of books. After moving the box closer to the camera, they place the apple on the notebook and release it to roll toward the lower end. They retrieve the apple and repeat the movement while the box partly blocks its path from view.

A person places an apple on a closed book, raises one edge of the book, and lets the apple roll off onto the table. They retrieve it and repeat the movement several times, changing the tilt so the apple rolls toward the near edge and then off the left side. The apple finishes on the table beside the book, while a capped bottle remains to the left.

A person brings a clear plastic bottle close to the camera and releases it on its side to roll across the wooden table toward the notebooks. They retrieve the bottle, then lift the spiral notebook stack away from the far end. Bringing the bottle back to the near edge, they send it rolling across the cleared space again.

A person lays a small blue-and-white cylinder sideways on a sloping children’s book and releases it to roll toward an upright box of colorful letters. The box hides the right end of the book. The person reaches behind it, retrieves the cylinder and brings it back to the left, repeating the rolling action twice more.

A person places a small blue toy car at the raised end of a green board supported by books and lets it roll down toward the apple at the bottom. They retrieve the car and return it to the top for another run. They repeat the movement once more, leaving the car beginning another descent as their hand lifts away.

A person shifts the green mug slightly on the dark table and picks up the black-handled knife beside it. They lay the knife horizontally across the mug's opening, then take the apple from the right side of the table. The apple is placed on top of the balanced knife and remains perched above the mug as the hand withdraws.

A person sets an apple near the front of the table, then handles strips of white paper and lays them beside the large mug. They bring a clear tub of pale granules closer and scoop from it with a spoon, tipping the spoonfuls into the mug. After another scoop and transfer, they lower the tub behind the mug and withdraw their hands.

A person lifts the small white cup over an empty patch of table, then raises the floral mug to reveal an orange underneath. They cover the orange and slide the inverted cups back and forth, briefly exchanging their positions. After restoring the white cup on the left and floral mug in the middle, they lift each again and leave the orange covered by the floral mug beside the apple.

A person positions a clear drinking glass on a reflective table and lays a thin colorful magazine across its rim. They adjust the magazine with both hands until it stays balanced horizontally after they let go. They lift the apple from beside the glass, set it near the middle of the magazine, and briefly touch it again, leaving the apple supported above the glass.

A person lifts a red apple and positions it between the narrow ends of two green plastic bottles lying on their sides. They repeatedly steady and turn the apple, nudging the bottles and briefly removing their fingers between adjustments. The apple remains between the bottle necks, with the white letter cutouts at the front and the glass vessels and spoon at the back left.

The person fits the dark-blue domed lid onto its matching container on the left. They lift a small gold-colored rectangular object onto the white jar, briefly raise it, and put it back across the lid. Finally, they take the shallow round metal container from the table and balance it on top of the tall blue bottle.

A person steadies the small glass jar on the wooden tray, twists off its metal lid and puts it to the right. They move the empty white bowl slightly left and turn it with their fingertips. They then unscrew the blue cap from the tall plastic bottle and set it beside the jar’s lid, leaving both containers open.

A person lifts the small metal bowl and rests it upside down over the open brown-filled jar. They take the long translucent blue lid and lower it diagonally into the clear glass bowl, leaving it leaning out. After shifting the loose yellow and turquoise lids on the counter, they pick up the blue bottle cap and screw it onto the water bottle.

A person screws a small silver lid onto the round decorated jar. They pick up the gold cap and drop it into the larger open glass jar, then fasten the red lid onto the tall narrow jar. Finally, they balance the wide gray lid across the mouth of the black bottle, where it rests at an angle.

The person removes the pale lid from the rear glass jar and twists the green lid off the larger jar in front. They grip the gray top of the bright green bottle and shift the bottle slightly on the counter. Finally, they bring forward the small white container and remove its mint-colored lid, leaving the jars and small container open.

A person lifts a navy garment with red and white stripes, folds it, and sets it at the back of the table. They hold up a white graphic T-shirt, fold it, and lay it on top. A navy-and-white garment is unfolded next and folded over the pile, leaving its dark side on top beside the bottle, orange, and green scissors.

A person folds the sleeves and body of a navy shirt into a rectangle and moves it to the left side of the table. They fold the gray shirt underneath in the same area and stack it over the navy one, then fold the green shorts and add them on top. Finally, they fold a white sheet of paper beside the clothes and press the crease flat.

A person lifts a dark teal garment from a pile on a checked table, folds it, and places it to the left. They fold an orange shirt and add it on top, followed by a red shirt. They then lift the remaining dark patterned sweater, fold it into a compact rectangle, and lay it on the stack, clearing the right side of the table.

A person takes the light gray garment from the top of a clothing pile, folds it, and sets it at the front of the table. They fold the white garment with orange and dark stripes and stack it on the gray one, then add folded camouflage clothing on top. Dark gray clothes remain at the back, with the pomegranate, book, and yellow boxes undisturbed on the right.

A seated person lifts a red printed garment, folds it and places it on the table. They fold a dark garment onto it, then add a pale patterned piece to the top of the pile. Finally, they pull a white paper towel toward the front, fold it into a smaller rectangle and smooth it down beside a pair of glasses.

A person moves the dark floral garment aside and folds the plain black clothing into a compact shape on the counter. They fold the yellow garment and place it on the black layer. Next, they gather the pale striped garment, lay it on top, and press the pile with both hands, leaving the floral item spread out to the right.

A person folds a black garment and smooths it into a flat pile on the left side of the table. They lift the blue garment from the remaining clothes, fold it, and add it to the pile. Next, they fold the mustard-yellow garment over the blue one and finish by placing a small folded gray item on top.

A person lifts a dark teal garment from a pile on a checked table, folds it, and places it to the left. They fold an orange shirt and add it on top, followed by a red shirt. They then lift the remaining dark patterned sweater, fold it into a compact rectangle, and lay it on the stack, clearing the right side of the table.

A person lifts a gray garment from a pile on a covered table, folds it, and places it near the back. They fold a white garment over it, smoothing the new stack with both hands. Next, they pick up a dark striped shirt, fold it, and add it on top, while a blue garment remains spread separately at the front.

A person takes the light gray garment from the top of a clothing pile, folds it, and sets it at the front of the table. They fold the white garment with orange and dark stripes and stack it on the gray one, then add folded camouflage clothing on top. Dark gray clothes remain at the back, with the pomegranate, book, and yellow boxes undisturbed on the right.

Standing behind the blue plaid-covered surface, a person shows a small floral mug and lowers it out of sight. A white mug with a green flower is presented next, followed by a slim pen. They bring up the green-flower mug and pen again before finishing with the floral mug, removing each between displays while the cardboard box stays on the right.

The person presents a flower-decorated mug, a thick dark marker, and a pale-yellow book one at a time, removing each before bringing the next into view. They then hold up a slim pen, followed by a mug with a black rectangular design and a taller white mug with a single black symbol. Each object is held above the patterned table and then taken away.

A person holds a white floral mug above the table, turns it, and removes it from view. They then present a metal cup, a blue invoice book, and a long black notebook one after another, withdrawing each before showing the next. Returning to the earlier objects, they display the floral mug again with its opening visible, followed by the invoice book with its blue cover facing the camera.

A hand presents three small mugs one at a time over a patterned tablecloth: a white floral mug, a brown-and-white mug, and a mug with a black line pattern. Each is taken away before the next appears. The person then shows a clear blue-capped pen, a black pen, and the blue-capped pen again, leaving the notebook and green bottle undisturbed at the back.

A hand brings a pink plastic cup into the foreground, holds it upright, and removes it. A flower-patterned glass and a paperback with an egg illustration are displayed in the same way. The person repeats the displays with the cup, book, and glass in that order, while a green plush pig, black toy car, and pink packet remain along the back of the table.

Seated on a wooden chair, a person holds a pair of brown boots toward the camera before moving them out of view to the right. They next lift a pair of long gray trousers and spread them in front of their body, then move them aside. Finally, they show light gray boxer shorts by the waistband and swing them out to the right as well.

A person holds a pair of dark trainers with red stripes in front of the camera, then takes them out of view. Light gray shorts are shown next, stretched by the waistband, and lowered away. Finally, they hold up a black garment by its upper corners before removing that as well.

A person holds up a pair of tan and brown lace-up shoes, then places them side by side on the wooden table. They lift a light gray pair of trousers and drape it across the shoes, covering most of their uppers. Brown elastic-waisted underwear is shown last and dropped onto the trousers, leaving the shoe toes visible beneath the pile.

A person holds up dark trousers and then a pair of black lace-up boots, lowering each out of view after showing them. They bring in a red mug with white spots and set it behind the paperback on the table. Next, they gather blue jeans into a pile on the left, bring the boots back, and place them side by side on top of the denim with their toes facing forward.

A person shows a folded gray garment and lays it on the left side of a white chair seat, beside a plate and fork. They add a small black fabric item on top, then present a silver metal bottle and lay it sideways across the pile. Finally, they lift a white lace-up sneaker and set it over the clothes, with its loose lace hanging toward the front.

With a vase of red flowers and a candy-shaped glass dish on the table, a person repeatedly brings their palms together and separates them. Their hands move forward over the circular pattern between claps, then settle lower near its far edge, leaving both objects in place.

A person stands behind a wooden table and brings their hands together in front of their body, briefly clasping the fingers. They lower their arms to their sides, then raise them and repeat a sequence of palm contacts and short separations. They finish with both arms down again, while the small lidded glass container with an orange object inside stays at the table’s left.

A seated person holds both hands open above the patterned tablecloth, brings the palms together, and separates them. They repeatedly clap, pausing at times with their fingers curled into fists before opening their hands again. The silver cylindrical tin and orange remain together on the pink cloth at the left throughout the hand movements.

A person holds both fists above a wooden table, then opens their palms to reveal a small red-and-white wrapped item in one hand. They close their hands, move the fists around, and briefly bring their hands together. Opening both palms again shows the wrapped item in the same hand, and they finish with both fists closed.

A person holds their hands together above a tabletop scattered with papers. They rub their palms back and forth, rotate the hands, and slide one palm over the back and fingers of the other. Their fingers repeatedly interlace and separate as the rubbing continues, then both hands lower toward the right edge of the frame.

The person holds an open green-and-white packet beside a clear jug and moves a white-handled spoon between the packet and the jug's mouth. Dark granules are visible on the raised spoon before it is lowered into the jug. They move the spoon around inside the jug, then lift it above the rim while the packet drops out of view.

A person handles a tea bag above a brown striped mug and lowers it inside, then tilts the tall green bottle over the mug. After returning the bottle upright, they stir with a spoon and leave it leaning in the cup. They next open the large container of white granules, hold its lid above the opening for a moment and close it again.

A person opens a tea box, handles a sachet and lowers a tea bag into a white mug. They lift a red insulated jug, tilt it above the mug and return it to the table before stirring with a metal spoon. Finally, they scoop a spoonful of white granules from a large clear jar and leave that spoon standing in the jar.

A person unscrews the gold lid from the front glass jar and sets it down on the counter. They remove the green lid from the jar behind it, then briefly handle the yellow top of the tall green bottle. Finally, they twist off the pale green lid of the small container of white granules, leaving it open beside the glass.

At a kitchen counter, a person opens a tea-bag packet above a white mug and places the wrapper beside it. They tip the metal jug over the mug, return it to the patterned plate, and stir with a spoon. After briefly lifting the large gray container out of view and replacing it, they stir the mug again and set the spoon down.

A person runs a hand across the red tablecloth, then places a dark book near the center of the table. They add an upside-down clear cup to its right and lay a green pen on the cover. A small jar with a red lid goes beside the clear cup, and a white mug is placed to the left of the book.

A hand points across an empty fruit-patterned tablecloth, then brings in a small white cup with a pencil leaning from it and sets it at the back right. A dark paperback is laid at the back left, followed by a round container with a pink lid near the front left. The hand points across the remaining open space and withdraws.

A seated person lifts a red printed garment, folds it and places it on the table. They fold a dark garment onto it, then add a pale patterned piece to the top of the pile. Finally, they pull a white paper towel toward the front, fold it into a smaller rectangle and smooth it down beside a pair of glasses.

A seated person shows three slender writing tools one after another above the floral tablecloth, setting each aside before taking the next. They then hold a purple illustrated book upright with its cover facing the camera and place it to the side, followed by a red book shown the same way. Finally, the person presents a green plastic cup and takes it away.

A person moves a red and white mug from the back of the table to the front left, leaving it upright. They place a checked mug upside down beside it, then invert a larger red floral mug to extend the row. They finish by lifting the remaining white mug covered in black words and holding it upright to the right of the arranged cups.

A hand lifts the rightmost striped glass, revealing a white eraser beneath it, and lowers the glass again. The person also lifts and replaces the other upside-down glasses, exposing bare tabletop beneath them. After sliding the glasses around, they check underneath again: the eraser is still under the glass on the right. All the glasses finish upside down on the table.

A person lifts the left inverted glass to show the bare tabletop, then lifts the right glass to reveal a small bottle underneath. After covering the bottle, they slide the glasses around each other. The bottle is revealed beneath the glass on the left, while the right one covers an empty patch; both glasses are set back upside down.

A hand brings a green patterned glass over the white table and sets it upright near the middle. The person adds a small clear glass beside it, then places a larger square clear glass farther to the left. They withdraw their hand, leaving the small glass between the two larger ones, with the folded socks and card still nearby.

A person lifts an inverted glass to reveal a small green ball beneath it, then covers the ball again. They slide the two glasses around on the wooden table until the ball is under the glass on the right. After lifting the left glass, they raise the right one to expose the ball, then replace it and move their hands away.

Two clear glasses stand upside down, with a small multicolored ball beneath the right one. The person lifts and replaces the left glass, then raises the right glass to expose the ball. They slide the glasses around with both hands and lift them again in turn, leaving the ball covered by the right glass and the left one over an empty space.

A person fastens a white shirt over an orange printed T-shirt. Starting near the collar, they bring the front edges together and work downward, using both hands to push the buttons through their holes.
