A person opens the paperback on the bedside table, briefly spreads its pages, and closes it again. They slide the book back toward the wall and move the pink pen alongside its right edge. They then adjust the knife near the front of the table so its blade points toward the red lamp base; the lamp stays lit beside the glass and metal pan.

A person operates the black switch beside a desk lamp, turning the lamp on brightly above a striped mug and open papers. They turn a page beneath the light and briefly move their hands over the desk. After pressing the switch again, the lamp goes dark; they turn another page and lower their hands beside the stack of books.

A person lifts a kitchen knife from beside the table and holds it horizontally between both hands before lowering it out of view. They then present a green writing tool, a yellow one, and a blue one in turn, removing each to the left before showing the next. A lime and black zippered case remain on the fruit-patterned tablecloth throughout.

A hand holds up a dark pencil and places it horizontally on the wooden table, with its point facing right. A second pencil is shown and laid alongside the first. The person then displays a silver table knife and places it in front of the pencils, also pointing to the right.

A hand slides the pale card into a slot in the open black wallet on the desk. The person folds the wallet closed, grips it from above, and lifts it toward the gray shoulder bag. They lower the wallet into an open compartment of the bag, with their hand still at the opening at the end.

A person opens a brown wallet on the table and picks up a small white card, sliding it into an inner compartment. They fold the wallet closed and open the black bag behind it. The closed wallet is lowered toward the bag's opening, and a hand reaches inside before the person leaves the bag lying flat on the table.

The person unzips the patterned wallet and spreads its compartments open. They pick up the pink card from the table and insert it into a slot, then add the blue card to another compartment. Finally, they close and zip the wallet and lower it into the dark handbag, leaving the loose notes and coins on the table.

A person picks up the white card and brown wallet from the table, opens the wallet and works the card between its inner sections. They fold the wallet closed, lift the flap of the black laptop bag and move the wallet behind it until it is hidden. They lower the flap again, leaving the banknote, two coins, mouse, scissors and marker on the table.

A person holds a folded banknote above an open black wallet beside the laptop and tucks it into the wallet. They fold the wallet closed, lift it from the desk, and bring it toward the upright black shoulder bag. They lower the wallet into the open compartment at the top and press it down with their fingers, leaving the bag open.

A person tears a long printed sheet into two pieces and leaves them beside a small blue packet. They pick up the small tan object on the right, pull it apart, and put the pieces down. Returning to the paper, they tear both sections into narrower strips and leave the strips spread across the table.

A person tears a white sheet into two sections and leaves them on the counter beside the large glass. They pick up the small green leaf, pull at it with both hands, and set it down again. Returning to one paper section, they fold and bend it repeatedly, tear off smaller pieces, and drop the scraps beside the remaining strip.

A person holds a small sheet of white paper above a dark kitchen counter and tears it with both hands. They rotate and pull the paper apart repeatedly, setting the separated scraps near a coiled cable and a knife. They pick up the pieces again and tear them into smaller sections, leaving several irregular white scraps spread on the counter.

A person pulls a white sheet apart with both hands and leaves the pieces on the counter. They pick up a green lettuce leaf, tear off a smaller piece, and put both pieces down beside the paper. They then tear more white paper into smaller fragments, leaving a loose pile near the larger sheet and the lettuce.

The person lifts the sheet of paper and pulls it apart, leaving a crumpled piece on the table. They then tear the lettuce into smaller sections and set the pieces down at the back of the table. Returning to the paper, they tear it into more pieces and leave a loose pile in front of the lettuce.

Two clear glasses stand upside down, with a small multicolored ball beneath the right one. The person lifts and replaces the left glass, then raises the right glass to expose the ball. They slide the glasses around with both hands and lift them again in turn, leaving the ball covered by the right glass and the left one over an empty space.

A person lifts an inverted glass to reveal a small green ball beneath it, then covers the ball again. They slide the two glasses around on the wooden table until the ball is under the glass on the right. After lifting the left glass, they raise the right one to expose the ball, then replace it and move their hands away.

A person lifts three inverted white cups in turn, revealing a small pale blue ball beneath the middle cup and empty spaces under the outer cups, then covers them again. They slide and exchange the cups with both hands before returning them to a row. They lift each cup again, showing the ball under the middle one, and finish with all three inverted.

A hand lifts the rightmost striped glass, revealing a white eraser beneath it, and lowers the glass again. The person also lifts and replaces the other upside-down glasses, exposing bare tabletop beneath them. After sliding the glasses around, they check underneath again: the eraser is still under the glass on the right. All the glasses finish upside down on the table.

A person lifts the left inverted glass to show the bare tabletop, then lifts the right glass to reveal a small bottle underneath. After covering the bottle, they slide the glasses around each other. The bottle is revealed beneath the glass on the left, while the right one covers an empty patch; both glasses are set back upside down.

A person crouches by a closed kitchen door to place a pale shoe and a small translucent jug on the floor. They bring over a white metal chair, set it beside the objects, and add a small bottle near the jug. When they swing the door inward, it shifts the chair and nearby floor objects toward the left, while the jug ends up beside their feet.

A person carries a round wooden stool into an open doorway and sets it just inside. They bend down several times to arrange a flat white packet and small objects on the floor beside it, including a dark bottle left standing upright. After straightening up, they swing the door closed, hiding the items and most of the stool, then turn and step away.

A person bends down at an open doorway and places a small white plastic bag and a brown ball on the tiled floor. They bring a wooden chair over and set it beside the doorway, then step to the wall and swing the door toward the objects. As the door closes, the bag and ball shift behind the chair and door, disappearing from the open floor space.

A person places an iron on the floor near the open doorway, adds a white cup, and brings in a metal chair beside them. They stand a small clear bottle near the door's edge and pull the door inward toward the chair. The door remains partly open, and when it is moved outward again, the bottle lies on its side near the iron and cup.

A person lays a small orange-filled bottle on its side on the floor beside an open door, then places a white envelope next to it. They add a large red cylindrical tin on its side near the envelope. As the door swings across the floor, the bottle and tin shift toward the right side of the doorway and the envelope is partly caught beneath the door's edge.

Over a dark wooden desk, a hand presents several objects one at a time: a clear plastic cup, a bright pink square note, a cigarette packet, a small box of staples, and a white pen. Each item is held toward the camera briefly and then taken away before the next appears. The desk surface remains clear at the end.

A person reaches over a wooden table to display a small beige rectangular piece between their fingers, then withdraws it. They repeat the presentation with two more pale rectangular pieces, holding each above the tabletop before taking it away. Finally, a small purple piece is shown and removed, while the fork and orange object at the far corner stay in place.

A person holds a white floral mug above the table, turns it, and removes it from view. They then present a metal cup, a blue invoice book, and a long black notebook one after another, withdrawing each before showing the next. Returning to the earlier objects, they display the floral mug again with its opening visible, followed by the invoice book with its blue cover facing the camera.

A person picks up objects from a row on a white-covered table, holding each toward the camera before taking it away. They display a pink marker, a pink-handled spoon, a blue pen, a pink-handled knife, and a matching fork in that order. Finally, they show the remaining gray marker with a red cap and remove it, leaving the tabletop clear.

A hand presents small colorful pieces one at a time in front of a wooden tabletop. A pink F is followed by a yellow ring-shaped letter, an orange letter, a blue D-shaped piece, and a dark blue triangle. Each piece is held briefly near the camera and carried away, while a glass containing a brown egg and spoon remains at the back.

A person lifts the large translucent green jug and sets it beside the narrow glass. They adjust the small fitting on its lid, then raise and tip the jug with its corner over the glass. After returning the jug upright to the table, they lift the glass out of view and set it down farther to the right.

A hand unscrews the metal cap from the clear bottle and removes it. The person lifts the open bottle, tilts its mouth over the stemless glass, and stands it upright again. They then pick up the glass and raise it out of view before returning it to the table beside the uncapped bottle.

A person lifts the clear bottle, twists off its cap, and sets the cap beside the mug. They tip the open bottle over the mug while steadying the mug with the other hand, then return the bottle upright on the table. The mug is raised beyond the top of the frame and later set back down, leaving the bottle uncapped.

A person unscrews the blue cap from a water bottle and pours clear liquid into the ribbed glass held in the other hand. They recap the bottle and stand it on the table. The person then lifts the glass toward the top of the frame, lowers it again, and moves it to the right of the smaller patterned glass.

A person lifts the blue patterned jug and pours clear liquid into the two wide glasses on the right, moving it over the taller left glass before setting it down. They pick up the middle glass and pour its liquid into the tall glass. After tipping and rotating the emptied glass above it, they hold the glass toward the camera and return it between the other two.

A person brings the broad white lid to the top of the white jar and adjusts it with both hands. They next lift a small cap toward the neck of the large clear bottle behind the jar. Finally, they handle the smaller clear bottle on the right and set a round white lid across its top.

A person picks up a round lid and fits it onto a small white jar on the table. They then reach between the two bottles and handle the opening of the large clear plastic bottle, which remains open. Finally, they lift the broad white cap from the table and balance it across the mouth of the smaller glass bottle.

A person screws the light blue cap onto the clear plastic bottle, then places the small dark blue cap on the little white container beside it. They pick up the cream-colored lid and lower it into the wide jar with the green rim, pressing it inside the opening. Finally, they fit the broad green lid onto the clear glass jar at the front and withdraw their hands.

A person screws a small silver lid onto the round decorated jar. They pick up the gold cap and drop it into the larger open glass jar, then fasten the red lid onto the tall narrow jar. Finally, they balance the wide gray lid across the mouth of the black bottle, where it rests at an angle.

The person places the large white cover across the mouth of the brown bottle, where it overhangs the sides. They then screw a metal lid onto the jar containing yellow liquid. Next, they pick up the small metal cap and lower it into the open jar with reddish contents, leaving that jar uncovered and its larger lid on the table.

A person moves a blue pen and lifts a white sheet to reveal a board with assorted geometric openings on a small cabinet. They place colored pieces over several openings, adding a red square, a blue piece, and a small pink circle. They then add two yellow circles of different sizes, leaving the partly filled board in front of the sheet and beside a mug.

A person draws simple outlines on a sheet of white paper with a blue pen, then lifts the sheet to show the shapes. They place it on a larger white board and steady it with one hand. Dark geometric cutouts are set along the top of the paper, forming a short row before the hands move away.

A person uncaps the blue pen and draws on a small white sheet while holding the paper steady. They lay the pen down and lift the sheet close to the camera, showing an outlined triangle beside a square. After returning the paper to the table, they pick up a dark blue square and turquoise triangle and present the colored cutouts together.

A person uses a blue pen to draw a small circle, a larger circle, and a triangle in a row on white paper, then raises the sheet to show the shapes. After laying it down, they put a red cap over the small circle, a green triangular piece over the larger circle, and a yellow lid over the drawn triangle.

A person draws a square and a circle on a white sheet resting over a book, then holds the paper upright to show both outlines. They lay it flat again and place a blue round piece over the left drawing. A red rounded rectangular piece is added over the right drawing, and both pieces remain on the paper beside the marker.

A person cracks a brown egg over a white bowl and separates the shell, letting the yolk and white drop into the bowl. They set the shell halves beside a blue cap, pinch some salt from the cap, and sprinkle it over the egg. They then lift the spoon from the bowl's rim and take it away, leaving the raw egg in the bowl.

A person takes an egg from an open carton, cracks it over a small blue bowl, and pulls the shell halves apart above the bowl. They leave the broken shells beside the carton, take a pinch from the large jar of salt, and hold their fingers over the bowl. They then pick up a utensil and make repeated stirring motions inside the bowl.

A person takes an egg from a tray, cracks it open over a yellow bowl and leaves a shell half on the table. They move a tall brown glass from the left side to the right, then shake a white seasoning container over the bowl. Finally, they stir the bowl's contents with a blue-handled fork and leave the fork resting inside.

A person taps a white egg at the rim of a small glass bowl, cracks it open and lets the contents fall into the bowl. They set the shell aside and stir the egg while holding the bowl. After shaking white seasoning from the small shaker over the mixture, they return the shaker upright and continue beating the egg with the utensil.

The person cracks an egg into a small glass bowl, leaving the yolk intact at first. They add white granules from the open jar and shake seasoning from the yellow-lidded container over the egg. Finally, they hold the bowl and stir with a plastic knife, breaking up the yolk and combining it with the white.

A person picks up a brown wallet from a blue backpack and opens it over a small table. They tuck a folded white slip into the wallet, close it, and unzip a front compartment of the backpack. They place the wallet inside and pull the zipper closed, leaving the folded banknotes, coins, cucumber, and other tabletop items outside the bag.

A person opens a brown wallet on a wooden table, picks up the white rectangular paper and slips it into the wallet. They fold the wallet closed, lift it and move it into a pocket of their shorts. The banknote, loose coins, pink handbag, orange cup and green fruit remain spread across the tabletop.

A person opens a tan wallet on a desk beside a brown handbag, picks up the banknotes lying nearby, and pushes them into the wallet's compartment. They fold the wallet shut and press its flap closed. They then lift the wallet over the open handbag and lower it inside, where its tan edge remains visible near the top.

A person opens a brown wallet on the table and picks up a small white card, sliding it into an inner compartment. They fold the wallet closed and open the black bag behind it. The closed wallet is lowered toward the bag's opening, and a hand reaches inside before the person leaves the bag lying flat on the table.

A person lifts a black wallet, opens its top, and picks up a small coin from the table. They put the coin into the wallet, pull the closure shut, and turn the wallet in their hands. The person then spreads the quilted handbag open, lowers the wallet toward its opening, and works the bag's zipper before withdrawing both hands.

A person places an apple on a closed book, raises one edge of the book, and lets the apple roll off onto the table. They retrieve it and repeat the movement several times, changing the tilt so the apple rolls toward the near edge and then off the left side. The apple finishes on the table beside the book, while a capped bottle remains to the left.

A person arranges three books on a wooden table, leaving one slanted across another and standing the third upright in front of its right end. They release a small orange onto the slanted book; it rolls behind the upright book and emerges on the right. They repeat this twice, then leave the orange beside the books and step away.

The person shifts a small cardboard box with an apple on top, then lays a spiral notebook at an angle across a stack of books. After moving the box closer to the camera, they place the apple on the notebook and release it to roll toward the lower end. They retrieve the apple and repeat the movement while the box partly blocks its path from view.

A person rolls an orange across the wooden table and retrieves it near the front edge. They bring a closed brown book forward and lift the orange onto its cover. The orange is turned and moved over the book, then released on top while the red mug and pale apple remain at the back of the table.

A person positions a clear drinking glass on a reflective table and lays a thin colorful magazine across its rim. They adjust the magazine with both hands until it stays balanced horizontally after they let go. They lift the apple from beside the glass, set it near the middle of the magazine, and briefly touch it again, leaving the apple supported above the glass.

A hand presents writing tools one at a time above the dark table, withdrawing each between views. A gray marker with a black cap is followed by a broad blue-capped marker, a slim blue pen, a silver-bodied marker with a blue cap, and another gray marker with a black cap. Finally, the person shows a clear glass with blue printing and takes it away.

A hand presents a slim black pen over a white-covered table and removes it from view. The person then displays a blue writing tool, a metal fork with a dark handle and a beige marker with a black cap, withdrawing each in turn. A small black charging unit and its loose cable remain on the left throughout.

A person displays a black-capped marker in one hand and lays it near the back of a checked table. They show a metal spoon next, then slide it into place to the left of a black case. Finally, they present another dark pen and put it near the front, below the spoon.

A seated person shows three slender writing tools one after another above the floral tablecloth, setting each aside before taking the next. They then hold a purple illustrated book upright with its cover facing the camera and place it to the side, followed by a red book shown the same way. Finally, the person presents a green plastic cup and takes it away.

A hand picks up the black-and-white pen and displays it across an open palm before returning it to the counter. The cream-handled knife is lifted and shown next, followed by the clear-bodied pen. Finally, the blue pencil is held up in the same way and set back beside the other objects.

A red toy fire engine sits on a mathematics book beside a bowl of pens. The person lifts the book's left edge and lets the truck travel off the right side. They repeatedly bring the truck back to the book and send it across toward the right again, finally returning it to rest on the cover.

A person places a small red toy truck on a wooden table, then lifts one end of a thin book to make a ramp. They release the truck from the raised end three times, letting it roll rightward toward a metal pen cup and retrieving it each time. They lower the book flat, guide the truck back across the tabletop by hand, and leave it near the center.

A person props a red hardcover book at an angle against a stack of books, making a slope behind an upright blue box. They place a red toy car at the raised end and release it down the cover, where it passes behind the box and appears near the front left edge. They retrieve the car and repeat the release from the top of the slope.

A person pushes an orange toy sports car from the left side of the table toward a thick book on the right, letting it roll freely across the cloth. They pick up the car and return it to the left, then repeat the push. After retrieving it once more, they send it rolling toward the book a third time.

A person places a small blue toy car at the raised end of a cardboard ramp supported by a stack of books. They release it to roll down toward the box at the lower end, then retrieve it from the left. They return the car to the top and repeat the release, ending with it moving down the ramp.

Hands lift a black remote control from a coffee table, turn its buttons toward the camera, and set it near the front. The person then picks up a closed laptop, tilts it sideways, and returns it farther right. They display a drinking glass and set it near the front left, then lift a power adapter with its cables and lay them across the table beside the remote.

A person brings a closed silver laptop into view and lowers it onto a round wooden table in front of several drink containers. They show a black remote control and place it beside the laptop's upper-right edge. They then hold up a small yellow cloth, move it over the laptop lid and leave it lying flat near the center.

A seated person holds a black remote control toward the camera and takes it away. They next display a notebook with a dark patterned cover and a white label, then lower it out of view. Finally, they raise an orange piece of fabric and withdraw it as well, while the tall clear glass and pencil balanced across its rim remain at the table’s left.

A person brings a black remote control to a wooden table, shows its buttons, and sets it beside a small lidded glass jar. They then hold out an empty white ribbed bowl and place it farther to the right. Finally, they display a black sock and lay it on the right side of the bowl, leaving the items spread across the table.

A seated person displays a pale pen and lays it on the right side of the gray table. They show a black remote and place it beside the pen, then add a coiled red and black USB cable to the remote’s left. They finish by holding up a metal spoon and laying it on the far left of the group.

A person brings a black remote control to a wooden table, shows its buttons, and sets it beside a small lidded glass jar. They then hold out an empty white ribbed bowl and place it farther to the right. Finally, they display a black sock and lay it on the right side of the bowl, leaving the items spread across the table.

A seated person starts a row near the front of the wooden table by placing a red letter R and a dark blue block beside it. They add a blue S, then a red bottle cap to its right. They place a green T next and finish with a purple cap at the far right, withdrawing their hand after each addition while the remote stays behind the row.

A person holds up a black remote control and lays it on the counter in front of the tall green vase. They bring in a white plate next and set it farther forward on the right. Finally, a white power adapter and its cable are placed to the left of the plate, with the cable left loosely looped.

A person points across a pale table and places a white plug adapter near its front corner. They add a small roll of tape farther back and a brown mug beside the adapter. A pair of metal chopsticks is moved next to the mug, and a black remote is taken from the left side and laid beside the tape.

A person lifts a black frying pan to show its inside, then returns it to the counter. They pick up and display a remote control, a small gray rectangular device and a floral mug in turn, putting each down again. Next, they lift and spread out the colorful cloth, then reposition the fork and red-handled knife beside it.

A person brings a clear plastic bottle close to the camera and releases it on its side to roll across the wooden table toward the notebooks. They retrieve the bottle, then lift the spiral notebook stack away from the far end. Bringing the bottle back to the near edge, they send it rolling across the cleared space again.

A person lays a brown spiral notebook at an angle across the small book stack, then stands a thick dark hardback upright to its right. They bring a clear blue-capped bottle onto the notebook and release it on its side. The bottle rolls off toward the open tabletop, and the person retrieves it and repeats the roll before bringing it back to the notebook.

A hand lifts a clear blue-capped plastic bottle and lays it sideways on a thick book. When released, the bottle rolls forward over the book’s near edge and onto the tabletop close to the camera. The person retrieves it and repeats the release several times, ending with the bottle rolling into the foreground again.

A person leans a spiral notebook against a small stack of books to form a ramp, then stands an ornate book upright nearby. They release a clear plastic bottle with a blue cap down the notebook, retrieve it from the right side of the table, and repeat the motion. The sequence ends with another release onto the sloping notebook.

A person lays a small clear jar of yellow liquid on its side near the right end of a book and releases it to roll across the cover. They repeatedly retrieve the jar from the left, return it to the right and let it roll again. After the last run, they move the jar beside the notebook pile, leaving the book clear in front of them.

A person lifts the small white cup over an empty patch of table, then raises the floral mug to reveal an orange underneath. They cover the orange and slide the inverted cups back and forth, briefly exchanging their positions. After restoring the white cup on the left and floral mug in the middle, they lift each again and leave the orange covered by the floral mug beside the apple.

A person moves a red and white mug from the back of the table to the front left, leaving it upright. They place a checked mug upside down beside it, then invert a larger red floral mug to extend the row. They finish by lifting the remaining white mug covered in black words and holding it upright to the right of the arranged cups.

A person moves cups from the right end of a white table into a row across its middle. They set a patterned white cup upright, place a green and yellow cup upside down to its left, add an upright metal tumbler, and then an inverted maroon and yellow cup farther left. They finish by lifting the remaining maroon cup and turning it upside down in the air.

A seated person brings the orange cup to the front of the table, then places the blue-lined white cup upside down behind it. They add the white mug with lettering upright and move the purple mug behind that, upside down. Finally, they lift the wide yellow-patterned mug and hold it above the table while reaching toward the camera with their other hand.

A person moves the burgundy spotted mug forward and leaves it upside down. They bring the wide green patterned cup beside it, then place the dark green mug upside down in front of the remaining cups. After moving the orange-rimmed patterned cup to the front right, they lift the tall pale mug and hold it above the arrangement.

A person wearing an open blue-and-white shirt brings its lower front edges together and fastens the bottom buttons. They work upward with both hands, closing the shirt across the waist and chest. After fastening the upper buttons near the collar, they lower their hands, leaving the shirt front closed over the black top underneath.

A person wears an open sheer white shirt over a dark top. Starting at the neckline, they use both hands to fasten the front buttons one after another, gradually working down past the two chest pockets toward the hem. They finish the lower fastening and lower their hands, leaving the shirt front closed.

A person brings the two sides of an open, pale checked shirt together near the neck and starts fastening the buttons. Their hands work steadily down the front, pinching each section of fabric together before moving lower. By the end, the front is closed and they are still adjusting the lowest part near the hem.

A seated person brings together the lower edges of an open gray shirt and fastens a button near the hem. They work upward with both hands, closing successive buttons across the stomach and chest until only the collar area remains open. After fastening the top button, they release the shirt and lower their hands to their lap.

The person brings the lower edges of their open denim shirt together and fastens a button near the hem. They continue buttoning upward, using both hands to join the front panels over the dark red top underneath. After fastening the buttons near the collar, they lower their hands with the shirt closed down the front.

A person pushes a blue-wheeled toy car up a clear plastic ramp on a yellow table and brings it back to the front. They repeat the movement on the neighboring ramp, then leave the car below the gap between the two. Finally, they straighten the red book on the left, while the apple and small pieces at the tops of the ramps remain in place.

A person places a small blue toy car at the raised end of a cardboard ramp supported by a stack of books. They release it to roll down toward the box at the lower end, then retrieve it from the left. They return the car to the top and repeat the release, ending with it moving down the ramp.

The person releases a blue toy car onto the cardboard ramp propped against the stack of books. They retrieve it and return it to the raised end for repeated runs down the slope. After the car reaches the table in front of the ramp, they pick it up and hold it between both hands beside the ramp.

A person moves a small green toy car across a worn green tabletop and brings it back beside a white cutting board. They lift the board from the left and set it flat near the center, then place the car on its surface. Keeping their fingers on the toy, they push it from the board left side toward the right edge and continue guiding it there.

A person pulls a small blue toy car backward across a patterned tablecloth, then releases it to travel toward the large book at the right. They repeat the backward pull and release twice more, returning the car to the same area beside the book after each run. The blue mug, knife and small white item stay along the back of the table.

A person stands a short round tub on its edge and sends it spinning across the dark tabletop. As it wobbles and drops onto its flat base, they catch it, lift it onto its edge, and spin it again. After repeating the movement, they steady the tub and leave it flat in front of them beside the small bottles.

A person lays a capped plastic water bottle on its side on a red-covered table and pushes it into a short roll. They repeatedly bring it back toward the left and send it rolling across the same area again. The bottle stays on its side throughout, while a notebook and an upside-down bowl topped with a small green vegetable remain at the back.

A person lays a capped white bottle on its side at the right edge of a wooden cutting board, which is raised on a dark book. They release the bottle and it rolls across the board to the left, where their other hand waits. They retrieve it and repeat the roll, then return the bottle to the raised right edge once more.

A person lifts a clear pitcher and tips its spout over two square glass vessels in turn, leaving water visible in both. They return the pitcher to the lower left of the table. They then pick up the middle square vessel, tilt it above the round glass on the right, and set it back down at an angle between the other two vessels.

A hand lowers a short wooden cylinder onto its side at the right of the table and releases it to roll left toward the small yellow container. The person retrieves it, brings it back beside the blue lid, and rolls it across again. They repeat the same movement once more, while the box and plate remain in place.

A hand presents three small mugs one at a time over a patterned tablecloth: a white floral mug, a brown-and-white mug, and a mug with a black line pattern. Each is taken away before the next appears. The person then shows a clear blue-capped pen, a black pen, and the blue-capped pen again, leaving the notebook and green bottle undisturbed at the back.

The person presents a flower-decorated mug, a thick dark marker, and a pale-yellow book one at a time, removing each before bringing the next into view. They then hold up a slim pen, followed by a mug with a black rectangular design and a taller white mug with a single black symbol. Each object is held above the patterned table and then taken away.

A person holds a white floral mug above the table, turns it, and removes it from view. They then present a metal cup, a blue invoice book, and a long black notebook one after another, withdrawing each before showing the next. Returning to the earlier objects, they display the floral mug again with its opening visible, followed by the invoice book with its blue cover facing the camera.

A person sets a small patterned mug upright near the back of a turquoise embroidered cloth. They bring in four more matching mugs one at a time, placing each beside the previous one. The five mugs form a diagonal row extending toward the front-right, while a red candle in a white holder remains at the left.

A person moves a red and white mug from the back of the table to the front left, leaving it upright. They place a checked mug upside down beside it, then invert a larger red floral mug to extend the row. They finish by lifting the remaining white mug covered in black words and holding it upright to the right of the arranged cups.

A seated person lifts a folded light blue T-shirt and holds its printed front toward the camera before returning it behind a small potted cactus. They then present a metal fork across their palm and lay it on the table. Finally, they hold out a white charger and coiled cable, then set them back beside the fork and the other tabletop items.

A seated person holds out a dark clothes hanger and lays it across the far end of the white table. They next present a coiled black cable and put it in the middle, below the hanger. Finally, they show a green-covered paperback and set it flat closer to the camera, beside the clear bottle.

A person lifts a burgundy shirt, holds it open and turns it before dropping it onto the gray table. They add a green cap with a red and white brim near the front edge, then lay a looped white cable across it. Finally, they show a thick paperback close to the camera and place it on top of the cable and cap.

Beside a folding table holding a glass and a white bottle, a person lays a white cable across the tabletop. They add a small handbag on the right, leaving its long strap hanging down, then drape a black garment over the front edge. Finally, they bring over a closed notebook with a yellow ribbon and lower it onto the crowded table before stepping away.

The person sets a folded green shirt on the table, unfolds it, and holds it spread out with the printed design facing forward. They fold it into a small stack again and lay it down. A black fabric item with blue edging is placed on top, followed by a fork laid across the pile.

The person moves the two small books to the left and rests one end of the thick white book on them to make a slope. They shift the coffee tin to the right of the raised book. Holding a small cork with a dark base, they release it near the raised end, retrieve it near the lower end, and repeat the movement.

The person fills an open cardboard box, first lowering a clear container and then the patterned mug into it. They move the books from the tabletop into the box in small stacks and add the black stapler. Next, they lift the tall glass carafe and place it upright inside. They fold the lid downward, but it remains angled above the box when their hands withdraw.

The person lays a white paperback horizontally across the top of an upright black bottle, keeping one hand against the bottle as they position it. After letting the book rest there, they bring a rounded black object over it. They place the object on the book and lift their upper hand away while the stack remains upright.

A seated person shifts a thick dark book forward on a patterned surface, then lifts a second illustrated book and holds it above the table. With their free hand, they place a loose white sheet across the dark book and smooth it flat. They lower the illustrated book onto the paper, forming a stack with the white sheet between the two books.

A person lifts the small book from the cabinet and opens it above the larger book lying underneath. They pick up the pale rectangular slip, lay it between the pages and close the small book. They move it toward the red bag, open the bag’s top and lower their hands at the opening before letting go and stepping back.

A person lays a capped plastic water bottle on its side on a red-covered table and pushes it into a short roll. They repeatedly bring it back toward the left and send it rolling across the same area again. The bottle stays on its side throughout, while a notebook and an upside-down bowl topped with a small green vegetable remain at the back.

A person lays a capped white bottle on its side at the right edge of a wooden cutting board, which is raised on a dark book. They release the bottle and it rolls across the board to the left, where their other hand waits. They retrieve it and repeat the roll, then return the bottle to the raised right edge once more.

A hand lays a blue-capped plastic bottle on its side and pushes it across the wooden tabletop toward the shallow gray bowl. The bottle is brought back toward the near edge and rolled again several times. The hand alternates between catching it and releasing it, while the mug and narrow red bottle stay in place.

A person pushes a white cylinder lying on its side across a dark-covered table, lets it roll, and moves it back for another release. They repeat the rolling motion, then reach behind the cylinder and lift a clear bottle out of view. They give the cylinder another push, leaving it resting horizontally near the front while a black toy car and small colored sticks remain nearby.

A person lays a brown spiral notebook at an angle across the small book stack, then stands a thick dark hardback upright to its right. They bring a clear blue-capped bottle onto the notebook and release it on its side. The bottle rolls off toward the open tabletop, and the person retrieves it and repeats the roll before bringing it back to the notebook.

A person presents a brown mug with a black interior above the floral table covering and takes it away. They show a metal spoon next, followed by a shallow metal plate, withdrawing each between views. Finally, they hold up a bunched olive garment with orange ties and then dark denim fabric before removing both from view.

A person holds a white floral mug above the table, turns it, and removes it from view. They then present a metal cup, a blue invoice book, and a long black notebook one after another, withdrawing each before showing the next. Returning to the earlier objects, they display the floral mug again with its opening visible, followed by the invoice book with its blue cover facing the camera.

A person briefly holds a long metal utensil over the table and removes it from view. They show a looped white cable next, followed by a white plate with a green floral design. Finally, they raise a gray mug by its handle with its base facing the camera, then take it away.

The person presents a flower-decorated mug, a thick dark marker, and a pale-yellow book one at a time, removing each before bringing the next into view. They then hold up a slim pen, followed by a mug with a black rectangular design and a taller white mug with a single black symbol. Each object is held above the patterned table and then taken away.

A seated person brings the orange cup to the front of the table, then places the blue-lined white cup upside down behind it. They add the white mug with lettering upright and move the purple mug behind that, upside down. Finally, they lift the wide yellow-patterned mug and hold it above the table while reaching toward the camera with their other hand.

Beside a folding table holding a glass and a white bottle, a person lays a white cable across the tabletop. They add a small handbag on the right, leaving its long strap hanging down, then drape a black garment over the front edge. Finally, they bring over a closed notebook with a yellow ribbon and lower it onto the crowded table before stepping away.

A seated person holds out a dark clothes hanger and lays it across the far end of the white table. They next present a coiled black cable and put it in the middle, below the hanger. Finally, they show a green-covered paperback and set it flat closer to the camera, beside the clear bottle.

A person lays a dark garment across the back of a white table. They bring in a patterned blue and black bag, stand it on the garment, and leave its straps draped forward. They then place a thick paperback leaning against the bag, while a wooden handled knife remains across a blue smartphone near the front edge.

A person lifts a white sheet from a pile of clothes, folds it, and stands it on the glass tabletop. They then pick up dark trousers, fold them into a compact rectangle, and set them down on the right. A dark blue printed shirt is folded next and placed on top of the trousers beside the open laptop.

A person opens a pale fabric tote on a glass table beside a laptop. They take out a clear spray bottle, a coiled white cable, and a black wallet, setting them along the front of the table. After reaching into the bag again, they lift it by its upper edges and hold its printed side facing outward.

A person rearranges a stack of orange-covered books on a dark table, then lifts a white adapter and connects it to the wall socket above. They separate and restack the books, leaving a white-covered volume on top. Next, they repeatedly lift and set down a small white corded device attached to the adapter, with its coiled cable hanging between the socket and tabletop.

A person opens a paperback on the table and points along the printed pages. They reach to the wall-mounted electrical connection, handle it, and return their hand to the book. They then pick up a black hair dryer and hold its nozzle toward the open book; several pages rise and shift while the dryer remains raised beside it.

A person pulls on long cords looped around a small cylindrical object resting beside a paperback. They lift the cylinder, place it on the book, and draw it toward the table edge. After repositioning the cords around it with both hands, they repeat the movement across the book and pull the cylinder off to the left again.

The person holds a small red hair dryer in one hand while moving the books beside the power strip with the other. They place the blue spiral notebook near the center of the table, add the brown book, and put the larger dark binder on top, exposing a gray cloth beneath the original stack. They then return both hands to the dryer and adjust their grip.

The person opens a book on the blue storage-box lid and moves a glass of clear liquid onto its pages. They plug the white desk lamp into the wall socket, then adjust the open book beneath the glass. Finally, they press the switch on the lamp cord, and a bright patch of light appears across the pages.

A person lays a brown spiral notebook at an angle across the small book stack, then stands a thick dark hardback upright to its right. They bring a clear blue-capped bottle onto the notebook and release it on its side. The bottle rolls off toward the open tabletop, and the person retrieves it and repeats the roll before bringing it back to the notebook.

A person leans a spiral notebook against a small stack of books to form a ramp, then stands an ornate book upright nearby. They release a clear plastic bottle with a blue cap down the notebook, retrieve it from the right side of the table, and repeat the motion. The sequence ends with another release onto the sloping notebook.

A person brings a clear plastic bottle close to the camera and releases it on its side to roll across the wooden table toward the notebooks. They retrieve the bottle, then lift the spiral notebook stack away from the far end. Bringing the bottle back to the near edge, they send it rolling across the cleared space again.

A person lays a small clear jar of yellow liquid on its side near the right end of a book and releases it to roll across the cover. They repeatedly retrieve the jar from the left, return it to the right and let it roll again. After the last run, they move the jar beside the notebook pile, leaving the book clear in front of them.

A hand lifts a clear blue-capped plastic bottle and lays it sideways on a thick book. When released, the bottle rolls forward over the book’s near edge and onto the tabletop close to the camera. The person retrieves it and repeats the release several times, ending with the bottle rolling into the foreground again.

A seated person holds both hands open above the patterned tablecloth, brings the palms together, and separates them. They repeatedly clap, pausing at times with their fingers curled into fists before opening their hands again. The silver cylindrical tin and orange remain together on the pink cloth at the left throughout the hand movements.

A seated person raises their hands from the wooden table and repeatedly claps, bringing the palms together and separating them in front of their chest. They pause with the hands pressed together between movements, then resume several more times. At the end, both hands lower toward the tabletop beside the stationary plants and ornaments.

Seated behind a low table, a person claps their hands repeatedly, changing the angle of their palms as they meet. They pause with both hands lowered near the tabletop and then resume clapping before lowering them again. Blue scissors and a long blue pen resting diagonally on a small upright box remain undisturbed in front of them.

Seated on an orange-covered sofa with a reddish cloth over their lap, the person repeatedly brings their open palms together and separates them. Their hands continue clapping in front of their body before coming together in a loose clasp at the end.

A seated person raises both hands above a pale tablecloth and repeatedly brings their palms together over the middle of the table. Between claps, they spread their arms outward and turn their open palms toward the camera. They finish by lowering both hands near the back edge, while the capped bottle at the left and clear jars at the right remain still.

A person lifts the tall clear bottle and unscrews its white cap. Holding the turquoise cup in the other hand, they tilt the bottle so its mouth rests over the cup's rim, then return both upright. They replace the cap and stand the bottle on the table before raising the cup out of view and setting it back down.

A person lifts the clear bottle, twists off its cap, and sets the cap beside the mug. They tip the open bottle over the mug while steadying the mug with the other hand, then return the bottle upright on the table. The mug is raised beyond the top of the frame and later set back down, leaving the bottle uncapped.

A hand unscrews the metal cap from the clear bottle and removes it. The person lifts the open bottle, tilts its mouth over the stemless glass, and stands it upright again. They then pick up the glass and raise it out of view before returning it to the table beside the uncapped bottle.

A hand removes the blue cap from the clear plastic bottle and briefly lifts the blue mug out of view before putting it back. The bottle is then tilted over the mug, pouring a stream of clear liquid into it. Finally, the bottle returns upright to the table and the cap is put back on.

A person picks up a round lid and fits it onto a small white jar on the table. They then reach between the two bottles and handle the opening of the large clear plastic bottle, which remains open. Finally, they lift the broad white cap from the table and balance it across the mouth of the smaller glass bottle.

A person takes lettuce from the plate, tears the leaves apart with both hands, and drops the pieces into the patterned bowl. They add tomato slices and then cucumber rounds from the plate, arranging them over the lettuce while some slices remain behind. Finally, they lift and move the small translucent container at the back of the counter.

A person places lettuce leaves on a blue-and-white patterned plate and adds small red-skinned apple pieces near the upper edge. They tip a bottle of yellow oil over the lettuce, then shake white granules from a spoon onto the leaves. Using the spoon, they lift and turn the lettuce, shifting the leaves around the plate with the apple pieces beside them.

A person tears lettuce onto a square plate and adds pieces of orange pepper from a smaller plate. They lift corn from a glass with a fork and add it to the lettuce, then tip a capped green bottle over the plate before standing it back up. After sprinkling white granules from a bowl with their fingers, they mix the vegetables with the fork and return it to the smaller plate.

The person lifts the sheet of paper and pulls it apart, leaving a crumpled piece on the table. They then tear the lettuce into smaller sections and set the pieces down at the back of the table. Returning to the paper, they tear it into more pieces and leave a loose pile in front of the lettuce.

A person pulls a white sheet apart with both hands and leaves the pieces on the counter. They pick up a green lettuce leaf, tear off a smaller piece, and put both pieces down beside the paper. They then tear more white paper into smaller fragments, leaving a loose pile near the larger sheet and the lettuce.

A person uncaps the blue pen and draws on a small white sheet while holding the paper steady. They lay the pen down and lift the sheet close to the camera, showing an outlined triangle beside a square. After returning the paper to the table, they pick up a dark blue square and turquoise triangle and present the colored cutouts together.

A woman draws on a white sheet with a blue pen, then raises the page to show a circle on the left and a triangle on the right. She sets the paper down and adds a small colored paper triangle over the left side of the page. A blue plastic cap is placed on the right side, and her hand withdraws with both objects resting on the drawing.

A person uses a blue pen to draw a small circle, a larger circle, and a triangle in a row on white paper, then raises the sheet to show the shapes. After laying it down, they put a red cap over the small circle, a green triangular piece over the larger circle, and a yellow lid over the drawn triangle.

A person draws simple outlines on a sheet of white paper with a blue pen, then lifts the sheet to show the shapes. They place it on a larger white board and steady it with one hand. Dark geometric cutouts are set along the top of the paper, forming a short row before the hands move away.

A person draws a square and a circle on a white sheet resting over a book, then holds the paper upright to show both outlines. They lay it flat again and place a blue round piece over the left drawing. A red rounded rectangular piece is added over the right drawing, and both pieces remain on the paper beside the marker.

A person bends down at an open doorway and places a small white plastic bag and a brown ball on the tiled floor. They bring a wooden chair over and set it beside the doorway, then step to the wall and swing the door toward the objects. As the door closes, the bag and ball shift behind the chair and door, disappearing from the open floor space.

A person walks to an open doorway and places a white plastic bag and a small crumpled brown object on the tiled floor. They carry a wooden chair into the doorway and set it beside the objects, then pull the door toward them by its handle. The door comes partway across the opening beside the chair, and the person walks away to the left.

A person puts a pink pouch on the floor beside the open door, drops a book next to it, and stands a clear bottle nearby. They carry in a wooden chair and set it in the doorway. As the door swings inward across the objects, the bottle falls and rolls to the left, while the book and pouch end up beside the chair and the door remains partly open.

A person crouches by a closed kitchen door to place a pale shoe and a small translucent jug on the floor. They bring over a white metal chair, set it beside the objects, and add a small bottle near the jug. When they swing the door inward, it shifts the chair and nearby floor objects toward the left, while the jug ends up beside their feet.

A person crouches in the doorway and lays a white sheet of paper on the wooden floor near the open door. They spread a translucent plastic bag beside it and set a small white cup on its side in front of the bag. The door then swings across the scattered items, pushing the cup and bag out of view while the paper remains visible on the left.

A person writes large letters on a small white sheet while holding it steady on the table. They lift the paper to show the writing and then put it back down. Still holding the pen, they display white letter cutouts one at a time and lay them in a vertical row to the sheet's left, leaving the red pencil in the container behind.

A person picks up a pen and makes short writing movements on a sheet of white paper while steadying the page with their other hand. After putting the pen down, they take large colored letter pieces one at a time and arrange them along the paper's right edge. They adjust the last piece and withdraw their hands, leaving the letters beside the page.

The person picks up a pen and makes marks on a small white sheet on the table. They lift the sheet to show it, then return it beside the pen. Next, they display red letter cutouts one at a time, placing V, C, and U in a row closer to the camera while the cup and green plate stay at the back.

A person moves an orange pen across a white sheet, then lays the pen down and raises the paper to show its unmarked surface. They return the sheet to the dark table and begin arranging small pink and white letter pieces beside it. The letters are added one at a time until they form the row LUPER to the right of the blank sheet.

A person makes short strokes with a silver pen on a lined sheet, then lifts the sheet toward the camera and lays it back on the table. They hold up a small printed lowercase n, followed by an a, placing each cutout near the paper. They then bring a third letter cutout forward between their fingers and lower it alongside the others.

A person lifts a gray garment from a pile on a covered table, folds it, and places it near the back. They fold a white garment over it, smoothing the new stack with both hands. Next, they pick up a dark striped shirt, fold it, and add it on top, while a blue garment remains spread separately at the front.

A person takes the light gray garment from the top of a clothing pile, folds it, and sets it at the front of the table. They fold the white garment with orange and dark stripes and stack it on the gray one, then add folded camouflage clothing on top. Dark gray clothes remain at the back, with the pomegranate, book, and yellow boxes undisturbed on the right.

A person folds a pink knitted garment into a pile on the table, then folds a gray garment and places it over the pink one. They briefly move the green knitwear aside while adding a dark navy garment to the stack. The green garment is folded and placed on top last, building a tall pile in front of the clear pitcher and fuzzy slippers.

A person moves clothing from the far end of a checkered table into a stack at the front. They fold and lay down a teal printed shirt, add an orange shirt, then place a red shirt over it. A dark knitted garment with a brown pattern is added last, while the kettle, wallet and bottles remain standing on the left.

A person sorts a pile on a wooden table, gathering a white garment and then folding a striped towel over it on the right. They fold a gray item and add it to the stack. Next, they crease a sheet of white paper and stand it on top before gathering the last white cloth and placing it with the folded items.

A person operates the black switch beside a desk lamp, turning the lamp on brightly above a striped mug and open papers. They turn a page beneath the light and briefly move their hands over the desk. After pressing the switch again, the lamp goes dark; they turn another page and lower their hands beside the stack of books.

A person rests a hand on an open book beside a lit desk lamp, then reaches down and pulls the lamp's plug from the wall socket. The bulb goes dark, and the loose plug is laid on the table. The person repeatedly presses the lamp's base while keeping the other hand on the book, then begins turning a page.

The person opens a book on the blue storage-box lid and moves a glass of clear liquid onto its pages. They plug the white desk lamp into the wall socket, then adjust the open book beneath the glass. Finally, they press the switch on the lamp cord, and a bright patch of light appears across the pages.

A person picks up and releases the inline switch of a pink lamp, then opens a small notebook and closes it again. They handle the switch once more, touch the wall plug, and briefly reopen the notebook. Finally, they operate the inline switch again; the lamp illuminates brightly through its pink shade and stays lit as the switch is set down.

A seated person holds an open book near a white plate beside a wooden floor lamp. They lower the book, reach toward the plate, and lift a round control attached to a red cord before letting it rest on the plate again. The book is raised open once more, then closed and laid on the seat beside them.

A hand brings the red-and-yellow tennis ball toward the left edge and releases it to roll across the red tabletop toward the books. The person then slides the books away, clearing the right side. They retrieve the ball, bring it back to the left, and send it rolling across the open space again while the toy car stays balanced on the jar.

A person releases a small orange ball onto the yellow book propped on stacked red books. It rolls down the ramp toward the large red book standing like a tent. The ball is then visible on the table on the other side of the red book, where the person reaches for it. They retrieve it near the table edge and return it to the yellow ramp.

A person pushes a tennis ball across a round red table, where it comes to rest near the open notebook at the front. They lift the notebook away and hold it in one hand while bringing the ball back to the right side. Another push sends the ball rolling across the cleared table and off the left edge, leaving the hand extended over the empty surface.

The person rests one end of the gray rectangular board on the stack of books, making a shallow slope, and moves the small box forward beside it. They place the tennis ball near the raised end and let it roll along the board. They retrieve the ball and repeat the motion, ending with another release near the top of the slope.

A person pushes an orange toy sports car from the left side of the table toward a thick book on the right, letting it roll freely across the cloth. They pick up the car and return it to the left, then repeat the push. After retrieving it once more, they send it rolling toward the book a third time.

A person picks up objects from a row on a white-covered table, holding each toward the camera before taking it away. They display a pink marker, a pink-handled spoon, a blue pen, a pink-handled knife, and a matching fork in that order. Finally, they show the remaining gray marker with a red cap and remove it, leaving the tabletop clear.

Over a dark wooden desk, a hand presents several objects one at a time: a clear plastic cup, a bright pink square note, a cigarette packet, a small box of staples, and a white pen. Each item is held toward the camera briefly and then taken away before the next appears. The desk surface remains clear at the end.

A hand brings a pink plastic cup into the foreground, holds it upright, and removes it. A flower-patterned glass and a paperback with an egg illustration are displayed in the same way. The person repeats the displays with the cup, book, and glass in that order, while a green plush pig, black toy car, and pink packet remain along the back of the table.

A person picks up a dark pen from a wooden table and holds it horizontally between both hands, then puts it back. They repeat the display with a second dark pen before lifting a metal spoon and holding it across their hands in the same way. The spoon is returned beside the pens, while another utensil stays resting across the red container at the left.

A hand picks up the black-and-white pen and displays it across an open palm before returning it to the counter. The cream-handled knife is lifted and shown next, followed by the clear-bodied pen. Finally, the blue pencil is held up in the same way and set back beside the other objects.

A person places an iron on the floor near the open doorway, adds a white cup, and brings in a metal chair beside them. They stand a small clear bottle near the door's edge and pull the door inward toward the chair. The door remains partly open, and when it is moved outward again, the bottle lies on its side near the iron and cup.

A person lays a small orange-filled bottle on its side on the floor beside an open door, then places a white envelope next to it. They add a large red cylindrical tin on its side near the envelope. As the door swings across the floor, the bottle and tin shift toward the right side of the doorway and the envelope is partly caught beneath the door's edge.

A person puts a pink pouch on the floor beside the open door, drops a book next to it, and stands a clear bottle nearby. They carry in a wooden chair and set it in the doorway. As the door swings inward across the objects, the bottle falls and rolls to the left, while the book and pouch end up beside the chair and the door remains partly open.

A person crouches by a closed kitchen door to place a pale shoe and a small translucent jug on the floor. They bring over a white metal chair, set it beside the objects, and add a small bottle near the jug. When they swing the door inward, it shifts the chair and nearby floor objects toward the left, while the jug ends up beside their feet.

A person carries a round wooden stool into an open doorway and sets it just inside. They bend down several times to arrange a flat white packet and small objects on the floor beside it, including a dark bottle left standing upright. After straightening up, they swing the door closed, hiding the items and most of the stool, then turn and step away.

A person tears a white sheet into two sections and leaves them on the counter beside the large glass. They pick up the small green leaf, pull at it with both hands, and set it down again. Returning to one paper section, they fold and bend it repeatedly, tear off smaller pieces, and drop the scraps beside the remaining strip.

A person pulls a white sheet apart with both hands and leaves the pieces on the counter. They pick up a green lettuce leaf, tear off a smaller piece, and put both pieces down beside the paper. They then tear more white paper into smaller fragments, leaving a loose pile near the larger sheet and the lettuce.

A person holds a small sheet of white paper above a dark kitchen counter and tears it with both hands. They rotate and pull the paper apart repeatedly, setting the separated scraps near a coiled cable and a knife. They pick up the pieces again and tear them into smaller sections, leaving several irregular white scraps spread on the counter.

A person tears a long printed sheet into two pieces and leaves them beside a small blue packet. They pick up the small tan object on the right, pull it apart, and put the pieces down. Returning to the paper, they tear both sections into narrower strips and leave the strips spread across the table.

A person lifts a handwritten sheet from a kitchen counter and tears it apart with both hands, leaving the pieces in front of them. They pick up a pale cabbage leaf, pull off a section, and put the leaf pieces down beside the paper. They then tear the paper again and release the smaller scraps onto the counter.

A hand takes the green marker and writes “CAR” on the white sheet, then lays the marker across the small cup. The person raises the sheet to show the word and lowers it again. They next hold up multicolored letter cutouts, standing a T in front of the glass and an E beside the teapot before bringing a Z into view.

The person picks up a pen and makes marks on a small white sheet on the table. They lift the sheet to show it, then return it beside the pen. Next, they display red letter cutouts one at a time, placing V, C, and U in a row closer to the camera while the cup and green plate stay at the back.

A person raises a pale paper letter D in front of the camera and lowers it out of view to the left. They display an E, then a K, handling each briefly before taking it away. They finish by holding up a pale triangular cutout and lowering it, while the clear glass, egg carton, and tea box stay on the counter.

A hand holds a pale letter A above the table and withdraws it, then presents a purple B in the same spot. The person continues with a yellow C and a green D, showing each letter separately by its top edge. The spice jar, figurines, and small blue bottle remain on the table as the final cutout is taken away.

A hand holds a yellow cutout letter D close to the camera and places it flat on the wooden table. The person then displays a letter E cut from multicolored printed card and sets it beside the D. A yellow F is added at the right, leaving the three letters arranged in alphabetical order in front of the small clock, tin, and pink cup.

A person lifts the left of two clear inverted cups, revealing a small green piece, then lifts the right cup to show the bare cloth beneath it. They replace both cups and slide them around with crossed hands. Lifting them again reveals the green piece beneath the left cup, and both cups are finally set down upside down.

A person lifts three upside-down white cups one at a time, showing a small dark object beneath the cup on the right. They put the cups down and slide them around with both hands. After rearranging them, they lift the cups again, revealing the object under the middle cup before returning all three to an inverted row.

A person lifts the left of two inverted clear cups, revealing a small green loop, and replaces it. They lift the right cup to show the empty tabletop underneath, then slide both cups around one another. After setting them side by side again, they reveal the green loop beneath the left cup and the empty space beneath the right before putting both cups down.

A person lifts three inverted white cups in turn, revealing a small pale blue ball beneath the middle cup and empty spaces under the outer cups, then covers them again. They slide and exchange the cups with both hands before returning them to a row. They lift each cup again, showing the ball under the middle one, and finish with all three inverted.

A person lifts each of two inverted yellow cups, showing empty space beneath the left cup and a small white bottle beneath the right, then covers both positions again. They slide the cups forward and closer together on the counter. They repeat the reveals in the same order, with the bottle still beneath the right cup, and finish with both cups inverted.

A hand places a clear ribbed cup upright near the front-left of the black tabletop. A tall decorated yellow tumbler is added behind it to the right, followed by a plain pale yellow cup farther right. Finally, the person sets a white printed mug upside down at the back-right end, leaving four vessels arranged diagonally across the table.

A person sets a tall patterned cup with a yellow rim on the gray table, then adds a white cup with green leaves beside it. A clear glass is placed in front of the yellow-rimmed cup. The final cup, decorated with small stars, is set upside down to the right of the glass, forming a second row.

A seated person brings the orange cup to the front of the table, then places the blue-lined white cup upside down behind it. They add the white mug with lettering upright and move the purple mug behind that, upside down. Finally, they lift the wide yellow-patterned mug and hold it above the table while reaching toward the camera with their other hand.

A person moves a red and white mug from the back of the table to the front left, leaving it upright. They place a checked mug upside down beside it, then invert a larger red floral mug to extend the row. They finish by lifting the remaining white mug covered in black words and holding it upright to the right of the arranged cups.

A person places a white mug on the black counter and adds a clear glass mug to its left. They set another white mug upside down in front of them, then bring in a tall drinking glass and place it nearer the front edge. Finally, they add a smaller clear handled cup at the back left of the group.

A person sets a dark blue spiky ball on the white tabletop and withdraws their hand. A person lifts the large clear bottle from the table, holds it up, and returns it upright. They do the same with the smaller bottle of dark liquid and then the green glass bottle. Finally, they raise the white plate holding a yellow piece of food toward the camera and set it back on the left.

A person kneels beside a wall socket while holding a plugged-in silver and dark hair dryer in one hand and a pen in the other. A person kneeling beside a hair dryer brings their palms together and separates them above the wooden floor. They reach to the wall socket and grip the dryer's plug, then return to the dryer, lift it by its handle and set it down again with the nozzle pointing left. A seated person picks up a red-and-black hair dryer from the floor and points it toward a nearby stack of notebooks and loose papers. A person holds a corded black hair clipper beside a wall socket, turning it so its comb attachment faces the camera. They continue handling both objects and bring the pen closer to the clipper, while the cord stays plugged into the socket.

A seated person stirs a gray mug with a spoon and lays the spoon on the tiled floor. They plug a black hair dryer's cord into the wall, stir the mug again, and return the spoon to the floor. They then lift the dryer, hold its nozzle horizontally toward the right, and shift their fingers along its handle while keeping it raised.

A person holds up a dark pair of briefs, folds it inward, and places it on the left side of a table. Finally, they lift a black garment from the remaining clothes, gather it together, and put it on the stack.

A person brings a pair of burgundy trainers to the glass table and sets them side by side. They hold up black shorts by the waistband, then lay them over the shoes. Next, they spread a pair of beige briefs between their hands and place them on top of the shorts, building a pile beside the blue mug.

A person holds up a pair of black lace-up shoes and places them side by side on a white bedside table with the toes facing forward. They raise gray trousers and drape them over the shoes, leaving the legs hanging over the front edge. They then display dark patterned underwear with lace edging and lay it across the top of the trousers.

A person holds up a white bra and places it on the right side of a wooden table, then shows a paperback book and lays it beside the bra. A person moves a wooden rolling pin from the dark table onto the plate at the right. A seated person touches the blue lid of a translucent pitcher, grips its neck and tilts it to pour water into a clear glass on a small table. They set the pitcher upright and touch the lid again. A person unscrews the blue cap from a water bottle and pours clear liquid into the ribbed glass held in the other hand. They recap the bottle and stand it on the table. A person lifts a clear pitcher and tips its spout over two square glass vessels in turn, leaving water visible in both. They return the pitcher to the lower left of the table. A person lifts a metal kettle and pours water into two short glasses on a coffee table. They set the kettle down, bring a stemmed glass forward and tip one short glass over it to transfer some water. A person lifts the blue patterned jug and pours clear liquid into the two wide glasses on the right, moving it over the taller left glass before setting it down. After tipping and rotating the emptied glass above it, they hold the glass toward the camera and return it between the other two.

A person lifts a black hair dryer from a red-covered table and holds it with its nozzle angled upward. A seated person stirs a gray mug with a spoon and lays the spoon on the tiled floor. They plug a black hair dryer's cord into the wall, stir the mug again, and return the spoon to the floor. A seated person brings their hands together above the table and separates them, then reaches back to the side shelf. A seated person picks up a red-and-black hair dryer from the floor and points it toward a nearby stack of notebooks and loose papers. A person lifts the blue patterned jug and pours clear liquid into the two wide glasses on the right, moving it over the taller left glass before setting it down. A person pours clear liquid from a pink-lidded pitcher into the right pink cup, then fills the matching cup beside it. A person holds up a pair of black lace-up shoes and places them side by side on a white bedside table with the toes facing forward. The person stretches the gray trousers along the table and folds them into a shorter rectangle. They set a pair of white sneakers side by side on the folded trousers. Next, they hold a dark striped garment across the shoes, fold it inward, and leave it resting on top of the pair.

A hand rises over a white table and presents a green lime on an open palm, then withdraws. A hand presents a yellow lemon over a pale patterned tablecloth, then takes it out of view. The person repeats the display with a red apple and then a long dark green cucumber, removing each afterward. A green cloth and two filled jars remain at the back of the table throughout.

A person holds a yellow lemon in one hand, turns it to show different sides, and brings it close to the camera before setting it on the counter. A person takes a large yellow citrus fruit from a plate, presents it on one palm, and sets it on a gray woven placemat. A person lifts a bottle of dark liquid and twists its orange cap while holding the bottle beside a tall clear glass. A person unscrews the cap from a black bottle and leaves it on the table beside the decorated glass. They tilt the open bottle over the glass, then return it to an upright position. Next, they raise the glass and lower it back onto the table, leaving the bottle uncapped.

A hand unscrews the metal cap from the clear bottle and removes it. The person lifts the open bottle, tilts its mouth over the stemless glass, and stands it upright again. They then pick up the glass and raise it out of view before returning it to the table beside the uncapped bottle.

A person lifts the clear bottle, twists off its cap, and sets the cap beside the mug. A person balances a broad beige lid across the mouth of a tall plastic bottle. They bring a small yellow cap toward another clear bottle, but it drops onto the table. A person places a small stemmed glass upside down on the right side of a dark table, beside a turquoise bowl. They add a second stemmed glass upright just in front of it. A person unscrews the cap from a black bottle and leaves it on the table beside the decorated glass. They tilt the open bottle over the glass, then return it to an upright position. Next, they raise the glass and lower it back onto the table, leaving the bottle uncapped.

A person unscrews the blue cap from a water bottle and pours clear liquid into the ribbed glass held in the other hand. They recap the bottle and stand it on the table. A person opens a yellow paperback, picks up banknotes from the table, and places them between its pages before closing it and setting it down. A person moves a small green toy car across a worn green tabletop and brings it back beside a white cutting board.
