Holding the ball at the right edge, they lift the book away with their other hand. They then release the ball across the cleared tabletop for another roll.

A person sets a small pale ball on a black notebook and lifts its right edge, making the ball roll off to the left. They retrieve the ball, replace it, and tilt the notebook again so it rolls away once more. They return the notebook flat and leave the ball on top, beside a white mug and a red bowl standing on a wrapped loaf of bread.

A person walks to an open doorway and places a white plastic bag and a small crumpled brown object on the tiled floor. They carry a wooden chair into the doorway and set it beside the objects, then pull the door toward them by its handle. The door comes partway across the opening beside the chair, and the person walks away to the left.

A person bends down at an open doorway and places a small white plastic bag and a brown ball on the tiled floor. They bring a wooden chair over and set it beside the doorway, then step to the wall and swing the door toward the objects. As the door closes, the bag and ball shift behind the chair and door, disappearing from the open floor space.

A person places small objects on the floor near an open doorway, including a white-and-pink toy car and a black remote control. They leave briefly and return carrying a wooden chair, which they set in the doorway behind the objects. Then they swing the door toward the chair, leaving it partly open with the small items beside its lower edge.

A barefoot person bends near an open doorway and puts small crumpled white pieces on the tiled floor by the door. They walk away, return carrying a chair, and set it in the doorway beside the sofa. Standing to the right, they swing the door toward the chair, leaving it partly open above the scattered pieces.

A person crouches in the doorway and lays a white sheet of paper on the wooden floor near the open door. They spread a translucent plastic bag beside it and set a small white cup on its side in front of the bag. The door then swings across the scattered items, pushing the cup and bag out of view while the paper remains visible on the left.

A person opens both hands toward the camera, displaying a large dark X across one palm. They close their hands, lower the fists, and move them together in front of their body before opening one hand and then the other. Both palms face forward again, with the large X and a smaller reddish mark on the opposite palm visible, before the hands close and lower.

A person holds both hands in fists near the camera, then opens them with the palms facing upward and fingers spread. They close the hands again, cross their wrists, and move the fists past one another. The hands separate and reopen to show both empty palms before closing and crossing again above the table.

A person opens both hands close to the camera, showing a blue cross on one palm and no mark on the other. They close their hands into fists, move their forearms across one another, and return their hands side by side. They open both palms again and hold them toward the camera, with the cross still visible on the same hand.

A person holds both fists side by side above a wooden table, then opens their palms to show a dark X on one hand. They close the hands again, cross their wrists and bring the fists together, then uncross them. Opening both palms once more, they display the X on the same side of the view before curling their fingers closed again.

The person opens both hands toward the camera, showing a purple cross on one palm. They close their hands into fists and lower their arms beside their body. After bringing both fists forward again, they spread their fingers and hold their palms together, with the same cross still visible.

A pale blue board spans between a small book stack and a white paperback behind a patterned mug. A person places a blue capped marker near the left end and releases it to roll rightward along the board. They return it to the left and repeat the movement, reaching around the mug to retrieve it, then lift the marker away and hold it near the front left edge of the table.

A hand sets a blue-ended marker on a book at the left of a patterned mug and releases it along the sloping blue cover behind the mug. The person retrieves the marker from the right and returns it to the left book. They repeat the rolling movement, with the mug obscuring the middle of its path.

A person rolls a blue ball from the right end of the narrow wooden table toward the yellow book on the left, then retrieves it and repeats the motion. Holding the ball at the right edge, they lift the book away with their other hand. They then release the ball across the cleared tabletop for another roll.

A person gives a blue ball short pushes across the colorful cloth on a small wooden table, picking it up and returning it to the right side between rolls. They remove the yellow book from the left end and hold it on their lap. Another push sends the ball farther across the cleared table toward the left edge of the cloth.

A person lays a blue pen horizontally near the center of a wooden table, beside a printed sheet and a red pen. They bring a white paperback upright in front of the blue pen, hiding it while shifting the book across the table and moving the loose sheet. When they lift the paperback away, the blue pen is visible farther left near the back edge.

Hands bring an orange-and-blue ball over a stack of books on a glass table, release it onto the top book and catch it as it moves off to the left. The person repeatedly returns the ball above the books and lets it bounce across the stack again. They catch it once more and carry it out of view, leaving the boots and slippers undisturbed.

A person releases a small orange ball onto the yellow book propped on stacked red books. It rolls down the ramp toward the large red book standing like a tent. The ball is then visible on the table on the other side of the red book, where the person reaches for it. They retrieve it near the table edge and return it to the yellow ramp.

A person places a blue ball at the raised end of a small yellow book resting against a stack of books. They release it to roll down toward the front of the table, then retrieve it from out of view. They repeat the release twice more, with the last frame showing the ball still moving along the yellow book beside a knife and red-and-gold bag.

A person moves a small gold spiked ball attached to a string across a cluttered tabletop, drawing it toward the left wall. They lay a closed red book over some papers, lift the ball, and set it on the cover. After repositioning it near the right side, they tug the string again, making the ball move across the book and roll off onto the bare table at the left.

A person places a small blue ball on a wooden table beside a tall glass with a spoon across its rim. They hold a paperback upright in front of the ball, keeping it hidden for several moments. They briefly raise the book to reveal the table without the ball visible, then set the book upright again and continue holding it there.

A seated person writes LOVE across a lined notebook page with a red pencil. They then place colored cutouts above the writing one at a time, including an orange L, a brown round piece, an orange rectangular piece, and a dark V. They adjust the pieces into a row and lay the pencil diagonally along the left side of the page before withdrawing their hand.

A person writes LOVE in large capitals on an open lined notebook beside a plate holding a spoon and fork. They bring in four small colored letter shapes one at a time and lay them in a row below the writing. After arranging the pieces, they lift the notebook toward the camera, set it back down, and step away from the table.

A person writes large letters on a small white sheet while holding it steady on the table. They lift the paper to show the writing and then put it back down. Still holding the pen, they display white letter cutouts one at a time and lay them in a vertical row to the sheet's left, leaving the red pencil in the container behind.

A person picks up a pen and makes short writing movements on a sheet of white paper while steadying the page with their other hand. After putting the pen down, they take large colored letter pieces one at a time and arrange them along the paper's right edge. They adjust the last piece and withdraw their hands, leaving the letters beside the page.

A person steadies an open lined notebook and draws a large circle with a black pen, then adds a pointed star outline above it. They show a green triangular cutout and lay it partly across the star’s right edge. Finally, they bring a green rectangular piece over the lower-right of the page and hold it there beside the circle.

A person opens both palms above a wood-patterned table, showing a small blue cross on one palm and an unmarked other hand. They close their fists, cross their forearms and reopen both hands with the cross still on the same palm. After another sweeping hand movement, they display the palms once more and then withdraw their arms from the table.

A person shows both palms over the kitchen counter, with a dark cross drawn on one palm and no mark on the other. They close their hands, lift their arms, and cross their forearms before bringing the fists down again. They open the marked hand while their arms remain crossed, then close it and begin moving their hands apart.

A person holds both fists above a table, then opens their hands to show a red cross on one palm. They close their hands again, briefly cross their forearms, and bring their fists back side by side. At the end, they reopen both palms with the red cross still visible, while the apple and hanger stay on the table.

A person holds two closed fists above a table and opens the hand with a pale green bracelet, showing a small cross drawn on the palm. They close it, move their fists together, and cross their forearms. The same hand opens again with the cross still visible, then closes while the arms remain crossed above a remote and playing-card box.

A person opens both hands close to the camera, showing a blue cross on one palm and no mark on the other. They close their hands into fists, move their forearms across one another, and return their hands side by side. They open both palms again and hold them toward the camera, with the cross still visible on the same hand.

A person places lettuce leaves on a blue-and-white patterned plate and adds small red-skinned apple pieces near the upper edge. They tip a bottle of yellow oil over the lettuce, then shake white granules from a spoon onto the leaves. Using the spoon, they lift and turn the lettuce, shifting the leaves around the plate with the apple pieces beside them.

A person takes lettuce from the plate, tears the leaves apart with both hands, and drops the pieces into the patterned bowl. They add tomato slices and then cucumber rounds from the plate, arranging them over the lettuce while some slices remain behind. Finally, they lift and move the small translucent container at the back of the counter.

A person tears lettuce onto a square plate and adds pieces of orange pepper from a smaller plate. They lift corn from a glass with a fork and add it to the lettuce, then tip a capped green bottle over the plate before standing it back up. After sprinkling white granules from a bowl with their fingers, they mix the vegetables with the fork and return it to the smaller plate.

After rearranging the pink letter cutouts, the person cuts a pale leafy vegetable into small pieces on a plate. They tip chopped orange vegetables from the other plate onto the leaves and set the empty plate aside. They make pinching motions over the food and tilt the dark bottle above it. Finally, they return the bottle upright and use a fork to mix the vegetables together.

A person moves the two bread slices from above the bowl onto the patterned plate and lays them side by side. They place a lettuce leaf on the right slice, then briefly straighten the three colored letters in front of the plate. They add tomato rounds from the bowl onto the lettuce and adjust the topping with both hands, leaving the left bread slice uncovered.

The person presents a flower-decorated mug, a thick dark marker, and a pale-yellow book one at a time, removing each before bringing the next into view. They then hold up a slim pen, followed by a mug with a black rectangular design and a taller white mug with a single black symbol. Each object is held above the patterned table and then taken away.

A person holds a white floral mug above the table, turns it, and removes it from view. They then present a metal cup, a blue invoice book, and a long black notebook one after another, withdrawing each before showing the next. Returning to the earlier objects, they display the floral mug again with its opening visible, followed by the invoice book with its blue cover facing the camera.

A hand presents three small mugs one at a time over a patterned tablecloth: a white floral mug, a brown-and-white mug, and a mug with a black line pattern. Each is taken away before the next appears. The person then shows a clear blue-capped pen, a black pen, and the blue-capped pen again, leaving the notebook and green bottle undisturbed at the back.

A person presents a brown mug with a black interior above the floral table covering and takes it away. They show a metal spoon next, followed by a shallow metal plate, withdrawing each between views. Finally, they hold up a bunched olive garment with orange ties and then dark denim fabric before removing both from view.

Standing behind the blue plaid-covered surface, a person shows a small floral mug and lowers it out of sight. A white mug with a green flower is presented next, followed by a slim pen. They bring up the green-flower mug and pen again before finishing with the floral mug, removing each between displays while the cardboard box stays on the right.

A person places a clear glass lid on the small jar of orange wax and presses it into position. They pick up a short black pen, drop it through the mouth of the tall glass bottle, and leave it lying at the bottom. They then pick up the small white cap and bring it against one end of the silver pen before setting the pieces down beside the jar.

The person places the large white cover across the mouth of the brown bottle, where it overhangs the sides. They then screw a metal lid onto the jar containing yellow liquid. Next, they pick up the small metal cap and lower it into the open jar with reddish contents, leaving that jar uncovered and its larger lid on the table.

A person turns a small dark item between their hands and places it near the white egg. They then hold up a red-capped pen and a black pen in turn, laying them on the table after each display. Finally, they show the orange-handled spoon and set it down to the left of the writing implements.

A person screws a small silver lid onto the round decorated jar. They pick up the gold cap and drop it into the larger open glass jar, then fasten the red lid onto the tall narrow jar. Finally, they balance the wide gray lid across the mouth of the black bottle, where it rests at an angle.

A person unscrews the yellow-topped lid from a translucent bottle and sets it beside the bottle. They also remove the white cap from a smaller labeled container. Leaving both containers open, they pick up a roll of clear tape, turn it in their hands and move it around on the tabletop with their fingertips.

A person turns a white-covered paperback and lays it flat in front of them on a black grid-patterned cloth. They lift an orange towel, fold and square it between both hands, then place it on top of the book. A second blue-and-white paperback is lifted from the left and laid over the towel, leaving the wristwatch separate at the front.

A person slides a blue-and-white paperback forward on a dark patterned tablecloth. They lift a folded orange towel and set it on the book, then pick up a second, white-covered book from the left and lay it across the towel. They straighten the three layers into a small stack beside a white wristwatch.

A person lifts a large blue record book, exposing a thin booklet underneath, and lays the blue book back down near the front of the table. They pick up a thick paperback, turn it in their hands and place it on top of the blue book. A black-and-white checked cloth is then lifted and draped over both books.

A person picks up a banknote, opens the orange paperback beside a red backpack and brings their fingers toward its pages. They close that book and leave it on the table. They lift the other orange paperback from the foreground and place it in the open backpack, pressing it down before folding the broad bag panel over the opening.

A person gathers the books into a stack on a small table, placing the pale book on top of the red one. They move a black-handled utensil up and down against the top cover. Keeping the utensil in one hand, they lift the white and green hair dryer with the other and turn it above the table.

A person holds a large clear plastic bottle horizontally above a wooden table, turns it upright and sets it at the left behind a black ladle. They present a tall dark glass bottle next and place it on the right. Finally, they show a red apple and lower it onto the table between the two bottles, just behind the ladle's handle.

A person lifts a red apple and positions it between the narrow ends of two green plastic bottles lying on their sides. They repeatedly steady and turn the apple, nudging the bottles and briefly removing their fingers between adjustments. The apple remains between the bottle necks, with the white letter cutouts at the front and the glass vessels and spoon at the back left.

A hand sets a tall frosted glass bottle upright on a yellow patterned cloth. The person adds a dark green bottle beside it, leaving both bottles standing close together. They then hold a red apple toward the camera and lower it onto the cloth in front of the bottles before moving their hand away.

A hand places a clear bottle with a white lid on the right side of the round table. A larger bottle containing yellow-green liquid is brought in horizontally, turned upright, and set to its left. Finally, a large yellow fruit is placed between the bottles, in front of the purple cups.

A person places an orange near the back of a round red table, then sets a clear drinking glass to its right. They add a small white bowl in front of the orange and stand a tall pink bottle beside the glass. Finally, they place a small labeled bottle behind the bowl, leaving the objects spaced across the tabletop.

A person lifts the yellow mug from the glass shelf, showing clear space beneath it, and puts it back. They lift the black mug to reveal a small black key fob with a metal ring, then cover it again. After sliding the two mugs around and returning the black one to the left, they repeat both reveals and replace the mugs.

A person lifts a yellow mug and a black mug from a glass console table in turn, briefly carrying each above the camera's view before returning it. They move the mugs around one another and set them side by side again. Each mug is lifted once more, then returned near a red bottle with a book balanced on its cap.

A person moves a black mug from the back of a wooden table to the front left, then places a white mug beside it. They bring the second black mug forward to the white mug's right, forming a row of three upright mugs. They then reach for the blue plastic cup remaining behind the row and begin lifting it by the rim.

A person moves an upright yellow cup forward from a group of drinkware, then brings a blue patterned mug closer beside it. They add another upright yellow cup in front of the mug. Finally, they lift a third yellow cup, turn it upside down, and set it at the front of the group, leaving a patterned paper cup farther back.

The person presents a flower-decorated mug, a thick dark marker, and a pale-yellow book one at a time, removing each before bringing the next into view. They then hold up a slim pen, followed by a mug with a black rectangular design and a taller white mug with a single black symbol. Each object is held above the patterned table and then taken away.

A person moves a red onion toward the middle of the wooden table, then lifts a printed sheet and bends it upright in front of the onion. They adjust the paper with both hands, hiding the onion behind it. As they raise and shift the sheet, the onion reappears on the right and moves toward the front of the table while the paper remains raised.

Hands fold the sleeves and sides of a red shirt inward and turn it into a compact rectangle at one end of the table. They fold the gray trousers into a small bundle and place it beside the shirt. After briefly rubbing their palms, the person folds the printed sheet into a smaller rectangle, presses its creases and leaves it beneath the two folded garments.

A person places a red tomato on a fruit-patterned tablecloth and adjusts its position. They then hold a black tablet upright in front of it, shifting the tablet from side to side while the tomato is hidden. When the tablet is lifted away, the tomato is visible farther to the right, and the tablet is lowered flat near the front edge of the table.

A person rolls an orange across the wooden table and retrieves it near the front edge. They bring a closed brown book forward and lift the orange onto its cover. The orange is turned and moved over the book, then released on top while the red mug and pale apple remain at the back of the table.

A person lifts a handwritten sheet from a kitchen counter and tears it apart with both hands, leaving the pieces in front of them. They pick up a pale cabbage leaf, pull off a section, and put the leaf pieces down beside the paper. They then tear the paper again and release the smaller scraps onto the counter.

A hand lifts black headphones and a small power adapter off two books and moves them toward an open black bag. The red paperback is placed into the bag, followed by the larger yellow book being raised to the opening. The hand then brings the yellow book back onto the table and retrieves the red paperback, laying it on top again.

A person opens the thick red and gray paperback on a wooden board and places a small blue card between its pages. They close the book and return it to the board, then pick up the pink and blue paperback beside it. This second book is moved toward the black backpack behind the desk, where the person works both hands around the bag's opening.

A person lifts the small book from the cabinet and opens it above the larger book lying underneath. They pick up the pale rectangular slip, lay it between the pages and close the small book. They move it toward the red bag, open the bag’s top and lower their hands at the opening before letting go and stepping back.

The person lifts the top of a dark backpack lying on the table and slides a blue book into the open compartment. They add a thicker book with a dark cover, then an orange book, taking each from the stack beside the bag. After pressing the last book down inside, they lower the top of the backpack and withdraw their hand.

A person picks up a banknote, opens the orange paperback beside a red backpack and brings their fingers toward its pages. They close that book and leave it on the table. They lift the other orange paperback from the foreground and place it in the open backpack, pressing it down before folding the broad bag panel over the opening.

A person places a red tomato on a fruit-patterned tablecloth and adjusts its position. They then hold a black tablet upright in front of it, shifting the tablet from side to side while the tomato is hidden. When the tablet is lifted away, the tomato is visible farther to the right, and the tablet is lowered flat near the front edge of the table.

A person moves a red onion toward the middle of the wooden table, then lifts a printed sheet and bends it upright in front of the onion. They adjust the paper with both hands, hiding the onion behind it. As they raise and shift the sheet, the onion reappears on the right and moves toward the front of the table while the paper remains raised.

A small banana rests near the front of a wooden table while a clear plastic bottle lies on its side beside stacked notebooks farther back. A hand removes the notebooks, then lifts the bottle off the table. The bottle subsequently rolls from the right across the cleared rear portion and disappears from view, while the banana stays in the same place.

A hand stands a tall white bottle in the middle of the covered table. The person lays a thin black-covered book horizontally across its top and lets go, leaving it balanced. They then place a potato near the book's left end; the book tilts slightly but stays on the bottle with the potato on top.

A person holds a pink spiral notebook upright on the table, obscuring the space in front of them. They shift it to the left, revealing their other hand resting on a green ball. They raise the notebook and move the ball beneath it, then lower the notebook back to the tabletop until the ball is hidden behind its cover again.

A person removes a dark brown garment from a white shopping bag, folds it into a bundle, and places it beside the pink slipper on the folding table. They take out two white cylindrical containers and stand them in front of the garment, then add a small white rectangular box. Finally, they gather and crumple the empty bag and leave it at the right end of the table.

A person pulls a dark patterned garment from a brown paper shopping bag and places it beside a tall glass. They take out a pink-and-blue garment and then a navy-and-yellow one, laying both on the first piece of clothing. After the clothes are stacked, they gather and flatten the paper bag into a small folded bundle and leave it to the left of the bottle.

A person gathers a gray item with pink trim into a small bundle and places it at the front of a kitchen table. They fold a black garment and lay it over the bundle, then lift and fold a pale pink top onto the same stack. Finally they pick up a darker pink garment and lower it onto the table to the right of the folded clothes.

A person takes the light gray garment from the top of a clothing pile, folds it, and sets it at the front of the table. They fold the white garment with orange and dark stripes and stack it on the gray one, then add folded camouflage clothing on top. Dark gray clothes remain at the back, with the pomegranate, book, and yellow boxes undisturbed on the right.

A person folds a pink knitted garment into a pile on the table, then folds a gray garment and places it over the pink one. They briefly move the green knitwear aside while adding a dark navy garment to the stack. The green garment is folded and placed on top last, building a tall pile in front of the clear pitcher and fuzzy slippers.

A person lays a capped white bottle on its side at the right edge of a wooden cutting board, which is raised on a dark book. They release the bottle and it rolls across the board to the left, where their other hand waits. They retrieve it and repeat the roll, then return the bottle to the raised right edge once more.

A hand holds a plain white bottle horizontally by its cap above a wooden cutting board. The bottle is released onto its side near the left edge, then retrieved from the right side of the board. The person repeats this sequence twice more, lifting the bottle by the cap and placing it back onto its side on the board.

A person lays a capped plastic water bottle on its side on a red-covered table and pushes it into a short roll. They repeatedly bring it back toward the left and send it rolling across the same area again. The bottle stays on its side throughout, while a notebook and an upside-down bowl topped with a small green vegetable remain at the back.

A person pushes a white cylinder lying on its side across a dark-covered table, lets it roll, and moves it back for another release. They repeat the rolling motion, then reach behind the cylinder and lift a clear bottle out of view. They give the cylinder another push, leaving it resting horizontally near the front while a black toy car and small colored sticks remain nearby.

A person holds a large white board upright in front of a small nail polish bottle on the table. They move the board to the left to reveal the bottle, then slide it back across to hide it again. After repeating this movement, they lift the board away and leave, with the bottle and a mug holding a banana and fork still on the table.

A seated person pushes an orange across the red tablecloth toward the remote control on the right. Once the orange stops nearby, they pick up that remote and place it on the sofa beside them. They retrieve the orange, bring it back toward the left, and roll it across the cleared area again, leaving the bottles and other remote on the table.

A seated person starts a row near the front of the wooden table by placing a red letter R and a dark blue block beside it. They add a blue S, then a red bottle cap to its right. They place a green T next and finish with a purple cap at the far right, withdrawing their hand after each addition while the remote stays behind the row.

A person brings a black remote control to a wooden table, shows its buttons, and sets it beside a small lidded glass jar. They then hold out an empty white ribbed bowl and place it farther to the right. Finally, they display a black sock and lay it on the right side of the bowl, leaving the items spread across the table.

A person rolls an orange across the wooden table and retrieves it near the front edge. They bring a closed brown book forward and lift the orange onto its cover. The orange is turned and moved over the book, then released on top while the red mug and pale apple remain at the back of the table.

A person places an orange near the back of a round red table, then sets a clear drinking glass to its right. They add a small white bowl in front of the orange and stand a tall pink bottle beside the glass. Finally, they place a small labeled bottle behind the bowl, leaving the objects spaced across the tabletop.

A person lays a small orange-filled bottle on its side on the floor beside an open door, then places a white envelope next to it. They add a large red cylindrical tin on its side near the envelope. As the door swings across the floor, the bottle and tin shift toward the right side of the doorway and the envelope is partly caught beneath the door's edge.

A person puts a pink pouch on the floor beside the open door, drops a book next to it, and stands a clear bottle nearby. They carry in a wooden chair and set it in the doorway. As the door swings inward across the objects, the bottle falls and rolls to the left, while the book and pouch end up beside the chair and the door remains partly open.

A person places an iron on the floor near the open doorway, adds a white cup, and brings in a metal chair beside them. They stand a small clear bottle near the door's edge and pull the door inward toward the chair. The door remains partly open, and when it is moved outward again, the bottle lies on its side near the iron and cup.

A person carries a round wooden stool into an open doorway and sets it just inside. They bend down several times to arrange a flat white packet and small objects on the floor beside it, including a dark bottle left standing upright. After straightening up, they swing the door closed, hiding the items and most of the stool, then turn and step away.

A person crouches by a closed kitchen door to place a pale shoe and a small translucent jug on the floor. They bring over a white metal chair, set it beside the objects, and add a small bottle near the jug. When they swing the door inward, it shifts the chair and nearby floor objects toward the left, while the jug ends up beside their feet.

A person sitting on a tiled step picks up a flat cardboard letter P and holds it in front of their body, then lowers it out of view. They repeat the display with a cardboard E and finally an F, removing each before presenting the next. A large jar of dried beans stands on the floor with a banana resting across its yellow lid.

A person raises a pale paper letter D in front of the camera and lowers it out of view to the left. They display an E, then a K, handling each briefly before taking it away. They finish by holding up a pale triangular cutout and lowering it, while the clear glass, egg carton, and tea box stay on the counter.

A seated person presents colorful letter cutouts on an open palm and places them in a row across a white tablecloth. They add a red M, blue N, yellow O, green P, red Q, and blue R in order, briefly displaying each before setting it down. A small glass with green stems remains on the left and a black remote stays on the right.

A person standing behind a glossy red table holds up a small green letter F with both hands, then lowers it out of view. A green letter E is presented and removed in the same way. Finally, they display a small square piece with a pink border and green center before lowering it, leaving the tabletop clear.

A hand holds a pale letter A above the table and withdraws it, then presents a purple B in the same spot. The person continues with a yellow C and a green D, showing each letter separately by its top edge. The spice jar, figurines, and small blue bottle remain on the table as the final cutout is taken away.

A person opens both palms above a dark wooden table, showing a small white clip in the hand farther from the camera. They close their hands, cross their wrists, and lower both fists together onto the table. Opening their palms again reveals the white clip in the same farther hand, after which they bring their hands back together.

A person opens both hands toward the camera, displaying a large dark X across one palm. They close their hands, lower the fists, and move them together in front of their body before opening one hand and then the other. Both palms face forward again, with the large X and a smaller reddish mark on the opposite palm visible, before the hands close and lower.

A seated person raises both hands above a pale tablecloth and repeatedly brings their palms together over the middle of the table. Between claps, they spread their arms outward and turn their open palms toward the camera. They finish by lowering both hands near the back edge, while the capped bottle at the left and clear jars at the right remain still.

A person holds both fists above a wooden table, then opens their palms to reveal a small red-and-white wrapped item in one hand. They close their hands, move the fists around, and briefly bring their hands together. Opening both palms again shows the wrapped item in the same hand, and they finish with both fists closed.

The person opens both hands toward the camera, showing a purple cross on one palm. They close their hands into fists and lower their arms beside their body. After bringing both fists forward again, they spread their fingers and hold their palms together, with the same cross still visible.

A hand picks up a brown egg from a kitchen counter, holds it over a white bowl, and sets the whole egg inside. A person removes a dark brown garment from a white shopping bag, folds it into a bundle, and places it beside the pink slipper on the folding table. They take out two white cylindrical containers and stand them in front of the garment, then add a small white rectangular box. Finally, they gather and crumple the empty bag and leave it at the right end of the table.

A hand places a metal spoon near the front of an empty wooden coffee table and a small red tomato near the back. The person brings in a black electric kettle and sets it behind the spoon. They add a kitchen knife beside the tomato and finally stand a clear bottle in front of the kettle, leaving all five objects on the table.

A hand places a clear ribbed cup upright near the front-left of the black tabletop. A tall decorated yellow tumbler is added behind it to the right, followed by a plain pale yellow cup farther right. Finally, the person sets a white printed mug upside down at the back-right end, leaving four vessels arranged diagonally across the table.

A person lifts a black frying pan to show its inside, then returns it to the counter. They pick up and display a remote control, a small gray rectangular device and a floral mug in turn, putting each down again. Next, they lift and spread out the colorful cloth, then reposition the fork and red-handled knife beside it.

A hand points across an empty fruit-patterned tablecloth, then brings in a small white cup with a pencil leaning from it and sets it at the back right. A dark paperback is laid at the back left, followed by a round container with a pink lid near the front left. The hand points across the remaining open space and withdraws.

A person presents a brown mug with a black interior above the floral table covering and takes it away. They show a metal spoon next, followed by a shallow metal plate, withdrawing each between views. Finally, they hold up a bunched olive garment with orange ties and then dark denim fabric before removing both from view.

Two cardboard tubes lie side by side with purple cutouts standing behind them. A person rolls a textured orange ball toward the near opening of the right tube, then retrieves it. They send the ball toward the left tube and point at it resting against the opening. After removing it again, they roll it toward the right tube once more, where it remains outside the mouth.

A person sets a small pale ball on a black notebook and lifts its right edge, making the ball roll off to the left. They retrieve the ball, replace it, and tilt the notebook again so it rolls away once more. They return the notebook flat and leave the ball on top, beside a white mug and a red bowl standing on a wrapped loaf of bread.

A person releases a small white ball beside a clear, funnel-shaped section of a plastic bottle on a patterned mat. They lift and reposition the plastic section, then guide it across the mat with one finger; the ball becomes visible inside its broad opening when they withdraw their hand. They retrieve and move the plastic section again, leaving the ball visible near its wide rim.

A hand releases a blue spiky ball from the left end of the white cutting board, and it rolls toward the tin at the other end. The person reaches behind the tin to retrieve it and brings it back to the starting side. They repeat the roll, collect the ball again, and release it for another pass across the board.

A person moves a small gold spiked ball attached to a string across a cluttered tabletop, drawing it toward the left wall. They lay a closed red book over some papers, lift the ball, and set it on the cover. After repositioning it near the right side, they tug the string again, making the ball move across the book and roll off onto the bare table at the left.

A person opens a brown wallet on the table and picks up a small white card, sliding it into an inner compartment. They fold the wallet closed and open the black bag behind it. The closed wallet is lowered toward the bag's opening, and a hand reaches inside before the person leaves the bag lying flat on the table.

A hand slides the pale card into a slot in the open black wallet on the desk. The person folds the wallet closed, grips it from above, and lifts it toward the gray shoulder bag. They lower the wallet into an open compartment of the bag, with their hand still at the opening at the end.

A person picks up the white card and brown wallet from the table, opens the wallet and works the card between its inner sections. They fold the wallet closed, lift the flap of the black laptop bag and move the wallet behind it until it is hidden. They lower the flap again, leaving the banknote, two coins, mouse, scissors and marker on the table.

The person unzips the patterned wallet and spreads its compartments open. They pick up the pink card from the table and insert it into a slot, then add the blue card to another compartment. Finally, they close and zip the wallet and lower it into the dark handbag, leaving the loose notes and coins on the table.

A person picks up a brown wallet from a blue backpack and opens it over a small table. They tuck a folded white slip into the wallet, close it, and unzip a front compartment of the backpack. They place the wallet inside and pull the zipper closed, leaving the folded banknotes, coins, cucumber, and other tabletop items outside the bag.

A person folds the white garment and leaves it at the far end of the ironing board. They lift the black garment, fold it into a smaller bundle, and stack it over the white one. They then fold the white paper in half, press along the crease, and carry it to the clothes, placing it on top of the stack beside the egg and fork.

A person lifts a gray garment from a pile on a covered table, folds it, and places it near the back. They fold a white garment over it, smoothing the new stack with both hands. Next, they pick up a dark striped shirt, fold it, and add it on top, while a blue garment remains spread separately at the front.

A person folds a camouflage garment on a bed and places a folded zebra striped garment on top. They lay a white sheet of paper over the stack, fold a green knitted garment, and add it above the paper. They press and straighten the completed pile, leaving it beside an empty lavender basin before moving out of view.

A person moves the dark floral garment aside and folds the plain black clothing into a compact shape on the counter. They fold the yellow garment and place it on the black layer. Next, they gather the pale striped garment, lay it on top, and press the pile with both hands, leaving the floral item spread out to the right.

A person sorts a pile on a wooden table, gathering a white garment and then folding a striped towel over it on the right. They fold a gray item and add it to the stack. Next, they crease a sheet of white paper and stand it on top before gathering the last white cloth and placing it with the folded items.

A person pulls a dark cord looped around a small watermelon, making the fruit rock on the counter, then lets the cord fall aside. They lift and rotate the watermelon by hand before removing it briefly. They return it with the cord around it on the cutting board and rock it again while holding the cord. After lifting it away once more, they set it back on the counter beside the board.

A person opens a small silver backpack and lowers a purple book into it, leaving much of the book sticking out. They add a blue pen beside the book and adjust the opening. The book is then lifted back out and placed on the table to the right of the backpack, with the watermelon left untouched on the other side.

A kneeling person brings small green fruits to two white plastic cups lying on their sides on the tiled floor. One fruit passes through the right-hand cup and rolls out toward the lower right. The person then brings another fruit to the back of that cup while pointing at the neighboring cup, leaving the water bottle and cardboard letters in place.

A person lifts the large mottled yellow fruit from the table, holding it horizontally with a white cloth beneath it before carrying it out of view. They next pick up the dark round fruit, turn it in their hands and remove it as well. Finally, they display the carrot across one palm and take it away, leaving the tall lidded glass at the left.

A person holds a yellow lemon in one hand, turns it to show different sides, and brings it close to the camera before setting it on the counter. They repeat the presentation with a green apple and place it to the lemon’s left. Finally, they hold a carrot horizontally across their palm and lay it along the front edge, in front of the two fruits.

A person carries a green plastic stool into the doorway and sets it on the tiled floor behind the open wooden door. They drop a red and yellow packet beside the stool, then add a small clear packet closer to the threshold. The door swings toward them, shifting the stool to the right and leaving both packets visible on the floor in front of its lower edge.

A person carries a round wooden stool into an open doorway and sets it just inside. They bend down several times to arrange a flat white packet and small objects on the floor beside it, including a dark bottle left standing upright. After straightening up, they swing the door closed, hiding the items and most of the stool, then turn and step away.

A barefoot person drops a small red and yellow box onto the tiled floor in the doorway, then adds a small dark item beside it. They bring over a green plastic stool and set it over the items at the threshold. The door swings closer to the stool and remains partly open as the person steps away.

A person walks to an open doorway and places a white plastic bag and a small crumpled brown object on the tiled floor. They carry a wooden chair into the doorway and set it beside the objects, then pull the door toward them by its handle. The door comes partway across the opening beside the chair, and the person walks away to the left.

A person lays a small orange-filled bottle on its side on the floor beside an open door, then places a white envelope next to it. They add a large red cylindrical tin on its side near the envelope. As the door swings across the floor, the bottle and tin shift toward the right side of the doorway and the envelope is partly caught beneath the door's edge.

A person lays a green capped marker horizontally in the middle of the wooden tray. They hold a black notebook with a cat face upright in front of the marker, then move the notebook farther back and bring it forward again while keeping it vertical. They finally take the notebook to the right, revealing the middle of the tray clear, with the marker no longer visible.

A person displays a black-capped marker in one hand and lays it near the back of a checked table. They show a metal spoon next, then slide it into place to the left of a black case. Finally, they present another dark pen and put it near the front, below the spoon.

A person moves a gray marker over a white sheet while holding the paper steady, then puts the marker down. They lift the sheet toward the camera, showing a blank surface, and return it to the counter. They then display green paper shapes and place a small triangle and a larger square on the white board beside the sheet, pressing both pieces flat.

A person lays a blue pen horizontally near the center of a wooden table, beside a printed sheet and a red pen. They bring a white paperback upright in front of the blue pen, hiding it while shifting the book across the table and moving the loose sheet. When they lift the paperback away, the blue pen is visible farther left near the back edge.

A person turns a small dark item between their hands and places it near the white egg. They then hold up a red-capped pen and a black pen in turn, laying them on the table after each display. Finally, they show the orange-handled spoon and set it down to the left of the writing implements.

A person opens the upper pocket of a gray backpack lying on a black table and holds the flap upright. With their other hand, they move slim dark items from beside a water jug toward the pocket, repeatedly lowering their fingers into its opening. They work along the zipper edge, lower the flap over the pocket and move away, leaving the backpack beside the jug.

A person holds a black backpack open and lowers purple fabric out of view behind its front edge. They move several small stationery items from beside a closed laptop toward the opening, with a blue glue stick and writing tools becoming visible inside. They lift the laptop toward the bag, then lay the backpack flat and handle its zipper.

A person holds a gray backpack open on the table and lowers a purple bottle into its main compartment, leaving the bottle upright inside. They pick up the orange notebook and slide it down beside the bottle. Next, they lift the black-handled knife, turn it in their hand, and lower it into the bag; the sock, fork and patterned mug remain on the table.

The person lifts the top of a dark backpack lying on the table and slides a blue book into the open compartment. They add a thicker book with a dark cover, then an orange book, taking each from the stack beside the bag. After pressing the last book down inside, they lower the top of the backpack and withdraw their hand.

A person lifts an owl-patterned backpack from its side and stands it upright on the bed with its front facing the camera. They repeatedly reach to the left and return their hands to the top of the bag, handling the opening above its front panel. They then grip the sides, straighten and tilt the backpack, and continue adjusting its top.

A seated person starts a row near the front of the wooden table by placing a red letter R and a dark blue block beside it. They add a blue S, then a red bottle cap to its right. They place a green T next and finish with a purple cap at the far right, withdrawing their hand after each addition while the remote stays behind the row.

A person brings a black remote control to a wooden table, shows its buttons, and sets it beside a small lidded glass jar. They then hold out an empty white ribbed bowl and place it farther to the right. Finally, they display a black sock and lay it on the right side of the bowl, leaving the items spread across the table.

A seated person pushes an orange across the red tablecloth toward the remote control on the right. Once the orange stops nearby, they pick up that remote and place it on the sofa beside them. They retrieve the orange, bring it back toward the left, and roll it across the cleared area again, leaving the bottles and other remote on the table.

The person displays a purple F and places it near the front of the wooden table. They add a yellow O, an orange R, and a blue D one at a time, forming the word FORD. After straightening the row with their hand, they hold up a dark blue triangular piece and set it beside the F.

A person holds up a green letter E and places it flat on a dark wooden table. They show a red A and add it to the right, followed by a brown U to complete a row of three letters. Finally, they display a small green triangle and set it below the middle of the row, with a water bottle and keys remaining behind the pieces.

A person opens the thick red and gray paperback on a wooden board and places a small blue card between its pages. They close the book and return it to the board, then pick up the pink and blue paperback beside it. This second book is moved toward the black backpack behind the desk, where the person works both hands around the bag's opening.

A person lifts the small book from the cabinet and opens it above the larger book lying underneath. They pick up the pale rectangular slip, lay it between the pages and close the small book. They move it toward the red bag, open the bag’s top and lower their hands at the opening before letting go and stepping back.

A person opens a red paperback and places a folded banknote between its pages before closing it. They open the flap of a dark shoulder bag and slide the book into an inner compartment. After pressing it down, they fold the flap back over the bag and leave it closed on the table beside another book, scissors, and a small glass.

A person picks up a banknote, opens the orange paperback beside a red backpack and brings their fingers toward its pages. They close that book and leave it on the table. They lift the other orange paperback from the foreground and place it in the open backpack, pressing it down before folding the broad bag panel over the opening.

The person lifts the top of a dark backpack lying on the table and slides a blue book into the open compartment. They add a thicker book with a dark cover, then an orange book, taking each from the stack beside the bag. After pressing the last book down inside, they lower the top of the backpack and withdraw their hand.

A person lifts a black wallet, opens its top, and picks up a small coin from the table. They put the coin into the wallet, pull the closure shut, and turn the wallet in their hands. The person then spreads the quilted handbag open, lowers the wallet toward its opening, and works the bag's zipper before withdrawing both hands.

A person opens a black wallet beside a black zippered bag and gathers the banknotes on the striped surface. They work the notes along the wallet’s inner edge, fold it closed and turn it in one hand. They open the bag’s front compartment and push the wallet inside, then tug the zipper at the right and pat the bag, leaving a gap along the opening.

A person holds a folded banknote above an open black wallet beside the laptop and tucks it into the wallet. They fold the wallet closed, lift it from the desk, and bring it toward the upright black shoulder bag. They lower the wallet into the open compartment at the top and press it down with their fingers, leaving the bag open.

A person opens a brown wallet on the table and picks up a small white card, sliding it into an inner compartment. They fold the wallet closed and open the black bag behind it. The closed wallet is lowered toward the bag's opening, and a hand reaches inside before the person leaves the bag lying flat on the table.

A person opens a tan wallet on a desk beside a brown handbag, picks up the banknotes lying nearby, and pushes them into the wallet's compartment. They fold the wallet shut and press its flap closed. They then lift the wallet over the open handbag and lower it inside, where its tan edge remains visible near the top.

A person opens both hands beside a potted plant, showing a coin on the farther palm and the nearer palm empty. They close both fists and move them around, briefly crossing the wrists. When the hands open again, the coin is on the farther palm, which is then held closer to the camera to display it.

A person opens one hand to reveal a coin on the palm, then closes their fingers around it. They draw their hands back and move them together before returning both fists side by side above the table. Finally, they open both palms, displaying the coin in the hand on the left of the image while the other palm is empty.

A person opens one hand over a wooden table to show a coin in their palm, then closes it into a fist. They bring the other fist alongside it and cross and turn their forearms before holding both fists forward. Finally, they open both palms, showing the coin in one hand and the other hand empty.

A seated person opens one hand over the glass table to show a coin, while keeping the other hand closed. They close the open palm, turn both fists downward and cross their forearms. They reopen the same hand on the opposite side of the crossed arms, showing the coin still resting in the palm beside a small blue mark, then close it again.

A person holds both hands in fists near the camera, then opens them with the palms facing upward and fingers spread. They close the hands again, cross their wrists, and move the fists past one another. The hands separate and reopen to show both empty palms before closing and crossing again above the table.

A cat sits among several cups on a table while a person reaches into a clear bag of white pieces. The person lowers pinched fingers into a dotted cup and draws it forward, then brings another dotted cup and a small floral cup alongside it. The cat leans toward the cups as the person lifts a blue cup from behind them.

A person sets a tall patterned cup with a yellow rim on the gray table, then adds a white cup with green leaves beside it. A clear glass is placed in front of the yellow-rimmed cup. The final cup, decorated with small stars, is set upside down to the right of the glass, forming a second row.

A person places a translucent purple cup upright near the back of the round table. They add a second cup in front of it, turning this one upside down, then set a third cup upright closer to the front edge. The cups form a short diagonal row beside the small roll of tape.

A person moves cups from the right end of a white table into a row across its middle. They set a patterned white cup upright, place a green and yellow cup upside down to its left, add an upright metal tumbler, and then an inverted maroon and yellow cup farther left. They finish by lifting the remaining maroon cup and turning it upside down in the air.

A seated person steadies clear plastic bowls lying on their sides near the back of a white table. Their other hand repeatedly reaches toward a small orange ball among the bowls and nudges it through short movements. The bowls remain clustered together while a tall container stays balanced on an inverted mug to the left.

A person opens a paperback and lays the blue banknotes from the table between its pages. They close the book with part of the money still protruding and lift it. Holding the black handbag open by a strap, the person lowers the book toward its opening, reaches inside, and then folds the top down and presses the bag flat.

A person picks up a book from a small table and opens it, turning through several pages. They lift a banknote from the tabletop, lay it across the open pages, adjust it, and close the book around it. They then lower the closed book into a tan handbag, press it farther down through the opening, and pull the bag zipper across the top.

A person picks up a banknote, opens the orange paperback beside a red backpack and brings their fingers toward its pages. They close that book and leave it on the table. They lift the other orange paperback from the foreground and place it in the open backpack, pressing it down before folding the broad bag panel over the opening.

A person opens a black wallet beside a black zippered bag and gathers the banknotes on the striped surface. They work the notes along the wallet’s inner edge, fold it closed and turn it in one hand. They open the bag’s front compartment and push the wallet inside, then tug the zipper at the right and pat the bag, leaving a gap along the opening.

A person opens a red paperback and places a folded banknote between its pages before closing it. They open the flap of a dark shoulder bag and slide the book into an inner compartment. After pressing it down, they fold the flap back over the bag and leave it closed on the table beside another book, scissors, and a small glass.

A person picks up a banana from the back of a white table, holds it toward the camera and sets it nearer the front. They repeat the display with an orange and a green apple, placing both below the banana. Lastly, they show a red-skinned sweet potato and lay it to the right of the fruit, leaving a slice of bread on the left.

A person holds a red and yellow apple close to the camera, turns it slightly, and takes it away. They display a red tomato next, followed by a large red and yellow mango. Finally, they lift a long pale squash with green stripes, turn it horizontally between both hands, and lower it back toward the right side of the counter.

A person presents a red apple on an open palm and sets it on the wooden table beside the water bottle. They show a short carrot next and lay it to the apple's left. A pale green fruit with a bumpy, segmented skin is then held toward the camera and placed farther left, completing a row of three foods.

A person holds a yellow lemon in one hand, turns it to show different sides, and brings it close to the camera before setting it on the counter. They repeat the presentation with a green apple and place it to the lemon’s left. Finally, they hold a carrot horizontally across their palm and lay it along the front edge, in front of the two fruits.

A person seated behind a table holds a bunch of dark grapes close to the camera and sets it back down. They repeat the display with a yellow red apple, a dark purple plum, and a carrot, returning each beside the others. A tall empty glass, a small red toy car, a blue pen, and an upright book remain around the fruit and vegetable.

A person arranges three books on a wooden table, leaving one slanted across another and standing the third upright in front of its right end. They release a small orange onto the slanted book; it rolls behind the upright book and emerges on the right. They repeat this twice, then leave the orange beside the books and step away.

A person rolls an orange across the wooden table and retrieves it near the front edge. They bring a closed brown book forward and lift the orange onto its cover. The orange is turned and moved over the book, then released on top while the red mug and pale apple remain at the back of the table.

A person places an apple on a closed book, raises one edge of the book, and lets the apple roll off onto the table. They retrieve it and repeat the movement several times, changing the tilt so the apple rolls toward the near edge and then off the left side. The apple finishes on the table beside the book, while a capped bottle remains to the left.

A person places one end of a wooden board on a stack of books to make a ramp. They release an orange at the raised end, allowing it to roll down onto the table, then retrieve it from near the small black box. The orange is sent down the board a second time, retrieved again and reset for another release as the person's hand lifts away.

A person lays a small clear jar of yellow liquid on its side near the right end of a book and releases it to roll across the cover. They repeatedly retrieve the jar from the left, return it to the right and let it roll again. After the last run, they move the jar beside the notebook pile, leaving the book clear in front of them.

A person lifts a metal kettle and pours water into two short glasses on a coffee table. They set the kettle down, bring a stemmed glass forward and tip one short glass over it to transfer some water. They then hold the short glass toward the camera, showing water still inside, and return it to the table.

A person removes the cap from a water bottle and tips it over each of two tall glasses, leaving shallow amounts of clear liquid in both. They lift the middle glass and pour its liquid into the short tumbler on the right. They hold the emptied tall glass upright and turn it slightly toward the camera, then put it back between the other two glasses.

A seated person touches the blue lid of a translucent pitcher, grips its neck and tilts it to pour water into a clear glass on a small table. They set the pitcher upright and touch the lid again. They then lift the glass toward their mouth, mostly above the view, and return it beside the pitcher and a red hair dryer.

A person pours clear liquid from a large plastic bottle into two clear cups in turn, then stands the bottle behind them. Holding the fruit-printed glass in one hand, they lift the left cup and pour most of its contents into that glass. They bring the cup close to the camera and tilt it to show the small amount remaining, then set it back beside the fuller cup.

A person unscrews the blue cap from a water bottle and pours clear liquid into the ribbed glass held in the other hand. They recap the bottle and stand it on the table. The person then lifts the glass toward the top of the frame, lowers it again, and moves it to the right of the smaller patterned glass.

A person unscrews the blue cap from a water bottle and pours clear liquid into the ribbed glass held in the other hand. They recap the bottle and stand it on the table. The person then lifts the glass toward the top of the frame, lowers it again, and moves it to the right of the smaller patterned glass.

A person lifts the blue patterned jug and pours clear liquid into the two wide glasses on the right, moving it over the taller left glass before setting it down. They pick up the middle glass and pour its liquid into the tall glass. After tipping and rotating the emptied glass above it, they hold the glass toward the camera and return it between the other two.

A hand unscrews the metal cap from the clear bottle and removes it. The person lifts the open bottle, tilts its mouth over the stemless glass, and stands it upright again. They then pick up the glass and raise it out of view before returning it to the table beside the uncapped bottle.

A person unscrews the red cap from a clear plastic bottle and places it on the counter. They hold the glass steady and pour clear liquid into it, then set the bottle upright. They lift the filled glass toward their face above the frame, lower it back beside the bottle, and step away, leaving the cap off near the cutting board.

A person lifts the left inverted glass to show the bare tabletop, then lifts the right glass to reveal a small bottle underneath. After covering the bottle, they slide the glasses around each other. The bottle is revealed beneath the glass on the left, while the right one covers an empty patch; both glasses are set back upside down.

A seated person shows three slender writing tools one after another above the floral tablecloth, setting each aside before taking the next. They then hold a purple illustrated book upright with its cover facing the camera and place it to the side, followed by a red book shown the same way. Finally, the person presents a green plastic cup and takes it away.

A person lifts a kitchen knife from beside the table and holds it horizontally between both hands before lowering it out of view. They then present a green writing tool, a yellow one, and a blue one in turn, removing each to the left before showing the next. A lime and black zippered case remain on the fruit-patterned tablecloth throughout.

A hand presents writing tools one at a time above the dark table, withdrawing each between views. A gray marker with a black cap is followed by a broad blue-capped marker, a slim blue pen, a silver-bodied marker with a blue cap, and another gray marker with a black cap. Finally, the person shows a clear glass with blue printing and takes it away.

The person presents a flower-decorated mug, a thick dark marker, and a pale-yellow book one at a time, removing each before bringing the next into view. They then hold up a slim pen, followed by a mug with a black rectangular design and a taller white mug with a single black symbol. Each object is held above the patterned table and then taken away.

A person runs a hand across the red tablecloth, then places a dark book near the center of the table. They add an upside-down clear cup to its right and lay a green pen on the cover. A small jar with a red lid goes beside the clear cup, and a white mug is placed to the left of the book.

A person lowers blue jeans onto the glass table and leaves them spread out. They hold a dark garment above the jeans, fold it, and place it on the right leg. A pair of red and black high top trainers is then set over the folded clothing, followed by a banana placed on the jeans to the shoes' left.

A person lifts a pair of blue jeans and folds them into a compact pile in the middle of the table. They display a brightly patterned slip-on shoe and place it on the jeans, then add the matching shoe beside it. After adjusting the pair so both toes face forward, they release their hands.

The person lifts a pair of blue jeans and folds them into a compact stack on the wooden table. They place a brightly patterned slip-on shoe on top, then add its matching shoe beside it. Holding both shoes by their openings, they briefly lift them together and set them back onto the folded jeans.

A seated person stretches a pair of blue jeans lengthwise across the white table, folds the legs inward, and brings the waistband over to make a compact rectangle. They place a fork to the left, then set two black shoes side by side on top of the folded jeans. A paperback is added on the far left beside the fork.

The person stretches the gray trousers along the table and folds them into a shorter rectangle. They set a pair of white sneakers side by side on the folded trousers. Next, they hold a dark striped garment across the shoes, fold it inward, and leave it resting on top of the pair.

A hand sets a blue-ended marker on a book at the left of a patterned mug and releases it along the sloping blue cover behind the mug. The person retrieves the marker from the right and returns it to the left book. They repeat the rolling movement, with the mug obscuring the middle of its path.

A pale blue board spans between a small book stack and a white paperback behind a patterned mug. A person places a blue capped marker near the left end and releases it to roll rightward along the board. They return it to the left and repeat the movement, reaching around the mug to retrieve it, then lift the marker away and hold it near the front left edge of the table.

A person lays a small blue-and-white cylinder sideways on a sloping children’s book and releases it to roll toward an upright box of colorful letters. The box hides the right end of the book. The person reaches behind it, retrieves the cylinder and brings it back to the left, repeating the rolling action twice more.

A person rolls a blue ball from the right end of the narrow wooden table toward the yellow book on the left, then retrieves it and repeats the motion. Holding the ball at the right edge, they lift the book away with their other hand. They then release the ball across the cleared tabletop for another roll.

A person lays a small clear jar of yellow liquid on its side near the right end of a book and releases it to roll across the cover. They repeatedly retrieve the jar from the left, return it to the right and let it roll again. After the last run, they move the jar beside the notebook pile, leaving the book clear in front of them.

A person tosses an orange above their open hands and sets it back on the table. They reach to the power strip, whose red switch light goes out, then briefly lift the orange again and put it down beside the scissors. Finally, they lift the black hair dryer by its handle, turn it slightly, and lay it back on the table.

A person picks up the black hair dryer from the small shelf, turns it in their hand, and handles the controls near the grip. While holding it horizontally, they lift the banana from the toilet-paper stand and put it back, then briefly touch the paper roll. The dryer is lowered toward the shelf again with its cord still plugged into the wall.

A person lifts a black hair dryer from a red-covered table and holds it with its nozzle angled upward. With their free hand, they repeatedly slide and turn a wooden spoon on the table, changing the direction of its handle and bowl. They leave the spoon on the table and lower the hair dryer back beside it.
